6e1a06e0.title: Architect, Principal
6e1a06e0.description:
### **Description**

  

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead BI/Datawarehouse Architect to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining our company's business intelligence (BI) and data warehouse (DW) solutions, ensuring they meet the organization's strategic data and reporting needs.  

### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

  

* Oversee the design, development, and deployment of the data warehouse and BI infrastructure, including the ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, data modeling, and reporting tools.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including business analysts, data engineers, and IT professionals, to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Develop and maintain a robust data governance framework, ensuring data quality, security, and compliance with relevant regulations.
* Optimize the performance and scalability of the BI and DW systems, implementing best practices and leveraging the latest technologies.


  

* Proficiency in cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform for designing, implementing, and managing data warehousing models, storage, and data processing solutions.
  

* Mentor and lead a team of BI/DW specialists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation.
* Stay up\-to\-date with industry trends and emerging technologies, and recommend strategic initiatives to enhance the company's data and analytics capabilities.
* Design, develop, and maintain a robust, scalable, and efficient data warehouse architecture to support the organization's business intelligence and reporting needs.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their data and reporting requirements, and translate them into technical solutions.
* Oversee the implementation and integration of data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
* Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and other database objects to support advanced data analysis and reporting.
* Implement and maintain data quality and data governance processes to ensure the reliability and integrity of the data warehouse.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the data warehouse team, guiding and supporting their professional development.
* Continuously monitor and optimize the performance of the data warehouse infrastructure, addressing any bottlenecks or issues that may arise.
* Collaborate with the IT team to ensure the data warehouse is integrated with other systems and applications, and that it aligns with the organization's overall technology strategy.
* Stay up\-to\-date with industry trends and advancements in data warehouse technologies, and recommend and implement appropriate solutions to enhance the organization's business intelligence capabilities.

### **Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Extensive experience (10\+ years) in BI/DW architecture, design, and implementation, preferably in a team lead role.
* Proficient in data modeling, ETL processes, and the use of BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Qlik).
* Strong knowledge of database technologies (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL) and cloud\-based data platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business\-friendly language.
* Experience in project management and leading cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.

cdd7c4e2.title: Tenable Architect
cdd7c4e2.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

We are looking for a **Tenable Security Architect / Administrator** to lead the end\-to\-end design, deployment, administration, and automation of our enterprise vulnerability management infrastructure across hybrid environments.


### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Architecture \& Design:** Design, scale, and maintain Tenable architecture (Security Center, Tenable.io/Tenable Vulnerability Management, and Nessus Scanners) across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid setups.
* **Platform Administration:** Oversee daily operations, including scan policies, repositories, RBAC, platform upgrades, plugin updates, and troubleshooting scan or connectivity issues.
* **Vulnerability Management:** Analyze scan results, prioritize vulnerabilities based on CVSS and business risk, and partner with IT/cloud teams to drive and validate remediation.
* **Automation \& Scripting:** Write scripts to automate health checks, reporting, and operational tasks using REST APIs and JSON payload processing.
* **Enterprise Integration:** Connect Tenable platforms with ServiceNow, SIEMs (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel), and Active Directory.

  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from a Junior Architect to Principal Architect – we have opportunities for that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.


### **Required Skillsets**

* **Core Platform Experience:** 7–10\+ years in vulnerability management with deep hands\-on expertise in Tenable Security Center, Tenable.io (Tenable Vulnerability Management), and Nessus scanners.
* **Vulnerability Frameworks:** Solid knowledge of vulnerability management lifecycles, asset discovery, credentialed scanning, CVE, CVSS scoring, and CIS Benchmarks.
* **Scripting \& APIs:** Basic to intermediate proficiency in **Python, PowerShell, or Bash** , with practical experience utilizing **REST APIs** and processing JSON data for operational automation.
* **System Integration:** Proven experience integrating Tenable with **ServiceNow** , **SIEM solutions** (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel), and **Active Directory** .
* **Operations \& Maintenance:** Hands\-on experience with platform upgrades, scanner deployment, policy configurations, and troubleshooting scan failures or network issues.

### **Preferred Skillsets**

* **Cloud Exposure:** Working knowledge of cloud security scanning mechanics in **AWS, Azure, or GCP** environments.
* **Certifications:** Tenable Certified Security Center Specialist/Architect, CISSP, CEH, or CISM.
* **Governance \& Compliance:** Experience supporting security audits, compliance mapping, and executive metrics reporting.

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

d982d4c6.title: Senior Architect
d982d4c6.description:
**Job Overview:**

The Senior Architect will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the overall architecture of our IT systems to support the organization's current and future needs. The Senior Architect will have a strong background in IT infrastructure, systems integration, and software development, with the ability to analyze complex problems and design innovative solutions. He/she will be responsible for providing strategic direction, designing complex IT solutions, and mentoring junior architects. This architect will be responsible for designing enterprise data models, defining metadata and governance standards, analyzing data quality issues, implementing MDM matching and survivorship strategies, evaluating emerging technologies, and enabling AI\-driven automation across the enterprise data ecosystem. Working closely with Data Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Stewards, and Business SMEs, the architect will translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions that improve data quality, governance, discoverability, and business value.


**Summary of Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain the organization's IT architecture framework, ensuring alignment with business objectives, industry best practices, and emerging technologies.
* Serve as the hands\-on technical architect and subject matter expert for Data Governance, Data Quality, Master Data Management (MDM), Metadata Management, Data Catalog, and AI\-enabled data management platforms.
* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise data architecture standards, canonical data models, metadata frameworks, and governance practices that promote trusted, discoverable, and reusable data assets.
* Lead technical design and configuration of MDM solutions, including data modeling, matching, survivorship, hierarchy management, and integration patterns across critical business domains.
* Analyze enterprise data quality issues through data profiling, root cause analysis, quality assessments, and measurement frameworks; define remediation strategies and business rules to improve data reliability and compliance.
* Architect and optimize enterprise Data Catalog and Metadata Management capabilities, including business glossary, lineage, classification, stewardship, and metadata enrichment processes.
* Identify and implement AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation capabilities to enhance data quality monitoring, anomaly detection, metadata enrichment, entity resolution, stewardship workflows, and governance operations.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to architecture and development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural principles, standards, and guidelines.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions that meet functional and non\-functional requirements.
* Design end\-to\-end IT solutions, including infrastructure, applications, data, and security components, to support business processes and workflows.
* Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance the organization's IT capabilities and drive innovation.
* Lead architectural reviews and provide guidance to development teams to ensure adherence to architectural principles, standards, and guidelines.
* Identify and mitigate architectural risks and issues through proactive planning and effective communication with stakeholders.
* Define and maintain documentation related to IT architecture, including diagrams, standards, policies, and procedures.
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in IT architecture, and apply knowledge to drive continuous improvement.
* Measurably impact company performance by delivering high quality, scalable data products.
* And all other duties as needed or assigned.

**Qualifications (Minimum Required):**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.

**Experience (Minimum Required):**

* 10 years of experience in Enterprise, Business, Information, Systems and Application, Solution Architectures.
* Strong expertise in designing and implementing enterprise\-scale IT solutions across multiple platforms and technologies.
* Hands\-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise data architecture, Data Governance, Data Quality, Metadata Management, Data Catalog, MDM, or related data management solutions.
* Must have e xperience implementing data solutions in Microsoft Azure
* In\-depth knowledge of cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and their services.
* Proficiency in system integration techniques, including API design, microservices architecture, and message queuing protocols.
* Hands\-on experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or Puppet.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively with stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications Include:**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Experience in pharmaceutical R and D, clinical development and/or healthcare IT.

Learn more about our EEO \& Accommodations request here .

e49af77d.title: Technical Architect - Sitecore
e49af77d.description:
Be a part of a high\-growth Customer and Employee Experience consulting firm that’s redefining digital engagement. Recognized by Inc. 5000, Great Place to Work and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 North America as one of the fastest growing companies, Altudo offers an environment where innovation, learning, and growth go hand in hand.
 



  





 Altudo has been awarded the Sales Performance Partner – XM Cloud Hero award by Sitecore in 2025\.
 



 As an Architect, you will provide technical leadership throughout the lifecycle of projects, with a strong focus on Sitecore and composable solutioning. You will guide design, user interface, and technology integration while interfacing with client technology and management teams to ensure solutions meet business and technical requirements. You will design end\-to\-end digital Sitecore technology solutions, participate in initial client conversations to identify needs, and provide pre\-sales support by bridging business goals with high\-value technical solutions.
 



  





**What will you do:** 



* Lead architecture and solution design for enterprise\-scale Sitecore and composable solutions, defining reference architectures, frameworks, and best practices for scalable, resilient implementations.
* Provide hands\-on guidance in implementing composable components, orchestrating microservices, integrating APIs, and deploying solutions on cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Ensure quality and industry standards with security first driven development across projects
* Design and implement CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), monitoring, observability, and API standards to support scalable, secure cloud deployments.
* Define and enforce API standards, manage API gateway configurations, and leverage event\-driven architectures for asynchronous communication between front\-end and back\-end systems.
* Partner with engineering, product, and business teams to translate functional and non\-functional requirements into technical solutions that are composable, modular, and aligned with business goals.
* Translate functional and non\-functional requirements into technical solutions, drive projects from conceptual architecture to deployment, including POCs, coding, and detailed estimates.
* Provide architectural oversight, mentor teams, conduct code reviews, and ensure high\-quality, secure, and performance optimized deliverables.
* Collaborate with clients, platform partners, vendors, and delivery teams to align solutions with technology roadmaps, business goals, and industry standards.
* Serve as a thought leader—stay current with emerging technologies, drive strategic initiatives, develop internal IP, and train internal teams.



  





**Who you are:** 



* Strong experience with .NET/C\#, Sitecore AI (XM Cloud), Sitecore XP/XM (versions 9 and 10\), and end\-to\-end Sitecore upgrade and migration projects.
* Must be a certified Sitecore professional
* Experience creating Architectural Diagram and technical design
* Familiarity with Sitecore Headless / JSS / SXA
* Cloud / containerization experience for Sitecore deployments.
* Strong experience with CI/CD, automated deployments, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and deployment platforms such as Vercel, along with Azure DevOps/Azure Pipelines for build and release automation.
* Leverage AI\-assisted development tools such as Cursor to enhance engineering productivity while maintaining full ownership of architecture, code quality, technical decisions, and overall solution delivery.
* Experience working with GraphQL / Sitecore Graph / Sitecore APIs
* Proficiency in modern front\-end frameworks (React, Nextjs) when integrating with headless Sitecore approaches.
* Performance tuning, caching strategies, and scalability in high\-traffic environments.
* Proficiency in Prompt engineering and using any AI tool for development
* Familiarity with DXP platforms beyond Sitecore, such as Optimizely, Contentful, or Contentstack



  





**What’s in it for you?** 



* Opportunity to work with a fast\-growing digital transformation and customer experience consulting that has been recognized internationally by Deloitte fast 500 \& INCE 5000 for this exceptional growth.
* Direct involvement in shaping enterprise Sitecore architectures for global brands.
* Competitive compensation structure
* Exposure to the latest in customer experience and digital commerce technologies.
* Collaborate with CMO, CIO, and senior business stakeholders across leading organizations.



  





**About Altudo**









 Altudo is an award\-winning customer experience consulting firm with a global presence across US, Canada, UK, UAE and India. We combine strategic insight, technology, and creativity to deliver measurable business impacts. Our commitment to excellence has been recognized with awards including Great Place to Work honor, Deloitte Technology Fast 500, and Inc. 5000 rankings. Our client work has been honored with top industry awards like Hermes, AVA, and Vega echoing our approach to help brand move from vision to value.
 



 We deliver serious outcomes, not serious egos. By blending design\-led thinking, engineering precision, and AI\-powered intelligence, we help brands move from strategy to execution at speed. As a trusted partner to Sitecore, Optimizely, Contentstack, BigCommerce, Asana, Similarweb, we leverage world\-class technologies to design scalable, data\-driven solutions for our clients .
 



 Our frameworks and accelerators play a key role in aligning business ambition with customer impact \- building scalable systems that create measurable value and lasting relevance. At Altudo, we bring together strategists, designers, and engineers who share a common mindset \- curious by nature, outcome\-obsessed, and unafraid to experiment. We take the work seriously, not ourselves. Our teams challenge assumptions with empathy and move fast with the purpose of creating meaningful impact. We’re building what’s next \- together.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.

You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award\-winning employee development programs. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.


At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.

**ABOUT EMERSON**

Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability.

We offer equitable opportunities, celebrate diversity, and embrace challenges with confidence that, together, we can make an impact across a broad spectrum of countries and industries. Whether you’re an established professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring possibilities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, you’ll find your chance to make a difference with Emerson. Join our team – let’s go!

455ff562.title: Associate Project Delivery Leader
455ff562.description:
**Meet Our Team:**
------------------



PegaSystems is seeking Client Success Journey Designers who partner with executives and product/delivery teams to design and realize measurable client outcomes. You will blend strategy, service design, strong negotiation, and storytelling to align stakeholders, shape outcome\-led roadmaps, and guide squads from vision to value—ensuring adoption, satisfaction, and sustained impact.

**Picture Yourself at Pega:**
-----------------------------



Pegasystems is seeking Tech Project / Program managers to join our dynamic team of Delivery Leaders at multiple levels.

* Co\-design the client success journey—from vision to value —using the blueprints, journey maps, and testable value hypotheses as a Solution Designer.
* Champion Pega Blueprint based Rapid Delivery
* Deliver engagements to agreed client scope, timescales, budget, and quality metrics, as well as assisting clients to achieve the expected ROI.


At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.


We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.

**What You'll Do at Pega:**
---------------------------


* Typically be involved in between one and two projects, including Pega, partner, or client\-led implementations
* Deliver engagements to agreed client scope, timescales, budget, and quality metrics, as well as assisting clients to achieve the expected ROI
* Drive account hygiene (timely and accurate contractual documentation, Project Status Reports (PSRs), Engagement Status Dashboards (ESDs), forecasts, and A/R collections)
* Act as a trusted advisor to the client on all aspects of Pegasystems engagement, leading communication and providing thought leadership so that the best system possible is implemented
* Advise on Pegasystems’ delivery methodology and how this can be harmonized with a client’s methodology; demonstrate a thorough understanding of Agile, Waterfall, and Scrum approaches to delivery
**Who You Are:**
----------------


* 9\-12 years in consulting/professional services with 4\+ years leading cross\-functional engagements and/or product/program work; proven track record designing client journeys, conflict resolution, stakeholder mediation and landing measurable business outcomes.
* Experience in managing resources in Matrix or non\-direct reporting structures
* Knowledge of cloud migration strategies and legacy modernization approaches
* Demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships at multiple organizational levels.
* Executive\-caliber written communication; storytelling; ability to simplify complex concepts into crisp narratives. Practical Agile experience (Scrum/Kanban); skilled in discovery\-to\-delivery orchestration and backlog management.
* Certifications (nice to have): PMP(preferred), PSM/CSM, PRINCE2, SAFe POPM/Lean Portfolio, Service Design (e.g., SDN)
**What You've Accomplished:**
-----------------------------


* Translate strategy into action with MVP definitions, outcome\-based road maps, and prioritized backlogs tied to OKRs/KPIs.
* Negotiate scope and priorities to protect outcomes while managing constraints; facilitate governance and issue resolution with senior stakeholders.
* Tell the story of value through executive\-ready narratives, data\-driven visuals, and compelling demonstrations that accelerate decisions and adoption.
* Coach teams on journey\-centric delivery and help mature practices, templates, and playbooks that scale success across accounts.
* Identify growth opportunities through realized outcomes, adoption signals, and stakeholder advocacy; contribute to proposals and SoWs.
* ***Step up to play Scrum Master or a Pega Business Architect role as required***


LI\-MC3

**Pega Offers You:**
--------------------


* A rapidly growing yet well\-established business
* The world’s most innovative organizations as reference\-able clients
* Analyst acclaimed technology leadership in a massive emerging market
* A fast\-paced, exciting, collaborative, and rewarding sales environment within innovative industries

  
**AI in Action – Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment**  

Pega embraces the responsible use of artificial intelligence (AI) to improve efficiency, consistency, and fairness across our business. We encourage thoughtful and ethical adoption of AI technologies that support people—not replace them. We may use AI‑enabled tools in our recruitment process. These tools are designed to assist us by providing insights and operational support.



All hiring decisions are made based on human review and judgment. You may have the right to request human review, provide additional information, or raise questions about how such tools are used.


**Culture**  

At Pegasystems, we foster an environment where people feel valued and empowered to contribute their best. With global clients across industries and regions, we know our success depends on the unique perspectives, experiences, and talents of our people. Ours is a workplace where everyone can grow, collaborate, and deliver meaningful outcomes.



We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and experiences and focus on the core competencies and mindset needed to thrive in a role.



As an Equal Opportunity employer, Pegasystems will not discriminate in its employment practices due to an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, veteran or disability status, or any other category protected by law.



This same mindset shapes how we work, encouraging curiosity, continuous learning, and smarter ways of working with AI. At Pegasystems, we believe the best ideas come from curious people who embrace change, learn continuously, and use AI to work smarter and move faster. Guided by our values, we bring a growth mindset to every challenge and create lasting impact together.


**Export Compliance**  

For positions requiring access to technical data subject to export control regulations such as this, Pegasystems may need to obtain export license approval from the U.S. Government and EU Authorities for certain individuals.


**Accommodations**  

If you require reasonable accommodations under the Americans with Disabilities Act (US only) or comparable regional regulations in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please contact us here or contact (US only) 1\-888\-PEGA\-NOW and/or 225 Wyman Street Waltham, MA 02451 ATTN: Benefits.

 :

* Co\-ordination between R\&D, QC, manufacturing site and Global Purchase operations in device evaluation, finalization

* Lead the discussion with Legal, GPO, R\&D, manufacturing and CMOs on CDA/NDA, development agreement and supply agreement.
* Identify potential risks and critical path activities that can affect the program, and flag them to appropriate stakeholders for mitigation.



**End to end handling of Global program:** 



* Lead cross\-functional biosimilar programs involving R\&D, CMC, Analytical, Clinical, Regulatory, Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Commercial functions.
* Develop and manage integrated program plans, timelines, budgets, and risk registers.
* Track milestones across cell line development, process development, comparability, clinical studies, and regulatory filings.
* Ensure program delivery in line with agreed scope, timelines, cost, and quality objectives.
* Act as the primary interface between functional teams and senior leadership.
* Drive program governance through core team meetings, stage gate reviews, and executive updates.
* Resolve cross\-functional dependencies and proactively manage conflicts, constraints, and resource risks.
* Ensure alignment with global biosimilars strategy and portfolio priorities.

* Support planning for global submissions (e.g., BLA, MAA) including data readiness and submission sequencing.
* Align development plans with target market access and commercialization timelines.

f5bd7f44.description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for
 *all* 
 .**
 Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
   

  

 Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.
   

  

 For more than 45 years, Micron Technology, Inc. has redefined innovation with the world’s most advanced memory and semiconductor technologies. We’re an international team of visionaries and scientists, developing groundbreaking technologies that are transforming how the world uses information to enrich life.
   

  

 As a Manager Projects/operations, you will Drive execution efficiency, across the IP Dev projects, develop executive\-ready presentations and documentation, sending out status \& accomplishments reports, managing special projects and supporting senior staff. Candidate should be able to develop flows enhancing project management efficiency using industry leading AI tools or developing scripts.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Drive the project management/execution for IP Dev projects.**
* Initiating the project, planning, and outlining project scope, objectives, and deliverables.
* Establishing and maintaining communication with the project team, management, and stakeholders
* Coordinating project meetings and decision\-making processes
* Executing the work, coordinating and supervising the project team and ensuring that they have the tools required for delivering the project on time
* Completing the project and creating required documentation and reports for the management
* Drive special projects chosen as highest priority for alignment across organizations and overall product time to market.
* Develop, coordinate, and sustain top\-level organizational objectives with regular report\-outs to senior leaders.
* Implement and oversee key metrics to ensure deliverables are achieved and have desired impact.
* Promote collaboration, drive deliverable execution.
* Lead and develop executive\-ready presentations, team highlights/low\-light summaries, objective summaries, and all\-team communications.
* AI proficiency is a must \- candidate should be able to develop flows enhancing project management efficiency,
* Leveraging Artificial Intelligence.


**About Micron Technology, Inc.**
 We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life
 *for all* 
 . With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high\-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.
   

  

 To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
   

  

 To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact hrsupport\_india@micron.com
   

  

 Micron Prohibits the use of child labor and complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and other international and industry labor standards.
   

  

 Micron does not charge candidates any recruitment fees or unlawfully collect any other payment from candidates as consideration for their employment with Micron.

 Candidates are encouraged to use AI tools to enhance their resume and/or application materials. However, all information provided must be accurate and reflect the candidate's true skills and experiences. Misuse of AI to fabricate or misrepresent qualifications will result in immediate disqualification.

de8ec405.title: Presales Consultant / Solutioning Lead - Mining (Engineering Services)
de8ec405.description:
**Role Overview** 




 Senior Manager Presales acts as the bridge between customer business challenges and the technical solutions that address them. This role is responsible for driving solution strategy, shaping customer engagements, developing compelling proposals, and positioning value\-driven engineering services solutions within the Mining \& Energy industry.
 



 The Presales Consultant will partner closely with Sales, Delivery, Domain SMEs, and Solution Architects to understand customer requirements, identify business drivers, and create differentiated solutions that align with customers' operational and strategic objectives.
 



 This role requires a strong combination of industry expertise, solutioning capability, proposal management experience, commercial acumen, and executive\-level stakeholder engagement skills.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Customer Engagement \& Discovery** 



* Engage with prospective customers to understand business objectives, operational challenges, and transformation priorities.
* Lead customer discovery workshops, requirement gathering sessions, and solution discussions.
* Analyze customer pain points and translate them into solution opportunities.
* Build trusted advisor relationships with customer stakeholders, including engineering, operations, digital, and executive leadership teams.



**Solution Development \& Architecture** 



* Develop end\-to\-end solution strategies aligned with customer business outcomes.
* Collaborate with solution architects, technical SMEs, delivery teams, and business units to create winning solutions.
* Design innovative service offerings across:
* Engineering Services
* Digital Engineering
* Asset Management
* Smart Mining
* Energy Transition Solutions
* Plant Engineering
* Industrial Automation
* AI/Analytics Applications
* Remote Operations Centers
* Sustainability and ESG initiatives
* Ensure technical feasibility, scalability, risk assessment, and delivery readiness of proposed solutions.



**Proposal Management \& RFP Response** 



* Lead end\-to\-end proposal development activities for RFP, RFQ, RFI, and bid responses.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to develop compelling technical and commercial proposals.
* Develop executive summaries, solution narratives, value propositions, assumptions, effort estimations, and pricing inputs.
* Own proposal governance, compliance requirements, and submission timelines.
* Ensure proposals clearly map customer requirements to organizational capabilities and differentiators.



**Commercial \& Financial Analysis** 



* Develop business cases supporting proposed solutions.
* Perform:
* ROI Analysis
* Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Analysis
* Cost Modeling
* Pricing Strategy Development
* Risk Evaluation
* Support leadership teams with Go/No\-Go assessments and opportunity qualification.



**Sales Support \& Deal Enablement** 



* Partner with Sales teams throughout the opportunity lifecycle.
* Support customer presentations, solution walkthroughs, and executive briefings.
* Participate in customer negotiations and commercial discussions where required.
* Create persuasive collateral including:
* Solution Presentations
* Capability Decks
* Case Studies
* Value Propositions
* Competitive Positioning Documents



**Market Intelligence \& Practice Development** 



* Track industry trends across Mining and Energy sectors.
* Analyze competitor offerings and develop strategic differentiators.
* Contribute to reusable solution assets, proposal repositories, accelerators, and best practices.
* Support creation of industry\-focused go\-to\-market strategies and offerings.



**Required Experience and Personal Attributes** 



* 12\-16 years of Presales, Solutioning, Bid Management, Proposal Development, or Consulting experience.
* Strong experience supporting Mining in Engineering Services environments.
* Proven experience in responding to large\-scale RFPs/RFIs/RFQs.
* Experience in creating solution architectures and transformation roadmaps.
* Demonstrated success in supporting large strategic pursuits and revenue growth initiatives.
* Experience working with geographically distributed teams and global customers.



**Domain Knowledge** 




 Strong understanding of one or more of the following:
 



 Mining
 


* Mine Planning \& Operations
* Asset Performance Management
* Autonomous Mining Technologies
* Mineral Processing
* Operational Excellence Programs
* Mine Digitization



 Energy
 


* Oil \& Gas
* Renewables
* Utilities
* Power Generation
* Transmission \& Distribution
* Energy Transition Programs



 Engineering Services
 


* Plant Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering
* Electrical Systems
* Instrumentation \& Control
* Product Engineering
* Digital Engineering
* Industrial IoT
* AI \& Analytics Applications



 Desired Skills \& Competencies
 



 Business Skills
 


* Consultative Selling
* Strategic Thinking
* Customer Engagement
* Stakeholder Management
* Executive Communication
* Negotiation Skills
* Commercial Awareness



 Presales Skills
 


* Solution Design
* Proposal Management
* Bid Coordination
* Estimation and Pricing
* Value Engineering
* Business Case Development
* Workshop Facilitation



 Technical Skills
 


* Engineering Services Solutioning
* Digital Transformation
* Industrial Automation
* Cloud and Data Platforms
* Asset Management Solutions
* Enterprise Systems Integration
* AI/ML and Analytics Concepts

dcaa6694.title: Google Cloud Generative AI Engineer (Vertex AI & Agentic AI)
dcaa6694.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated **Google Cloud Generative AI Engineer** with 4\-5 years of experience in designing, developing, and deploying AI\-powered applications on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on expertise in **Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), Vertex AI, Gemini models, LLM integration, RAG architectures, and cloud\-native application development**. This role involves building scalable AI solutions, intelligent agents, and enterprise\-grade GenAI applications that drive business innovation.


Key Responsibilities


* Build and implement Generative AI applications leveraging **Vertex AI, Gemini models, Agent Builder, and other Google AI services**.
* Design, develop, and deploy AI agents and multi\-agent systems using **Google Agent Development Kit (ADK)**.
* Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and third\-party systems.
* Develop orchestration workflows for autonomous, conversational, and task\-driven AI agents.
* Implement **Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)** solutions using vector databases and enterprise knowledge sources.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, and product teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable AI solutions.
* Optimize prompts, agent behavior, context management, and model performance to improve business outcomes.
* Ensure adherence to security, compliance, governance, and responsible AI practices.

75efd000.title: Solution Architect
75efd000.description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  

  

  

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**
  

  

  

 Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost\-to\-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise\-grade yet easy\-to\-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.
   

  

  

  

**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**



**Job Description**

 Solution Architect (SA) role is a critical internally and externally\-facing role within Freshworks Professional Services (FPS) which acts the senior technical SME heavily involved in Sales, Delivery and Expansion phases of the customer lifecycle.
   

  





 FPS SA is a trusted advisor internally and externally working with the highest level functional and technical resources within Freshworks and the customer organizations to translate business outcome requirements into scalable solutions.
   

  





**Your role and responsibilities:**



* During the Sales cycle, FPS SA will work closely with the Freshworks Presales team to understand a prospects pain points and solutions discussed to address them, and then directly interacts with the prospects leadership and functional owners to devise the best implementation approach for the identified solutions in line with industry and FPS best practices.
* During the Delivery phase, FPS SA will be the key resource who translates the high\-level solution provided during the sales cycle into detailed design information to meet the customer’s objectives and also for the FPS technical resources to implement the final solution.
* In the Expansion phase, FPS SA will work with the customer to adjust or expand their deployed capabilities by adjusting their implemented solutions to the customer’s updated needs and organizational changes.



**Some of the specific SA deliverables and activities are:**



* Product Champion: Act as a product leader in the region, instilling confidence in prospects during the sales cycle, devising innovative solutions during implementation, assessing existing enterprise customer health for improvement suggestions, and providing valuable customer feedback to the product team.
* Solution Design: Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and develop custom Freshworks product solutions in line with business goals and industry standards. Create architecture diagrams for proposed designs and deliver presentations.
* Technical Implementation: Configure, customize, and deploy Freshworks products, encompassing workflows, automation, integrations, and reporting.
* AI and Automation Solutioning: Identify opportunities for prospects and customers to leverage AI, automation, and agentic capabilities to achieve measurable business outcomes. Advise customers on the data readiness, governance, security, accuracy, adoption, and operational ownership required to successfully deploy and manage AI\-enabled solutions.
* Process Optimization: Identify areas for enhancement, proposing efficient solutions to improve operational efficiency.

1adeb084.title: Sr. Lead - Cloud Engineer
1adeb084.description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Sr. Lead \- Cloud Foundations Engineer**
==========================================


We are seeking a Sr. Lead \- Cloud Foundations Engineer to design, build, and maintain the core cloud infrastructure and shared services that enable our development and business teams to operate securely, reliably, and efficiently in the cloud. This role focuses on establishing the landing zones, automation, governance, and operational guardrails that form the foundation for all cloud workloads.


As a Cloud Foundations Engineer, you will work across multiple teams to ensure that our cloud environments follow best practices for security, scalability, automation, and cost optimization, while enabling self\-service adoption by application teams.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Cloud Platform Engineering**


	+ Design, implement, and maintain enterprise landing zones and shared cloud services.
	+ Manage account/subscription structures across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
	+ Build and enforce secure\-by\-default infrastructure patterns.
* **Infrastructure as Code \& Automation**


	+ Develop and maintain reusable IaC modules (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, or Pulumi).
	+ Build CI/CD pipelines to automate infrastructure deployment and updates.
	+ Enable self\-service provisioning capabilities for development teams.
* **Security, Governance \& Compliance**


	+ Implement identity and access management (IAM) best practices.
	+ Configure and maintain guardrails such as policies, SCPs, and monitoring controls.
	+ Ensure compliance with regulatory and internal security standards.
* **Networking \& Connectivity**


	+ Design and support VPC/VNet architectures, routing, firewalls, VPNs, and interconnects.
	+ Establish hybrid connectivity solutions with on\-premises environments.
* **Observability \& Cost Optimization**


	+ Deploy monitoring, logging, and auditing tools across the environment.
	+ Build dashboards to track cloud performance, security posture, and costs.
	+ Recommend and implement cost\-saving measures.
* **Collaboration \& Enablement**


	+ Partner with application, DevOps, and security teams to ensure smooth cloud adoption.
	+ Provide documentation, best practices, and training to engineering teams.
	+ Participate in incident response and troubleshooting when foundational services are impacted.

### **Qualifications**

* Education \& Experience


	+ Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
	+ 12\+ years of total work experience in Technology Infrastructure.
	+ 8\+ years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure, or platform operations.
* Technical Skills


	+ Deep expertise in at least one major cloud provider (Azure and AWS).
	+ Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) — Terraform preferred.
	+ Hands\-on knowledge of networking concepts (VPC, DNS, firewalls, load balancing, hybrid connectivity).
	+ Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, etc.).
	+ Familiarity with cloud security principles and compliance frameworks.
	+ Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Bash, PowerShell).
* Soft Skills


	+ Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting abilities, cross\-functional collaboration skills.
	+ Excellent communication, mentorship, and ability to influence cross\-functional teams.
	+ Demonstrated ability to lead technically without direct authority.
	+ Ability to balance governance requirements with developer productivity.

### **Preferred Skills (Nice\-to\-Have)**

* Experience operating cloud platforms in regulated enterprise environments.
* Experience with multi\-cloud environments.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration (EKS, AKS, GKE).
* Knowledge of service mesh, API Gateways, or Serverless Platforms.
* Background in FinOps (cloud cost optimization practices).
* Cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect, GCP Professional Cloud Architect).

### **Success Measures**

* Stable, secure, and scalable cloud foundation adopted across teams.
* Improved developer productivity through reusable frameworks and standards.
* Strong technical mentorship and uplift of data engineering capabilities.
* Reduced onboarding time and operational friction for application teams.
* Improved security posture and audit outcomes.
* Recognized as a trusted technical authority within the Cloud Foundation domain.

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  

  



  

**About Our Pune Office**

  

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

  

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

 Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry\-leading climate\-control solutions.  The Lead Architect owns the end\-to\-end technical design of enterprise applications built on Java and the Spring ecosystem. * Optimize application performance, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and continuously improving system reliability.
* Mentor architects and senior developers while fostering collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence.
* Promote knowledge sharing through technical documentation, architecture artifacts, workshops, and training sessions.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate their applicability to improve business outcomes and engineering capabilities


**Qualifications**
* 10–12 years of experience in enterprise application development, with at least 3\+ years in a Solution Architect or Technical Lead role.

* Strong knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and database design principles.
* Familiarity with front\-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like React.
* Experience with Git and modern software development workflows.
* Experience implementing DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and cloud\-native deployment patterns.
* Hands\-on experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) and SLO/SLA definition.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions aligned with enterprise architecture.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across engineering teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership.
* Ability to influence technical decisions and drive architectural governance across multiple teams.

8f4c6442.description:
**We're hiring a Senior Solutions Engineer (Presales) at Zenskar 🚀** 




 If you'd rather open the product and build the thing than talk around it, this is your role.
 



 You'll be the technical voice on our biggest deals, sitting across from CFOs, finance leaders, and engineering teams. You'll run discovery, build demos on real customer scenarios, design integrations, and own the technical win alongside the AE.
 



 This is hands\-on. You'll write SQL, poke at REST APIs, map data flows, and configure Zenskar to prove it works before the deal closes.
 



 What you'll do:
 


* Run technical discovery with finance, RevOps, and engineering stakeholders. Understand their billing model, usage data, and rev rec requirements before anyone talks about features.
* Partner with Sales on live demos, sandbox setups, and RFP responses, tied to the prospect's real scenario, not a generic tour.
* Design the integration: map how usage flows from Postgres, Snowflake, or a warehouse into Zenskar, and flag idempotency and reconciliation risks early.
* Own the technical win: qualify the deal, multi\-thread to the CFO, and de\-risk the build so nothing breaks post\-sale.
* Prepare business cases and RFP responses that tie capability to a dollar saved or a risk removed.
* Feed structured patterns from discovery back to Product and Engineering.



 What we're looking for:
 


* 5\+ years total experience, with meaningful time in a hands\-on technical role: solutions/sales engineering, forward\-deployed engineering, data engineering, or backend/integrations work.
* Comfortable with real SQL (group by, window functions, date logic) and have built or debugged REST API integrations.
* Vendor\-side B2B SaaS experience, ideally billing, payments, fintech, ERP, or data\-infrastructure adjacent.
* Client\-facing experience in a technical capacity: discovery, PoCs, demos, or implementation calls.
* You can hold a credible conversation with a CFO and an engineer on the same day.
* Willing to work US\-overlap hours (roughly 6:00 PM to 2:00 AM IST, weekdays) to cover US afternoons.
* A sense of humor helps. We're building something hard, and that's more fun with people who don't take themselves too seriously.



 Details: 📍 Hybrid, 2 days/week (Tue, Thu) — Indiranagar, Bengaluru
 



 💰 Competitive \+ meaningful ESOPs in a fast\-growing Series A startup
 



 About Zenskar: We're building Zero\-Touch Finance, AI\-native billing and revenue automation for B2B SaaS companies.
 



 Know someone who fits? Tag them, or send your resume our way.
 



 \#Hiring \#SolutionsEngineer \#Presales \#Bengaluru \#SaaS \#B2B \#Zenskar

By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to life\-changing innovations that impact billions of people worldwide.
   

  

 The Solution Architect is responsible for translating the client’s business requirements into specific systems, applications, or process designs for very large complex technology solutions and architectures. You’ll act as an advocate for the client as the ultimate authority on the architecture designed to address client business problems. You’ll provide direction for design activities, often project\-based, sometimes working at customer sites.
   

  

 As a Solution Architect you’ll gather customer/partner insights from a broad range of stakeholders to shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of projects. You’ll define and document the architecture to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Collaborating with the Project Manager you’ll jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use. This role is flexible in that you can work up to 50% from home.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 Responsibilities \-

Expertise in security controls such as encryption, AuthN/AuthZ Expertise in Zero\-Trust framework, Secure by Default design, Identity and Access Management (IAM), cloud security architecture, compliance standards, threat modeling, DevSecOps, continuous security improvement. Knowledge of the least privilege access, assume breach, micro\-segmentation, continuous monitoring and validation, strong authentication, endpoint security, automated security testing (SAST and DAST), secure CI/CD practices.Expertise with Tools such as Azure Sentinel, Splunk, Microsoft Threat Modeling Tool, Microsoft Defender for Cloud.Experience in Open\-source technologies and frameworks are an added plus. Prior experience in Cloud migration, Java, AWS or Google cloud is a definite plus. 6eaeefdd.description:

 AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and committed support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
   

  

 Are you excited to work with the team that enables India’s leading Fintech organisations to build innovative services with AWS, scaling to serve billion\+ Indians? The FSI team in AWS India is looking for a Solutions Architect who can work with our customers who have built new business models on the foundations of payment infrastructure like UPI, widespread 4G internet access, affordable smartphones, exploding digital content, identity infrastructure like Aadhar and world class cloud infrastructure.
   

  

 Your broad responsibilities will include: owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, and developing a deep expertise in the AWS technologies as well as broad know\-how around how applications and services are constructed using the AWS platform. An ideal candidate will have owned the architecture and designed IT systems deployed at scale, have worked as a part of Centre of Excellence, Innovation Centres etc. to investigate adoption of new technologies, have experience with multiple technologies, patterns and frameworks; and is able to figure out trade\-offs between them, be hands\-on, and can roll up their sleeves should need be to do Proof of Concepts and demonstrate technologies.  The ideal candidate will possess customer facing skills that will allow them to represent Amazon Web Services India Pvt Ltd. (AWS India) well within a customer environment and drive discussions with senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables them to easily interact and give guidance to software developers and architects in India. S/he should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges.
   

  

 \#aws\-ags\-India

 The selected candidate will work with Fintech customers to map/model business requirements \& user access patterns to technology \& performance requirement: compare between various design patterns: discern between variety of data technologies (RDBMS, NoSQL) \& compute technology \- servers, container, and serverless, design for required scaling, high availability goals, while minimizing the cost \& meeting security requirements: design Disaster Recovery solutions for required RTO/RPO: Advise on building DevOps pipelines \& process : advise on monitoring Infrastructure \& Applications using AWS technologies such as CloudWatch, ELK Stack, Conduct Well Architected Reviews, partner with AWS Specialists in areas like AI, Analytics, Media etc. to implement innovative solutions, collaborate with the Service Teams to identify feature gaps suggest new features \& present to Technical communities and customer C\-Suite on Architecture Patterns, Best practices, Case Studies.

e7a89c3d.title: Business Solutions Lead Architect
e7a89c3d.description:
**Company Profile**
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)** 
 Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry\-leading climate\-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Lead Architect owns the end\-to\-end technical design of enterprise applications built on Java and the Spring ecosystem. The role combines hands\-on architecture of cloud\-ready, event\-driven microservices with technical leadership across the software development lifecycle \- setting standards, mentoring engineers, driving engineering excellence and ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with business goals. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and business stakeholders, to deliver innovative and future\-proof solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end architecture for assigned systems, from solution design through detailed component, integration, and deployment architecture.
* Translate business and product requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions while collaborating closely with business, product, and delivery teams.
* Define and maintain architectural standards, best practices, governance frameworks, and technical roadmaps.
* Ensure non\-functional requirements including performance, scalability, security, availability, resilience, and fault tolerance are incorporated into all solutions.
* Design and oversee the development of Java\-based, cloud\-ready microservices using Spring Boot, REST APIs, and event\-driven architectures.
* Provide architectural guidance to development teams and ensure implementation aligns with the approved architecture.
* Partners with product and delivery leads to estimate effort, sequence work, and manage architectural dependencies and technical risks.
* Lead the development of new features, enhancements, and modernization initiatives across the application landscape.
* Participate in and provide technical leadership throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and support).
* Conduct architecture and code reviews to ensure compliance with coding standards, security guidelines, and quality best practices.
* Drive engineering excellence through Agile architecture, DevSecOps practices, CI/CD automation, and cloud adoption.
* Optimize application performance, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and continuously improving system reliability.
* Mentor architects and senior developers while fostering collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence.
* Promote knowledge sharing through technical documentation, architecture artifacts, workshops, and training sessions.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate their applicability to improve business outcomes and engineering capabilities


**Qualifications**
* 10–12 years of experience in enterprise application development, with at least 3\+ years in a Solution Architect or Technical Lead role.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise\-scale, distributed applications and microservices.
* Strong expertise in Java SE/EE and Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security).
* Proficiency in Java as the primary language, with working knowledge of Python or JavaScript as an advantage.
* Experience designing RESTful APIs, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and integration using SOAP where required.
* Experience with messaging platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ and API Gateway technologies.
* Strong knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and database design principles.
* Familiarity with front\-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like React.
* Experience with Git and modern software development workflows.
* Experience implementing DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and cloud\-native deployment patterns.
* Hands\-on experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) and SLO/SLA definition.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions aligned with enterprise architecture.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across engineering teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership.
* Ability to influence technical decisions and drive architectural governance across multiple teams.

67d3ba6e.title: Solution Architect - ITS, IT/ITES Vertical
67d3ba6e.description:
**Description**
 Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
   

  

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 AWS Solutions Architects are trusted advisors to our customers, helping them solve some of their largest business challenges by designing and advising on some of the most scalable, flexible and resilient solutions in the world.
   

  

 Working closely with internal teams at AWS, you’ll identify how our customers push the boundaries and how we can improve our services to obsess over our customers.
   

  

 Being a thought leader who creates and presents content you’ll help all of our customers scale and grow in non\-linear ways, using AWS as their building blocks.
   

  

 In this role, you will push technology boundaries and help scale some of the Emerging companies across various Verticals in India. You will have the opportunity to partner with customers early in their cloud journey and help them scale as well as customers further in their cloud journey where you can have visible and measurable impact in their growth ambitions.
   

  

 You will test traditional thinking by pushing the boundaries for your customers and AWS to dream and deliver beyond what they think is possible.
   

  

 Our customers’ needs are moving fast, so you will too. Be part of the team helping our Emergin customers find innovative and transformative ways to reinvent their business!
   

  

 \#aws\-ags\-India
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Work directly with customers to accelerate their business outcomes and recommend best\-practice cloud architectures in line with their long\-term business needs.
   

  

* Drive technical solutions discussions with your customers, diving deep into the details to solve complex technical problems and use your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures.
* Scope and own customer engagements, with attention towards clear and well\-defined objectives and success criteria.
* Work backwards from your customer's business needs to accelerate adoption of the most appropriate AWS technology
* Define and execute on the strategy by engaging highly technical teams (Solutions Architects, Technical Account Managers, AWS professional services consultants and consulting/managed services partners).
* Act as a thought leader in the wider community, playing a key role in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops.
* Share the voice of the customer to influence the roadmap of new features and services for the AWS platform. Proactively work within the organisation to influence the evolution of the platform.
* Serve as a key technical member of the Solutions Architecture team through influencing decision makers across multiple domains to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the AWS platform which align to long\-term business goals.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Our solutions architects are experienced technologists with technical breadth and depth coupled with strong interpersonal skills. The variety of customers is huge as we work across all industries within the SMB segment, like FSI, Retail , IT\& ITeS , Media and Entertainment to name a few. On a daily basis you will work alongside people who are leading the way in designing cloud bases architecture. We are the trusted advisor to our customers, so challenge our customers to think differently, learn more build elegant, transformative solutions!
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. To do this they collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, support, product teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of cloud architecture
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 7\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* 7\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience

 ECS/Fargate · PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB · Redis · MQTT · Kafka/MSK · GitHub Actions · CloudWatch · OpenTelemetry · Prometheus · Grafana
 



  





 Experience with IoT, SCADA or renewable energy systems is a bonus, but not required.
 



  





**How we use AI** 




  





 Peryx is an AI\-native engineering company. We expect engineers to use AI tools for implementation, debugging, testing and documentation where they help move faster.
 



  





 AI tools will be provided by us. What matters is that you understand, validate and take responsibility for what you ship.
 



  





**How we work** 




  





 We're a small engineering team, so you'll work directly with the founders and developers and have meaningful ownership of the infrastructure you build.
 



  





 We value people who can understand a problem, make sensible technical decisions, build the solution and operate it reliably.
 



  





**Apply** 




  





 Send your CV to careers@peryx.ai along with a short note about one cloud or infrastructure system you've personally built or operated, what you were responsible for, and one interesting problem you had to solve.
