b69e1c10.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description – Manager (Cloud AI Platform Architect)**
**Experience:** 
 10–13 years
   

  

**Role Overview:**
 The Manager will play a pivotal role in building and scaling EY GDS's AI Strategy \& Transformation practice. This leadership role combines hands\-on cloud and AI platform architect expertise with consulting excellence, driving end\-to\-end AI platform implementation, infrastructure modernization and enterprise deployment programs while managing senior client relationships and CxO engagements. The position demands deep technical implementation skills in AI platform and infrastructure engineering, multi\-cloud architecture, automation and deployment engineering, MLOps enablement and operationalization of AI workloads alongside proven program leadership across industries like BFSI, manufacturing and regulated sectors.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* AI Platform \& Infrastructure Engineering and Architecture Leadership
+ Lead the design and implementation of enterprise AI platforms that support AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI and RAG workloads across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments.
+ Architect scalable cloud\-native AI foundations using AWS SageMaker and Bedrock, Azure ML and Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI and enterprise Kubernetes platforms such as EKS, AKS and GKE.
+ Build secure and resilient infrastructure for AI model development, training, deployment and runtime operations including compute, GPU environments, storage, networking, secrets management and access control.
+ Design reusable platform services for model hosting, inference endpoints, vector databases, prompt orchestration, agent runtime support and enterprise API integration.
+ Establish platform observability with centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, telemetry, performance diagnostics and cost optimization for AI systems.
+ Enable secure AI platform controls with policy enforcement, access governance, auditability and support for Responsible AI, compliance and risk requirements.
+ Drive standardization of AI platform architecture through reusable patterns, landing zones, environment templates and enterprise engineering best practices.


* Client \& Stakeholder Management
+ Serve as primary technical advisor to CxOs, account leadership teams and enterprise engineering stakeholders on AI platform strategy, cloud modernization and deployment architecture.
+ Conduct technical workshops demonstrating platform blueprints, deployment models, MLOps capabilities, observability approaches and AI operational readiness.
+ Bridge platform engineering with business strategy by translating complex infrastructure capabilities into scalable business outcomes and delivery roadmaps.
+ Build trusted relationships through hands\-on PoC delivery, architecture discussions and strategic guidance on AI platform adoption


* Cloud, Automation \& Deployment Engineering Leadership
+ Lead automation of AI infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates and CloudFormation.
+ Design and implement CI/CD and CT pipelines for AI platforms, model deployment services, APIs, microservices and environment lifecycle management.
+ Drive containerization and orchestration patterns using Docker and Kubernetes including workload isolation, autoscaling, high availability and release automation.
+ Build deployment frameworks for AI and GenAI applications using REST services, FastAPI, model serving frameworks, serverless patterns and integration middleware.
+ Automate configuration management, secrets handling, policy validation, artifact promotion and environment provisioning across dev, test and production landscapes.
+ Implement release engineering practices including blue\-green deployment, canary rollout, rollback mechanisms and platform upgrade planning.
+ Ensure platform reliability, scalability and supportability through automated testing, operational runbooks, resilience engineering and incident readiness.


* MLOps, Data Pipelines \& Operationalization Leadership
+ Lead the setup and scaling of MLOps and LLMOps capabilities including experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry, artifact management, pipeline orchestration and deployment governance.
+ Establish standardized operationalization pipelines for model training, validation, packaging, deployment, monitoring and retraining across enterprise AI use cases.
+ Drive integration of AI platforms with batch and real\-time data pipelines using Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks and cloud\-native data services.
+ Design and govern reliable data flows for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, feature engineering, feature store integration, vector store enablement and metadata lineage.
+ Implement monitoring for models and services covering drift detection, latency, throughput, failure diagnostics and service\-level performance.
+ Collaborate closely with data science, AI engineering and application teams to productionize prototypes, notebooks and GenAI use cases into enterprise\-grade deployments.
+ Drive operational best practices around reproducibility, traceability, auditability and support for regulated or risk\-sensitive environments.


* Asset and Accelerator Development
+ Lead creation of EY IP including AI platform reference architectures, reusable IaC modules, deployment blueprints, MLOps templates and observability accelerators.
+ Develop reusable frameworks for secure AI environment setup, platform monitoring dashboards, model deployment factories and RAG infrastructure enablement.
+ Package technical accelerators as EY market offerings for rapid client deployment across industries and cloud ecosystems.


* Business Development \& GTM Initiatives
+ Lead technical solutioning for AI platform transformation RFPs including architecture blueprints, deployment approaches, cloud landing patterns and live PoC demonstrations.
+ Develop industry\-specific GTM strategies that combine EY assets with hyperscaler AI platform services and enterprise automation capabilities.
+ Collaborate with sales teams to position EY as a trusted partner for AI platform engineering, cloud AI operationalization and secure enterprise AI deployment.


* Program Governance \& Delivery Excellence
+ Oversee end\-to\-end AI platform transformation programs from infrastructure discovery through production deployment, operational handover and value realization.
+ Manage cross\-functional delivery teams including cloud engineers, platform engineers, ML engineers, DevOps specialists and data engineers across multiple workstreams.
+ Ensure technical excellence, risk mitigation and KPI achievement in complex enterprise AI platform and deployment programs.


* Practice Development \& Team Leadership
* 
+ Mentor consultants and seniors in AI platform engineering, cloud architecture, automation practices and MLOps operationalization across the broader EY GDS AI practice.
+ Lead technical recruitment and capability building for cloud AI platform engineering excellence.
+ Drive innovation PoCs showcasing enterprise AI platforms, scalable GenAI deployment models, advanced observability and sovereign AI infrastructure capabilities.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**
**Education:**
* B.Tech/B.E. (Computer Science / IT / AI / ML mandatory); M.Tech / MS in Cloud Computing, AI, Data Engineering or Machine Learning (preferred).


**Core Technical Expertise (Hands\-on Implementation Required):**
* AI Platform \& Infrastructure Engineering: Strong hands\-on experience in designing and managing enterprise AI platforms, model hosting environments, inference systems, vector database infrastructure, API\-based AI services and secure runtime environments.
* Cloud Platforms: Deep expertise in AWS, Azure and GCP with focus on AI and infrastructure services such as SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, AKS, EKS, GKE, IAM, networking, storage and monitoring.
* Automation \& Deployment Engineering: Strong knowledge of Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Kubernetes, deployment automation, microservices architecture and release engineering.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML pipelines, Vertex AI pipelines, model registry, experiment tracking, model serving, deployment governance and monitoring.
* Data Engineering \& Operationalization: Understanding of ETL and ELT pipelines, Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks, feature stores, streaming and batch processing and production data pipelines for AI workloads.
* Programming \& APIs: Proficiency in Python, shell scripting, YAML, JSON, REST APIs, FastAPI and automation scripting for platform and cloud operations.
* Security \& Governance: Familiarity with platform security, secrets management, policy controls, auditability, observability and support for Responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements.


**AI and Data Science Certifications (Good to have):**
* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate / Azure DevOps Engineer / Azure Solutions Architect
* AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty / AWS DevOps Engineer / AWS Solutions Architect
* Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer / Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer
* Additional: Kubernetes certifications (CKA / CKAD), Terraform Associate, Databricks certifications, MLOps or cloud platform engineering certifications


**Consulting \& Leadership Experience:**
* 10–13 years in cloud platform engineering, AI platform engineering, DevOps, MLOps or AI consulting (Big 4 / tech preferred).
* Proven track record leading enterprise AI platform implementations across BFSI, manufacturing, healthcare or public sector.
* Experience with sovereign AI, regulated industry deployments and multi\-cloud architecture programs.


**Soft Skills:**
* Exceptional technical storytelling for CxO audiences.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders through working prototypes, architecture deep dives and platform transformation roadmaps.
* Leadership of diverse technical teams with clear delivery focus.


**Portfolio Requirements:**
 Hands\-on experience in building production\-grade cloud AI platforms, automated deployment frameworks, MLOps pipelines and enterprise AI infrastructure is mandatory for interview stage.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

98282a96.title: Cloud Platform Architect
98282a96.description:
**Project Role :** 
 Cloud Platform Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Oversee application architecture and deployment in cloud platform environments \-\- including public cloud, private cloud and hybrid cloud. This can include cloud adoption plans, cloud application design, and cloud management and monitoring.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Cloud Design and Build
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 Cloud Strategy and Assessment, Cloud Automation DevOps, Docker Kubernetes Architecture, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Database Architecture
   

  

**Minimum 7\.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 This is not a consulting role or a project delivery role. A Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineer is a production engineer who works embedded inside a client's enterprise, shoulder to shoulder with their teams, to transform legacy infrastructure \& Application estates into AI\-ready, cloud/Hybrid platforms and Modernized Infrastructure. You own outcomes: time\-to\-value, reliability, adoption, and scalability. Not delivery milestones. Outcomes.
   

  

 The Role expects the expertise to build cloud including Data and AI foundations that is secure \& scalable and responsive — designing AI Infrastructure architectures including Compute, Data, Networking and security aspects leveraging Hybrid cloud models.
   

  

 Accenture's Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineers operate at the intersection of engineering depth and business reinvention. This is where the most complex enterprise infrastructure challenges get solved — not in a lab, but inside real client environments, with real constraints, at real scale.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Embed directly with client infrastructure and engineering teams to design, execute, and operationalize end\-to\-end transformation — spanning cloud foundation, hyperconverged infrastructure, platform engineering, application modernization, database transformation, SAP, network and security, and AI platform deployment — inside real enterprise environments
* Accountable for production outcomes — platform reliability, time\-to\-value, adoption, and scalability — measured against business metrics, not project milestones.
* Move from ambiguous infrastructure problems to working production environment through rapid iteration: days to validated architecture, weeks to production\-ready deployment.
* Execute application migration hands\-on — rehost (lift \& shift), re\-platform (lift \& optimize), and redeploy — applying the right strategy per workload to land on an AI\-ready, modernized target platform.
* Architect and implement network and security foundations: Zero Trust, SASE/SSE, micro\-segmentation, container security, and application AI governance across enterprise environments.
* Design and govern transformation architectures across the full enterprise stack: compute (HCI/cloud), platform engineering and Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs), Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, network, security, storage, containers, databases, applications, and AI platform layers.
* Build the Data and AI foundation layer: design data architectures for structured and unstructured data deploy the AI platform layer that enables modernized workloads to leverage AI at scale.
* Architect and modernize database estates — relational and NoSQL database migration, schema conversion, performance tuning, and cloud\-native database deployment — as the data layer underpinning the modernized platform.
* Leverage Python end\-to\-end — infrastructure automation, deployment scripting, data pipeline engineering, and AI agent development across the full transformation lifecycle.
* Translate technical architecture into business impact for client CTO, CFO, and CISO shape modernization roadmaps, ROI backlogs, and AI adoption strategy.
* Build reusable patterns, playbooks, and accelerators through architecture workshops, proofs of concept, and code\-with sessions — leaving the client team fully capable of operating, scaling, and extending the platform independently, and codifying learnings that grow the FDE practice


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Engineering Mindset should come in the beginning.
* Minimum 2 years of working experience of AI platform ecosystems — cloud\-native AI services (AWS, Azure, GCP), open\-source model deployment, and the infrastructure layer required to run AI workloads reliably at enterprise scale.
* 3 to 5 years of engineering experience with cloud\-native systems. \& have the ability to deploy and guiding team to deploy AI use cases
* Minimum 1 years of experience designing, deploying and operating AI platforms and infrastructure — model serving environments, AI\-ready compute, data pipelines, and platform integration — in production enterprise environments
* 10\+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, with demonstrable production delivery across cloud platforms, network, Security, Kubernetes, containerization, platform engineering, and enterprise application environments.
* Track record of owning and delivering infrastructure transformation outcomes inside live enterprise environments — not advisory engagements, internal initiatives, vendor labs, or contained team deployments.
* Ability to connect infrastructure decisions to business/financial outcomes — translating platform reliability, migration efficiency, and modernization gains into business impact a CFO would fund and act on.
* Experience presenting to and building trust with senior client stakeholders at CTO, CFO, or CISO level.
* Non\-linear profiles are expected and welcomed — assessment is based on demonstrated delivery experience and outcome ownership, not CV pattern matching.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Flexible to work in 24\*7 environment

**Description**
 Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer\-centric company? If so, come join us at Amazon.
   

  

 ShipTech is the connective tissue, which connects Transportation Service Providers, First Mile, Middle Mile, and Last Mile to facilitate the shipping of billions of packages each year. Due to criticality of the ShipTech systems, world\-wide (WW) Amazon business organizations work with ShipTech every year to deliver their programs for network expansion, operational efficiency improvement, new feature delivery to enhance customer/operator experience, compliance asks, etc. WW requestors submit intakes to deliver: (1\) on\-boarding new shippers, carriers, and services to the shipping network, (2\) facilitating package movement and tracking in Amazon and third\-party (3P) network, (3\) changes in carrier artifacts like a label and manifest, (4\) carrier configurations like routing codes, account ids, and (5\) custom tech\-builds for meeting business specific asks delivered by ShipTech every year (6\) support improvement in the quality of Amazon’s worldwide shipment infrastructure by defining the usage, configuration, and standardization of transportation milestones
   

  

 We are looking for a Program Manager to be a part of our effort to drive program for improving visibility and tracking capabilities for Amazon shipments. Our mission is to be a partner and enabler to Amazon Operations by improving shipment tracking logic and capabilities for different legs of logistics, customer messaging, validation of transportation milestones, enable logic for automated shipment workflows and improve quality of shipment tracking within and outside Amazon partners. This role gives an opportunity to work closely with Business team, Operations stakeholders, Tech teams, recipient experience teams and Senior Leaders to manage and deliver for Amazon businesses.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Drive improvement in worldwide shipment infrastructure by defining the usage, configuration, and standardization of transportation milestones.

d471d149.title: Product Delivery Lead – Finance Engineering
d471d149.description:
**Role** 
**Description**
 Reporting to the Head of Delivery Enablement, this role leads Finance Engineering's transition to a product\-led operating model. It establishes the practical structures, behaviours and engineering practices needed to organise around products, focus on measurable outcomes and improve delivery flow.
   

  

 The Product Delivery Lead works across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Operations and Business teams to translate strategy into outcome\-based roadmaps, remove systemic delivery constraints and enable sustainable ways of working within LSEG's risk and control environment.
   

  

 The emphasis is on hands\-on enablement and organisational change rather than project administration. The role requires a credible foundation in engineering or architecture, together with the judgement and influence to support change at team, platform and leadership levels.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Product\-led Transformation
+ Define and implement the Finance Engineering product operating model, including product boundaries, ownership, decision rights, planning cadences and governance.
+ Move teams from project\- and output\-focused delivery towards persistent product ownership, measurable outcomes and continuous improvement.
+ Pilot new practices with teams, learn from adoption and scale what works without imposing unnecessary standardisation.
+ Build internal capability through coaching, practical guidance and communities of practice
+ Engineering \& Architecture Enablement
+ Partner with Engineering and Architecture leaders to align product roadmaps with technology strategy and platform evolution.
+ Use engineering insight to identify and remove constraints across architecture, dependencies, environments, release, integration and operations.
+ Ensure security, resilience, operability, non\-functional requirements and technical debt are visible in product planning and prioritisation.
+ Promote engineering excellence, DevSecOps and sustainable delivery practices where appropriate.


* Planning, Prioritisation \& Flow
+ Translate product strategy and business priorities into outcome\-based roadmaps and executable plans.
+ Establish pragmatic prioritisation, capacity, dependency, risk and release planning across products and platforms.
+ Coach teams on backlog quality, work decomposition, flow and delivery forecasting.
+ Facilitate cross\-team decisions and remove systemic impediments to delivery.


* Tooling, Data \& Continuous Improvement
+ Define a coherent Jira and Confluence information model, work hierarchy, workflows and reporting that support traceability without creating bureaucracy.
+ Establish balanced measures across outcomes, flow, quality, reliability and engineering effectiveness.
+ Drive adoption of DORA, SPACE and other engineering effectiveness measures.
+ Use quantitative and qualitative insight to identify bottlenecks, test improvements and demonstrate progress.
+ Continuously simplify processes and controls while maintaining required evidence and assurance.


* 
* Leadership \& Stakeholder Influence
+ Advise and coach Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Architects, Delivery Leads and senior stakeholders.
+ Create alignment on roles, accountabilities, priorities and trade\-offs across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Operations and Business.
+ Lead planning and governance forums that drive decisions rather than status reporting.
+ Communicate progress, risks and recommendations clearly at team and executive levels.


 Key Behaviours
   

  

**Major Challenges (The challenges inherent in the role that require a continual test of the role holder’s abilities)**
* Shifting from project\- and output\-led delivery to persistent product ownership and outcome focus while maintaining business commitments.
* Aligning Product, Engineering, Architecture and control functions across complex, interdependent platforms.
* Creating sufficient consistency and transparency without imposing a one\-size\-fits\-all process.
* Influencing sustained change across teams and leaders without relying on direct authority.


**Management of Risk**
* Ensure delivery, technology, operational and transformation risks are visible, owned and actively managed.
* Embed architecture, security, resilience, regulatory and control requirements into planning and delivery.
* Escalate systemic impediments, unresolved decisions and risk concentrations with clear options and recommendations.


**Observation of Internal Controls**
* Comply with organisational policies, governance standards and control frameworks.
* Design delivery practices and tooling that provide proportionate evidence, traceability and clear accountability.


 Candidate Profile / Key Skills
   

  

**Essential**
* A foundation in software engineering, solution or enterprise architecture, or comparable technical leadership, combined with experience leading organisational change.
* Demonstrable experience implementing a product\-led operating model in a complex enterprise, including practical adoption by engineering teams.
* Strong understanding of software delivery and architecture, including the SDLC, APIs and integration, data and platform engineering, cloud, SaaS or ERP, non\-functional requirements, reliability and technical debt.
* Experience shaping product structures, ownership, decision rights, roadmaps, prioritisation, planning and governance.
* Ability to diagnose systemic delivery constraints and improve flow across teams, platforms and dependencies.
* Strong working knowledge of Agile, Lean and Kanban, with sound judgement on when scaled approaches add value.
* Experience designing and governing Jira, Confluence and roadmapping or reporting tools to support usable, traceable delivery data.
* Experience using outcome, flow, quality and engineering measures to guide improvement.
* Experience working in a regulated environment, with an understanding of technology risk and controls.
* Credible communicator and coach, able to influence senior leaders and work effectively with product managers, engineers and architects


**Preferred**
* Experience in Financial Services, Finance Technology or Capital Markets.
* Experience with product or platform modernisation, ERP transformation, data platforms, APIs or enterprise integration.
* Experience establishing internal capability, communities of practice or organisation\-wide change
* Experience leading platform modernisation, ERP transformation or data migration initiatives


**About London Stock Exchange Group**
 LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open\-access partners with a commitment to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years.
   

  

 Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open\-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
   

  

 LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.
   

  

 People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential.
   

  

 We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

Your day might include facilitating a design discussion with our Applied Science team to evaluate trade\-offs in a new catalog enrichment model, then pivoting to align cross\-functional stakeholders on data pipeline architecture for supply chain defect elimination.  Our team collaborates closely with Applied Science, Data Engineering, Finance, Operations, and Retail organizations worldwide. We operate with visibility into senior leadership forums, giving us the opportunity to influence strategy at the highest levels. We're looking for someone who thrives in this complex, multi\-stakeholder environment and can translate ambiguous problems into clear technical solutions. **What You'll Do**
 As an Architecture Sales Specialist, you will serve as the trusted technical and business advisor for your architecture, partnering with account teams to help customers solve complex business challenges through Cisco's technology portfolio.
   

  

 You will work closely with customers, account teams, solution engineers, and cross\-functional stakeholders to develop architecture strategies, shape customer opportunities, and position Cisco as a strategic partner. By combining deep technical expertise with business and industry knowledge, you will influence customer technology decisions, differentiate Cisco from the competition, and accelerate business growth.

* Lead customer discovery sessions to understand business priorities, technical challenges, and digital transformation objectives.
* Position Cisco's architecture solutions by aligning technology capabilities with customer business outcomes.
* Influence technical and business decision\-makers, including IT leaders, Line of Business stakeholders, and executive sponsors.
* Develop compelling solution strategies, business cases, and technical proposals that demonstrate measurable customer value.
* Lead Proof of Concept (PoC) and Proof of Value (PoV) engagements to validate Cisco solutions and accelerate customer adoption.
* Collaborate across Cisco's portfolio teams to develop integrated solutions that address customer requirements across multiple architectures.
* Apply competitive intelligence and market insights to differentiate Cisco solutions and strengthen customer positioning.
* Build architecture\-specific account plans and contribute to long\-term customer technology roadmaps.
* Support complex sales opportunities through technical strategy, solution design, forecasting, and commercial planning.
* Provide customer feedback and market insights to product and engineering teams to influence future product innovation.


**Who You'll Work With**
 You'll collaborate closely with Account Executives, Solution Engineers, Customer Experience, Product Management, Business Units, Partners, and cross\-functional sales teams while engaging directly with customer technical leaders, architects, IT executives, and business decision makers.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 You're a consultative technology sales professional with strong business acumen and deep expertise in your architecture. You enjoy solving complex customer challenges, influencing executive stakeholders, and translating technical capabilities into meaningful business outcomes.
   

  

 You thrive in collaborative environments, enjoy working across multiple teams, and are passionate about helping customers modernize their technology landscape.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree with 8\+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, technical sales, solution consulting, or architecture sales.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience selling enterprise technology solutions within Networking, Security, Collaboration, Cloud, Data Center, Observability, or AI.
* Strong consultative selling, customer discovery, and solution development skills.
* Experience leading technical discussions, workshops, Proof of Concept (PoC), and Proof of Value (PoV) engagements.
* Ability to engage and influence technical leaders, architects, and executive stakeholders.
* Knowledge of competitive technology landscapes and enterprise IT trends.
* Strong understanding of business value, ROI development, and solution positioning.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working collaboratively across sales, engineering, product, and partner organizations.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

**About Tekion**

c33673a7.title: Technical Program Manager – KPI Tracking & Roadmap Execution
c33673a7.description:
**Location:** 

 Pune, India (On\-site)
 




**Company:** 

 Skylark Labs
 



**About Skylark Labs** 


 Skylark Labs is an AI company building next\-generation autonomous intelligence for defense, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Our technology enables cameras, drones, robots, and sensor systems to detect and respond to threats in real time using self\-learning AI. We partner with governments, enterprises, and research institutions worldwide to develop cutting\-edge AI solutions that make environments safer and smarter.
 



**About the Role** 


 Skylark Labs is seeking a highly organized and technically inclined
 
**Technical Program Manager** 

 to drive
 
**engineering roadmap execution, KPI tracking, and cross\-functional program delivery** 

 across multiple engineering initiatives.
 





 This role is focused on ensuring engineering teams execute against strategic priorities by tracking milestones, monitoring key performance indicators, identifying execution risks, and coordinating work across AI/ML, robotics, software, and infrastructure teams. The ideal candidate combines strong technical understanding with exceptional organizational and project management skills and enjoys bringing structure, visibility, and accountability to complex engineering programs.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 
**Roadmap Execution** 
* Own and drive execution of engineering roadmaps across multiple technical teams.
* Translate strategic objectives into actionable milestones, deliverables, and timelines.
* Monitor roadmap progress and proactively identify risks, blockers, and dependencies.
* Coordinate engineering priorities with leadership to ensure alignment with company objectives.
* Ensure projects are delivered on schedule through effective planning and follow\-up.


**KPI Tracking \& Program Management** 
* Define, maintain, and report engineering and product KPIs.
* Build dashboards and recurring executive reports tracking engineering progress.
* Monitor sprint velocity, release timelines, roadmap completion, quality metrics, and team deliverables.
* Track action items, ownership, deadlines, and program health across departments.
* Escalate execution risks and recommend mitigation plans.
* Continuously improve reporting processes and execution visibility.


**Cross\-Functional Coordination** 
* Coordinate work across Engineering, AI/ML, Robotics, Product, DevOps, QA, Business Development, and Leadership.
* Organize technical planning meetings, roadmap reviews, and status updates.
* Ensure teams remain aligned on priorities, dependencies, and delivery schedules.
* Facilitate communication between technical and business stakeholders.


**Technical Program Delivery** 
* Support engineering planning, release management, and milestone tracking.
* Maintain technical documentation, project plans, and execution timelines.

**Job Title: Mainframe Infrastructure Solution Architect \- Presales**
**Location:** 
 Bengaluru / Chennai / Gurgaon / Pune
   

  

**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Mainframe Infrastructure Architect to join our dynamic team. This pivotal role will be responsible for providing technical leadership and strategic guidance throughout the presales cycle, focusing on mainframe solutions and modernization initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical knowledge of mainframe environments, coupled with exceptional communication and presentation skills to articulate complex solutions to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including C\-level executives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Solution Design \& Architecture:
+ Lead the design and definition of overall mainframe infrastructure solutionframeworks for mainframe components within client proposals and bids.
+ Analyze client requirements, existing IT landscapes, and business objectives to architect tailor\-made mainframe solutions, including on\-premise, cloud, and hybrid models.
+ Develop detailed architectural designs, high\-level designs, and associated documentation (e.g., application views, multiple sections \& views, artefacts).
+ Evaluate and recommend solutions to integrate mainframe systems with the broader technology ecosystem.
+ Identify improvements, options, and tradeoffs to define target state solutions.

* Presales \& Client Engagement:
+ Act as the primary technical subject matter expert during the presales phase, supporting the sales team in all technical aspects.
+ Engage directly with clients, including C\-level executives, technical decision\-makers, and business stakeholders, to understand their challenges and demonstrate how our mainframe solutions can address their needs.
+ Develop and deliver compelling technical presentations, demonstrations, and proofs\-of\-concept (POCs).
+ Collaborate with sales, program/project, and consulting teams to ensure proposed solutions align with client expectations and internal capabilities.
+ Participate in the development of RFP/RFS responses, providing technical analysis, cost estimations, and architectural validation.
+ Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.

* Mainframe Modernization \& Innovation:
+ Provide technical and strategic input for mainframe modernization strategies, including re\-hosting, refactoring, re\-platforming, and rewriting initiatives.
+ Guide customers in planning, evaluating, architecting, and re\-engineering legacy applications to leverage modern cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.).
+ Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies (e.g., AI/ML for modernization), and best practices in mainframe and cloud landscapes.
+ Contribute to the development of white papers, case studies, and thought leadership content related to mainframe solutions and modernization.

* Technical Leadership \& Mentorship:
+ Provide technical leadership to design, development, and implementation teams for custom solutions.
+ Mentor developers, designers, and junior architects, fostering their growth and enhancing their capabilities.
+ Contribute to internal architecture practices by conducting interviews and sharing knowledge.

* Costing \& Risk Management:
+ Develop fully costed solution architectures and provide accurate cost estimates for mainframe solution implementation (such as MFaaS) and ongoing support.
+ Identify implementation risks and potential impacts, proposing mitigation strategies.
+ Validate solutions from a technology, cost structure, and customer differentiation perspective.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Typically 12\+ years of experience in a technology environment, with a strong focus on mainframe infrastructure solutions
* Minimum of 5\+ years of hands\-on technical experience with mainframe systems and technologies such as:
+ Languages: COBOL, JCL, PL/I, Assembler, REXX, Natural, RPG.
+ Databases: DB2 for z/OS, IMS DB, VSAM, Adabas.
+ Transaction Managers: CICS, IMS TM.
+ Operating Systems: z/OS, z/VM, zLinux.
+ Middleware: MQ, WebSphere.
+ Tools: IBM Debug Tool for z/OS, Syncsort, SPUFI, ChangeMan, Endevor, CA\-7/ESP/Control\-M (Job Schedulers).

* Proven experience in designing and delivering complex mainframe solutions, including large\-scale migrations and modernizations.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience in architecting solutions for mainframe to cloud migration/integration and tools like Zowe, OpenShift, Wazi
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to diverse audiences.
* Proven presentation skills, comfortable presenting to large groups and executive levels.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
* Willingness to travel as required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer Engineering / relevant
* Experience with specific mainframe modernization tools and patterns (re\-architecture, rewrite, refactor, rehost).
* Familiarity with distributed client\-server architecture systems.
* Exposure to GenAI technologies (LLMs, NLP) for application modernization assessments or code transformation.
* Experience with ITILv3 or ITSM principles.


 IBM Mainframe administration certification

f7523f87.description:
**Project Role :** 
 Cloud Platform Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Oversee application architecture and deployment in cloud platform environments \-\- including public cloud, private cloud and hybrid cloud. This can include cloud adoption plans, cloud application design, and cloud management and monitoring.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Cloud Design and Build
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 Cloud Strategy and Assessment, Cloud Automation DevOps, Docker Kubernetes Architecture, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Database Architecture
   

  

**Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

**Summary**
 This is not a consulting role or a project delivery role. A Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineer is a production engineer who works embedded inside a client's enterprise, shoulder to shoulder with their teams, to transform legacy infrastructure \& Application estates into AI\-ready, cloud/Hybrid platforms and Modernized Infrastructure. You own outcomes: time\-to\-value, reliability, adoption, and scalability. Not delivery milestones. Outcomes.
   

  

 The Role expects the expertise to build cloud including Data and AI foundations that is secure \& scalable and responsive — designing AI Infrastructure architectures including Compute, Data, Networking and security aspects leveraging Hybrid cloud models.
   

  

 Accenture's Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineers operate at the intersection of engineering depth and business reinvention. This is where the most complex enterprise infrastructure challenges get solved — not in a lab, but inside real client environments, with real constraints, at real scale.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Embed directly with client infrastructure and engineering teams to design, execute, and operationalize end\-to\-end transformation — spanning cloud foundation, hyperconverged infrastructure, platform engineering, application modernization, database transformation, SAP, network and security, and AI platform deployment — inside real enterprise environments
* Accountable for production outcomes — platform reliability, time\-to\-value, adoption, and scalability — measured against business metrics, not project milestones.
* Move from ambiguous infrastructure problems to working production environment through rapid iteration: days to validated architecture, weeks to production\-ready deployment.
* Execute application migration hands\-on — rehost (lift \& shift), re\-platform (lift \& optimize), and redeploy — applying the right strategy per workload to land on an AI\-ready, modernized target platform.
* Architect and implement network and security foundations: Zero Trust, SASE/SSE, micro\-segmentation, container security, and application AI governance across enterprise environments.
* Design and govern transformation architectures across the full enterprise stack: compute (HCI/cloud), platform engineering and Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs), Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, network, security, storage, containers, databases, applications, and AI platform layers.
* Build the Data and AI foundation layer: design data architectures for structured and unstructured data deploy the AI platform layer that enables modernized workloads to leverage AI at scale.
* Architect and modernize database estates — relational and NoSQL database migration, schema conversion, performance tuning, and cloud\-native database deployment — as the data layer underpinning the modernized platform.
* Leverage Python end\-to\-end — infrastructure automation, deployment scripting, data pipeline engineering, and AI agent development across the full transformation lifecycle.
* Translate technical architecture into business impact for client CTO, CFO, and CISO shape modernization roadmaps, ROI backlogs, and AI adoption strategy.
* Build reusable patterns, playbooks, and accelerators through architecture workshops, proofs of concept, and code\-with sessions — leaving the client team fully capable of operating, scaling, and extending the platform independently, and codifying learnings that grow the FDE practice


**Professional \& Technical Skills**
* Engineering Mindset should come in the beginning.
* Minimum 2 years of working experience of AI platform ecosystems — cloud\-native AI services (AWS, Azure, GCP), open\-source model deployment, and the infrastructure layer required to run AI workloads reliably at enterprise scale.
* 3 to 5 years of engineering experience with cloud\-native systems. \& have the ability to deploy and guiding team to deploy AI use cases
* Minimum 1 years of experience designing, deploying and operating AI platforms and infrastructure — model serving environments, AI\-ready compute, data pipelines, and platform integration — in production enterprise environments
* 10\+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, with demonstrable production delivery across cloud platforms, network, Security, Kubernetes, containerization, platform engineering, and enterprise application environments.
* Track record of owning and delivering infrastructure transformation outcomes inside live enterprise environments — not advisory engagements, internal initiatives, vendor labs, or contained team deployments.
* Ability to connect infrastructure decisions to business/financial outcomes — translating platform reliability, migration efficiency, and modernization gains into business impact a CFO would fund and act on.
* Experience presenting to and building trust with senior client stakeholders at CTO, CFO, or CISO level.
* Non\-linear profiles are expected and welcomed — assessment is based on demonstrated delivery experience and outcome ownership, not CV pattern matching.


**Additional Information**
* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Flexible to work in 24\*7 environment

57f44e4f.title: Cloud Platform Architect
57f44e4f.description:
**Project Role :** 
 Cloud Platform Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Oversee application architecture and deployment in cloud platform environments \-\- including public cloud, private cloud and hybrid cloud. This can include cloud adoption plans, cloud application design, and cloud management and monitoring.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Cloud Design and Build
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 Cloud Strategy and Assessment, Cloud Automation DevOps, Docker Kubernetes Architecture, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Database Architecture
   

  

**Minimum 7\.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 This is not a consulting role or a project delivery role. A Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineer is a production engineer who works embedded inside a client's enterprise, shoulder to shoulder with their teams, to transform legacy infrastructure \& Application estates into AI\-ready, cloud/Hybrid platforms and Modernized Infrastructure. You own outcomes: time\-to\-value, reliability, adoption, and scalability. Not delivery milestones. Outcomes.
   

  

 The Role expects the expertise to build cloud including Data and AI foundations that is secure \& scalable and responsive — designing AI Infrastructure architectures including Compute, Data, Networking and security aspects leveraging Hybrid cloud models.
   

  

 Accenture's Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineers operate at the intersection of engineering depth and business reinvention. This is where the most complex enterprise infrastructure challenges get solved — not in a lab, but inside real client environments, with real constraints, at real scale.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Embed directly with client infrastructure and engineering teams to design, execute, and operationalize end\-to\-end transformation — spanning cloud foundation, hyperconverged infrastructure, platform engineering, application modernization, database transformation, SAP, network and security, and AI platform deployment — inside real enterprise environments
* Accountable for production outcomes — platform reliability, time\-to\-value, adoption, and scalability — measured against business metrics, not project milestones.
* Move from ambiguous infrastructure problems to working production environment through rapid iteration: days to validated architecture, weeks to production\-ready deployment.
* Execute application migration hands\-on — rehost (lift \& shift), re\-platform (lift \& optimize), and redeploy — applying the right strategy per workload to land on an AI\-ready, modernized target platform.
* Architect and implement network and security foundations: Zero Trust, SASE/SSE, micro\-segmentation, container security, and application AI governance across enterprise environments.
* Design and govern transformation architectures across the full enterprise stack: compute (HCI/cloud), platform engineering and Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs), Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, network, security, storage, containers, databases, applications, and AI platform layers.
* Build the Data and AI foundation layer: design data architectures for structured and unstructured data deploy the AI platform layer that enables modernized workloads to leverage AI at scale.
* Architect and modernize database estates — relational and NoSQL database migration, schema conversion, performance tuning, and cloud\-native database deployment — as the data layer underpinning the modernized platform.
* Leverage Python end\-to\-end — infrastructure automation, deployment scripting, data pipeline engineering, and AI agent development across the full transformation lifecycle.
* Translate technical architecture into business impact for client CTO, CFO, and CISO shape modernization roadmaps, ROI backlogs, and AI adoption strategy.
* Build reusable patterns, playbooks, and accelerators through architecture workshops, proofs of concept, and code\-with sessions — leaving the client team fully capable of operating, scaling, and extending the platform independently, and codifying learnings that grow the FDE practice


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Engineering Mindset should come in the beginning.
* Minimum 2 years of working experience of AI platform ecosystems — cloud\-native AI services (AWS, Azure, GCP), open\-source model deployment, and the infrastructure layer required to run AI workloads reliably at enterprise scale.
* 3 to 5 years of engineering experience with cloud\-native systems. \& have the ability to deploy and guiding team to deploy AI use cases
* Minimum 1 years of experience designing, deploying and operating AI platforms and infrastructure — model serving environments, AI\-ready compute, data pipelines, and platform integration — in production enterprise environments
* 10\+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, with demonstrable production delivery across cloud platforms, network, Security, Kubernetes, containerization, platform engineering, and enterprise application environments.
* Track record of owning and delivering infrastructure transformation outcomes inside live enterprise environments — not advisory engagements, internal initiatives, vendor labs, or contained team deployments.
* Ability to connect infrastructure decisions to business/financial outcomes — translating platform reliability, migration efficiency, and modernization gains into business impact a CFO would fund and act on.
* Experience presenting to and building trust with senior client stakeholders at CTO, CFO, or CISO level.
* Non\-linear profiles are expected and welcomed — assessment is based on demonstrated delivery experience and outcome ownership, not CV pattern matching.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Flexible to work in 24\*7 environment

217a065e.title: Assistant Program Manager
217a065e.description:
Position: Assistant Program Manager


Location: Gurugram


Working Days: Monday to Saturday


Experience Required: 5\+ years


### **Role Overview**


We are looking for an experienced **Assistant Program Manager** to own the student conversion journey from offer acceptance to final enrollment. The role involves building strong relationships with students and parents, understanding their concerns, addressing objections, and driving conversions through a consultative and high\-touch approach.


The ideal candidate will have strong experience in **academic counselling, EdTech sales, admissions, or consultative B2C sales**, with a proven ability to influence decision\-making and close high\-value conversions.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Own the complete **post\-offer conversion journey**, from offer made to final enrollment.
* Engage extensively with **students and parents** to understand their aspirations, concerns, and decision\-making factors.
* Conduct consultative conversations to communicate program value, outcomes, and career opportunities.
* Handle objections around fees, career prospects, program fit, timelines, and competing offers.
* Build trust and maintain strong relationships with prospective students and their families.
* Drive conversions through structured follow\-ups, personalized counselling, and effective stakeholder management.
* Maintain accurate records of the admissions funnel and ensure timely movement of candidates through each stage.
* Collaborate with admissions, academic, marketing, and other internal teams to ensure a seamless student experience.
* Consistently achieve **enrollment and conversion targets** while maintaining a high\-quality candidate experience.
* Identify conversion bottlenecks and contribute to improving the overall admissions process.

### **Ideal Candidate Profile**


* **5\+ years of experience** in academic counselling, EdTech sales, admissions, student recruitment, or consultative B2C sales.
* Experience in roles such as **Academic Counsellor, Admissions Manager, Senior Counsellor, Head of Admissions, or similar**.
* Strong exposure to **parent\-led or family\-influenced decision\-making processes** is highly preferred.
* Candidates from premium education institutions, EdTech companies, or education\-focused sales environments will be preferred.
* Open to candidates from other industries with strong experience in **high\-ticket, consultative B2C sales**.
* Excellent communication, persuasion, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Strong ownership mindset with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding conversion targets.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment.
* Ability to manage multiple prospects through a structured sales funnel while maintaining a highly personalized approach.

### **Key Success Metrics**


* Offer\-to\-enrollment conversion rate
* Enrollment targets achieved
* Follow\-up effectiveness and funnel movement
* Parent/student engagement and experience
* Overall admissions revenue contribution

 Summary:
   

  

 This is not a consulting role or a project delivery role. A Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineer is a production engineer who works embedded inside a client's enterprise, shoulder to shoulder with their teams, to transform legacy infrastructure \& Application estates into AI\-ready, cloud/Hybrid platforms and Modernized Infrastructure. You own outcomes: time\-to\-value, reliability, adoption, and scalability. Not delivery milestones. Outcomes.
   

  

 The Role expects the expertise to build cloud including Data and AI foundations that is secure \& scalable and responsive — designing AI Infrastructure architectures including Compute, Data, Networking and security aspects leveraging Hybrid cloud models.
   

  

 Accenture's Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineers operate at the intersection of engineering depth and business reinvention. This is where the most complex enterprise infrastructure challenges get solved — not in a lab, but inside real client environments, with real constraints, at real scale.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Embed directly with client infrastructure and engineering teams to design, execute, and operationalize end\-to\-end transformation — spanning cloud foundation, hyperconverged infrastructure, platform engineering, application modernization, database transformation, SAP, network and security, and AI platform deployment — inside real enterprise environments
* Accountable for production outcomes — platform reliability, time\-to\-value, adoption, and scalability — measured against business metrics, not project milestones.
* Move from ambiguous infrastructure problems to working production environment through rapid iteration: days to validated architecture, weeks to production\-ready deployment.
* Execute application migration hands\-on — rehost (lift \& shift), re\-platform (lift \& optimize), and redeploy — applying the right strategy per workload to land on an AI\-ready, modernized target platform.
* Architect and implement network and security foundations: Zero Trust, SASE/SSE, micro\-segmentation, container security, and application AI governance across enterprise environments.
* Design and govern transformation architectures across the full enterprise stack: compute (HCI/cloud), platform engineering and Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs), Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, network, security, storage, containers, databases, applications, and AI platform layers.
* Build the Data and AI foundation layer: design data architectures for structured and unstructured data deploy the AI platform layer that enables modernized workloads to leverage AI at scale.
* Architect and modernize database estates — relational and NoSQL database migration, schema conversion, performance tuning, and cloud\-native database deployment — as the data layer underpinning the modernized platform.
* Leverage Python end\-to\-end — infrastructure automation, deployment scripting, data pipeline engineering, and AI agent development across the full transformation lifecycle.
* Translate technical architecture into business impact for client CTO, CFO, and CISO shape modernization roadmaps, ROI backlogs, and AI adoption strategy.
* Build reusable patterns, playbooks, and accelerators through architecture workshops, proofs of concept, and code\-with sessions — leaving the client team fully capable of operating, scaling, and extending the platform independently, and codifying learnings that grow the FDE practice


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Engineering Mindset should come in the beginning.
* Minimum 2 years of working experience of AI platform ecosystems — cloud\-native AI services (AWS, Azure, GCP), open\-source model deployment, and the infrastructure layer required to run AI workloads reliably at enterprise scale.
* 3 to 5 years of engineering experience with cloud\-native systems. \& have the ability to deploy and guiding team to deploy AI use cases
* Minimum 1 years of experience designing, deploying and operating AI platforms and infrastructure — model serving environments, AI\-ready compute, data pipelines, and platform integration — in production enterprise environments
* 10\+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, with demonstrable production delivery across cloud platforms, network, Security, Kubernetes, containerization, platform engineering, and enterprise application environments.
* Track record of owning and delivering infrastructure transformation outcomes inside live enterprise environments — not advisory engagements, internal initiatives, vendor labs, or contained team deployments.
* Ability to connect infrastructure decisions to business/financial outcomes — translating platform reliability, migration efficiency, and modernization gains into business impact a CFO would fund and act on.
* Experience presenting to and building trust with senior client stakeholders at CTO, CFO, or CISO level.
* Non\-linear profiles are expected and welcomed — assessment is based on demonstrated delivery experience and outcome ownership, not CV pattern matching.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Flexible to work in 24\*7 environment

382b2d1f.description:
Overview:
**Solution Consultant**
=======================

**Location:** Remote \| Hyderabad, India \| Kolkata, India **Work Model:** Hybrid – 3 Days in Office / Work from Home**About the Role**
------------------


The Solution Consultant is responsible for providing consulting services with the overall objective of designing and implementing software solutions for customers. Working alongside senior team members, this role is instrumental in gathering business requirements, configuring solutions, supporting customer training, and ensuring a seamless transition into production — all while building a strong foundation in Hyland's implementation methodology.**Your Role Responsibilities? Here's What You'll Do.**
------------------------------------------------------

* Observe and assist senior team members in requirements analysis, gathering information about business processes and technical requirements from key client stakeholders.
* Compose and deliver documentation outlining solution configuration requirements; build and configure the company's application development tools with direct oversight from senior team members.
* Test configured solutions to ensure they function as designed; work collaboratively with team members to identify and resolve issues.
* Compose training materials and conduct training sessions for customers; participate in solution design with oversight from senior team members.
* Develop migration plans with direct oversight from senior team members; migrate configured solutions into production environments and support customers throughout the migration process.
* Transition key information to the technical support team to ensure continued customer success; assist with upgrade planning, execution, and solution demonstrations.

**Technology Tools**
--------------------

**Category** **Tools**  

**Development \& Architecture** Scripting, System Architecture, Application Development Tools  

**Data** Relational Databases  

**Role Essentials**
-------------------

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
* Knowledge of scripting, system architecture, or relational databases.
* Strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to speak and write with ease, clarity, and impact for varied audiences and subjects.
* Ability to thoroughly investigate situations or issues to gather relevant information; adept at asking probing questions to obtain quality information.
* Self\-motivated with the ability to complete projects in a timely manner, with demonstrated sound judgment and the ability to appropriately escalate issues for guidance.

**What We'd Like to See**
-------------------------

* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment with strong multi\-tasking capabilities.
* Organized and experienced at successfully managing multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
* Solid collaboration skills applied successfully within a team as well as with other areas of the organization.
* Demonstrated ability to use sound judgment and appropriately escalate issues when guidance is needed.
* Flexibility and willingness to travel up to 30% annually, with the understanding that unique customer circumstances may require additional travel.

**About Hyland**
----------------


Hyland is the pioneer of the Content Innovation Cloud™, delivering ubiquitous enterprise intelligence to organizations with solutions that unlock actionable insights and drive automation. © Hyland. All rights reserved.
Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, including many of the Fortune 100, Hyland's solutions create the foundation for a connected, agentic enterprise, where teams harness the power of AI to redefine how they operate and engage with those they serve. For additional information on Hyland's platform and services, please visit Hyland.com.**\#HylandLife**

Since 1991, it has been Hyland's mission to help our employees, customers and partners exceed their potential with our industry\-leading content services platform. Our employees exude a contagious energy and are passionate about what they do – whether it's helping customers succeed, raising up their fellow Hylanders, or engaging in the communities where they live and work.
The \#HylandLife hashtag encompasses our employee\-centric culture. Our employees live our culture day in and day out by bringing their best self to work. Hyland supports them to do just that through career development resources, wellbeing programs and innovation practices. We thrive on diverse viewpoints and new ideas and believe that a positive, inclusive workplace is imperative to sustainable success.
As we've grown to a company of nearly 4,000 strong, we have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our communities. We strongly support employee initiatives and align our giving campaigns and programs to organizations that are important to them.**Equal Opportunity Statement**
-------------------------------

Employment decisions are made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable laws and regulations. Information collected during the hiring process is used solely to assess qualifications, verify identity, and comply with legal requirements.

62786e87.title: Engineer Staff Managing, Cloud Architect
62786e87.description:
Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Cloud Application Software Engineer to join our dynamic team. As a Cloud Application Software Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining cloud\-based applications and services. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative solutions and ensure the highest level of performance, reliability, and scalability.
Responsibilities:
* Lead a team of Cloud application development \& support engineers.
* Educate \& guide the team on technical aspects of the architecture.
* Develop POCs and Reference implementations to prove Architecture components.
* Architect \& design cloud applications focusing on AWS and demonstrate technical cloud architectural knowledge, playing a vital role in the design of cloud products running in 24×7 environments.
* Participate in product planning, SRE, and release planning activities.
* Work with SRE to set up Cloud application support \& observability tooling and site reliability process.
* Develop and enforce quality standards and work with DevOps for tooling required to implement the standards.
* Work with SRE to Develop the application Run Books.
* Working with development teams to ensure development is completed with adherence to development guidelines, focusing on continuous improvement.
* Validate the proposed component solution design is workable, Supportable, and Operable to meet the required service level.
* Problem Management – support root cause analysis of production issues P1\-P4, work with AWS platform and application teams to address remediation.
* Work closely with applications, network, and infrastructure teams to ensure workable application architectures.
* Provide regular verbal and written communications regarding status, risks, and issues and makes recommendations for remediation or change
* We have partnered with architects and product development teams to provide estimates with in architectural guidelines.  

Apply standards and research/share best practices.
* Participate in roadmap reviews and feasibility assessments.
* Application Ownership – Accountable for the availability, performance, capacity, and maintenance of the technology services in your portfolio
* People Leadership – Enabling our people for success through regular mentoring, development, and career conversations
* Knowledge transfer to the on\-shore and off\-shore teams
* Responsible for supporting process improvements to improve the stability and performance of the application platform


Qualifications:
* Extensive technical experience either in infrastructure or production management.
* 12\+ years of experience in application architecture and 5 \+ years in Cloud application architecture and infrastructure management.
* Has Led Cloud software development team directly.
* Strong experience with Cloud platforms. AWS is preferred.
* Knowledge of network products and protocols, including TCP/IP, Firewalls, Load Balancers, and DNS.
* You will be creative and an excellent problem solver.
* High level of analytical skills in an IT environment.
* Articulate, independent and detail\-oriented.
* Process, tools, and service level improvement experience.
* Documentation, use of standard tools, SharePoint, and Confluence.

 **WHO WE ARE**  

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate\-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.  

Shure is headquartered in United States. We have more than 35 regional sales offices, engineering hubs, distribution centers and manufacturing facilities throughout the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.  

Join Shure and Amplify Your Impact. Explore our unique culture and learn the key pillars that define our legacy of excellence.  

THE MIX MATTERS
Don’t check off every box in the job requirements? No problem! We recognize that every professional journey is unique and are committed to providing an equitable candidate experience for all prospective Shure Associates. If you’re excited about this role, believe you’ve got the skills to be successful, and share our passion for creating an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible work environment, then apply!

aecc65dd.title: Public Cloud Engineer
aecc65dd.description:
Join us as an Infrastructure Engineer for Database Platforms
   

  

* Join us and collaborate in building the best possible database platforms for public and private cloud environments
* Improve our products as you apply automation to provide testing and a route to live
* This is your chance to share thought leadership and best practice across the bank, while you’re developing solutions
* We're offering this role at vice president level


 What you'll do
   

  

 As an Infrastructure Engineer, you’ll take the lead on designing intuitive, self\-service database products that make all the difference to our customers, as well as our strategic targets. This is a fantastic opportunity to advance your career in a highly innovative and supportive environment.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate with product owners to create roadmaps and manage the lifecycle, taking customer feedback, new feature requests and production issues into consideration. As you continue to manage the selection, creation and maintenance of database\-related technologies, you’ll ensure that our solutions comply with the bank’s requirements and responsibilities.
   

  

**You’ll Also**
* Identify new ways to solve problems and enhance performance using tech tools
* Provide operational support for pattern or product\-related issues, and contribute to the delivery of infrastructure as code solutions
* Build awareness of design\-thinking tools and techniques across the bank to improve products
* Work with key stakeholders to ensure that we continue to deliver the best possible service


 The skills you'll need
   

  

 To thrive in this role, you’ll have experience in software development or automation scripting, such as Python or Shell. You’ll be knowledgeable about the software development lifecycle, with experience of utilising modern infrastructure as code via tooling.
   

  

 We’ll expect you to bring a good understanding of Agile working practices and toolsets, with the ability to create the vision for the Release Train, feature team, platform and domain.
   

  

**In Addition, You’ll Have**
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or related cloud platform roles
* least five years of strong experience in AWS products \& services, with strong focus on security, and controls
* Extensive automation experience with demonstrable skills in IaC using Terraform, and Python
* Practical experience of designing, and using CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, automated testing and deployments
* Software development or scripting skills, with experience of the SDLC along with good understanding of Agile methodologies and toolsets such as Jira
* Drive to make sure that solutions have security considered from the outset
* Great collaboration and stakeholder management skills
* Capacity to focus on the customer, empathise with them and influence to achieve the right outcome

39ba2a51.description:
Job Description:
**Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation**


Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation (A unit of Schneider Electric India Pvt. Ltd.) is a pioneering electrical and automation brand with a rich legacy of over 70 years in India. We offer comprehensive portfolio of low\-voltage switchgear, medium\-voltage switchgear, automation solutions, software, and services catering to diverse segments, including homes, agriculture, buildings, infrastructure, and industry.

**Job Description**  

**Position:** Deputy Manager – Digital Solutions (Full Stack Developer)  

**Location:** Navi Mumbai (Mahape) Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech Experience: 3–6 years (with strong hands\-on full\-stack development experience)  

**Role Summary**  

We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer to lead the design, development, and delivery of on\-premises and cloud\-based platforms. The role requires strong hands\-on development expertise, solution architecture ownership, secure software design, preparation of detailed design and architecture documentation, and execution of unit\-level validation/testing. The position also involves leading Agile product development in close collaboration with internal teams and external stakeholders.
