027cf37e.title: Technical Program Manager
027cf37e.description:
**About us**
------------


Rifa AI is building the AI agents platform for contact centers in regulated industries.


Enterprises in these industries want AI agents handling their customer operations and mostly can't deploy them. It's not a model problem. Horizontal platforms lack governance, release processes, and change management, and in a domain where every call can be reviewed by a regulator, that's disqualifying. Building an AI agent has never been easier. Deploying one an enterprise can trust has never been harder. That harder problem is the one we work on.


Our platform turns a company's written procedures into AI agents: voicebots that hold real\-time conversations, take actions in the client's CRM, and stay within the limits the client has set. Every release is gated by an automated testing suite, and every conversation feeds a post\-analysis platform. We're live in production today, handling debt collection calls for US financial services clients.


The engineering convictions behind it: evaluation methodology, not model capability, is the bottleneck. Every rule and decision trace becomes part of a company's context graph. Observability goes beyond logging. And our Agent Studio lets engineers, non\-engineers, and auditors collaborate to build and improve AI agents with the right guardrails to achieve the expected business outcomes.


Rifa was founded by Sameer Fulzele (IIT Bombay). We're a small team of exceptionally capable, passionate engineers with paying enterprise clients and growing revenue, backed by Seaborne Capital, a founder\-first firm of exceptional industry operators that works closely with its founders, and by angel investors who are veterans of enterprise software and operators in the accounts receivable industry.

**About the role**
------------------


Rifa ships voice and chat agent releases to multiple enterprise clients on overlapping timelines, and every one of those releases has an eval gate, a client sign\-off, and a rollout plan. You'll own that machinery, reporting directly to the CEO. As Technical Program Manager you run the release train end to end: planning what lands in each cycle, tracking dependencies across engineering, QA, and client\-facing teams, catching risk before it becomes a slipped date, and making sure a release that passes internally actually lands cleanly with the client.


This is a role for someone who reads engineering tickets and QA reports as fluently as a project plan, and who keeps five threads moving without letting any of them become someone else's surprise.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Run the release train.** Own the release calendar across voicebot and chatbot versions and across clients. Plan each cycle's scope with engineering, hold the eval gate as a hard line, and manage staged rollouts so no client is surprised by what changes.
* **Track dependencies and kill risk early.** Map what blocks what across engineering, QA, infrastructure, and client schedules. Surface slippage when it's a one\-day problem, not a one\-week one, and drive the trade\-off conversation to a decision.
* **Own program communication.** Keep a single, current source of truth for every program: status, risks, decisions, and owners, written clearly enough that the CEO, an engineer, and a client\-facing teammate all act from the same picture.
* **Run client onboarding and migration programs.** When a new client goes live or an existing one moves to a new agent version, you own the plan: milestones, environment readiness, data and integration checkpoints, sign\-offs, and the go\-live itself.
* **Improve the machinery.** Where the process creates friction, fix the process. Where a checklist would have caught the incident, write the checklist. Keep it simple; process is a cost we pay only when it clearly buys something.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 4 to 7 years in technical program management, release management, or engineering\-adjacent project management at a B2B software company, with at least part of that in a production environment where releases had real consequences.
* Enough technical depth to be dangerous: you can read an engineering ticket, follow an architecture discussion, and understand why a failing eval blocks a release, without needing an engineer to translate.
* A track record of shipping cross\-team programs on time, and of being honest early when they won't be.
* US\-hours overlap: reliable daily overlap with US business hours (ET/CT), which in practice means a late\-afternoon\-into\-evening IST schedule, since client rollouts and go\-lives happen on their clock.
* Strong written and spoken English. Status updates, rollout plans, and risk callouts are the core artifacts of this job, and they need to hold up under scrutiny.

**Even better...**
------------------

* Experience shipping AI/ML or conversational AI products, or working with eval\-gated release processes
* Experience in a regulated domain: financial services, collections, healthcare, insurance
* Familiarity with observability and QA tooling, or with client\-facing rollout and migration programs
* Early\-stage startup experience where you built the process rather than inherited it

**How we work**
---------------


Small teams per client, with real ownership. We review each other's work, we write things down, and we'd rather hear an honest "I don't know yet" than a confident wrong answer.

**Our values**
--------------

* **Trust:** We do the right thing, especially when nobody is checking. Clients hand us regulated conversations with their own customers, and we earn that every day.
* **Transparency:** We write things down, share the real numbers, and say "I don't know yet" out loud, with each other and with clients.
* **Technically best solution:** We choose what's right, not what's easiest or trendiest. When we notice we got it wrong, we fix it.
* **Decisiveness:** We decide quickly with the information we have, commit, and correct course fast when reality disagrees.
* **Simplicity:** We keep systems, processes, and words simple. Complexity is a cost we pay only when it clearly buys something.


Compensation Range: ₹25L \- ₹50L

502e7fbc.title: Program Manager, RBS Defect Reduction
502e7fbc.description:
**Description**
 Amazon strives to be Earth’s most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Retail Business Services (RBS) accelerates Amazon's growth by improving customer and Selling Partner (SP) experiences, while optimizing costs across Stores WW. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon’s systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high\-quality customer and selling\-partner experience.
   

  

 Returns Reduction as part of Cost to Serve (CtS) BU is a specialized program within RBS focused on driving down overall Return Rate for both Retail and FBA channels. Returns Reduction Program focuses on Upstream defect elimination with focus on defect identification and defect elimination and partners with System Owners, Category Teams, FC ACES, Finance, CS, and abuse\-related programs to uncover true drivers and remove them systematically. The team builds mechanisms that strengthen upstream defect visibility, and enable consistent governance and contributing directly to improved Free Cash Flow and scalable business growth.
   

  

 This role will focus on identification and prioritization of high\-impact defect opportunities and will own and define the roadmap for elimination of the problem space end to end. They will do this by building trusted partnerships with key stakeholders across technology, finance, operations and earning alignment to pursue defect elimination opportunities and influencing senior leaders through compelling, data\-driven business cases. This role requires an individual who is comfortable in diving deep into complex data sets and presenting strategic recommendations to leadership up to three tiers above level. The candidate will bring strong business and supply chain acumen, a bias for action, and the strategic vision by directly contributing to improved cost to serve performance and driving scalable growth across Amazon Stores worldwide.
   

  

 Why You’ll Love This Role
   

  

* Customer Impact: You’ll lead critical projects that remove defects, improves customer experience and directly influence Amazon’s supply chain cost, driving measurable results.
* Strategic Influence: Collaborate across global teams, including technology, finance, operations to shape strategies that focuses on improving customer satisfaction.
* Data\-Driven Innovation: Leverage analytics to uncover insights and optimize supply chain performance.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Deliver Results, Dive Deep: Conduct deep\-dive analysis on customer returns data to identify and quantify top defect opportunities. Own execution of elimination initiatives end\-to\-end, escalating blockers and partnering with senior team members on prioritization.
* Ability to Influence: Build data\-driven business cases for defect elimination opportunities and present recommendations to managers and cross\-functional partners, using insights to influence team\-level priorities and tradeoffs.
* Earn Trust: Build strong working relationships with immediate stakeholder groups; proactively communicate progress, risks, and findings to gain alignment on defect elimination priorities within your scope.
* Financial Collaboration: Work closely with finance partners to quantify returns impact, validate savings estimates, and ensure proposed initiatives align with the team's financial targets. Identify tradeoffs between near\-term cost reduction and longer\-term goals, surfacing recommendations to leadership.
* Stakeholder Communication: Coordinate stakeholder updates across project milestones, process changes, and escalations within your assigned programs, ensuring timely and clear communication. Provide analytical support to leaders on strategy documents, research requests, and data pulls as needed.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Defect Opportunity Identification: Leverage analytics tools and customer anecdotes to identify high\-impact defect opportunities within the Returns space. Conduct root cause analysis to validate findings and develop use cases, applying judgment to prioritize based on customer impact, value, and feasibility of solutions.

JD — Senior Solution Architect (Microsoft)
 



  





 Senior Solution Architect
 



**(Microsoft \& Enterprise Landscape)** 




 \#EA/Structure/Roles
 



 About the Role
 



 Kaplan International Pathways is a leading provider of global education centered around our students. Technology is at the heart of what we do, and our Solution Architecture capability ensures that our diverse IT systems align with our overall business strategy.
 



 We are looking for a permanent Solution Architect to act as the guardian of our enterprise architecture patterns.
 



 Kaplan International Pathways is undertaking a strategic consolidation of service onto the core SaaS, PaaS, and Cloud platforms, including the Microsoft stack and Azure service including Fabric, PowerApps, Purview, and more. In this role, you will be the primary authority for ensuring that our diverse portfolio, ranging from custom PHP applications to off\-the\-shelf SaaS, integrates neatly within and consolidates effectively around this core backbone.
 



 You will sit within the Application Engineering and Architecture team, ensuring that projects are built right the first time. You act as the bridge between high\-level business strategy and low\-level engineering execution, ensuring that we move quickly while enforcing mandatory guardrails for consistency, security, and compliance that our vendors and dev teams adhere to.
 


* **Location:** 
 Hybrid (Based in our Bengaluru Office).
* **Team:** 
 Application Engineering \& Architecture.



 Key Responsibilities
 



**Designing the Future State** 




 Your primary goal is to drive architectural consistency and help define the direction for our technology estate, aligned with our AI and data initiatives, and ensuring we reduce technical debt.
 


* **Microsoft Stack Strategy:**
* Lead the architectural alignment with Microsoft 365 and Azure (PaaS/IaaS/Serverless).
* Champion our "Buy\-not\-Build" strategy through checks\-and\-balances against unnecessary custom development/engineering, ensuring we leverage native cloud capabilities (e.g., Azure Functions, Logic Apps) before building custom code.
* **Architecture Governance \& Standards:**
* Own the Architecture Decision Record (ADR) repository and C4 Model standards.
* You review and approve technical designs, ensuring that decisions are documented, defensible, and communicated clearly to the engineering teams.
* **Integration \& API\-First:**
* Define how our peripheral ecosystem (Salesforce, Pimcore, KSS – our student services platform, Drupal) connects to the central data spine.
* Enforce the API\-First mandate. You ensure that systems communicate via governed interfaces (Azure API Management), minimizing brittle point\-to\-point connections.
* **Security \& Identity:**
* Enforce Zero\-Trust principles and Privacy\-by\-Design at the blueprint stage.
* Design patterns for internal service\-to\-service communication using InfoSec approved credential management (Azure Key Vault/Entra ID) and ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR.
* **Collaboration \& Quality:**
* Partner with the Development Manager and QA Manager to ensure designs are deliverable/executable by the Development Manager and testable by QA.
* Champion "Shift\-Left" thinking, ensuring that non\-functional requirements (performance, scalability, observability) are baked into the architecture early, not added as an afterthought.



 What You Bring
 



 We are looking for someone who is passionate about Architecture, understands the importance of flexibility and security, and is able to help build a north\-star strategy.
 



**Essential Skills \& Experience** 



* **Azure API Management:** 
 Strong experience architecting solutions on Azure (App Service, Functions, Event Grid, API Management) and integrating with Microsoft 365 capabilities.
* **Enterprise Architecture Management:** 
 Substantial experience working as a Solution Architect at enterprise organisations. You understand complex system setup and configurations (e.g. CRM, CMS, Billing) and have exposure to or understanding of eCommerce business models.
* **Bridging Technologies:** 
 Comfortable working with both new (Cloud\-Native) and legacy (Legacy PHP/Monolith) technologies. You have a track record of designing strategies to bridge the gap or migrate systems effectively.
* **Governance Frameworks:** 
 Understanding of architectural frameworks (e.g. TOGAF, C4 Model) and experience applying them in both Agile and Waterfall environments. You value clarity over complexity.
* **Communication:** 
 Excellent communicator, able to make technical concepts accessible to Director\-level stakeholders and influence decision\-making without direct authority.



**Desirable** 



* **Data Awareness:** 
 Understanding of modern Data Lakehouse concepts (Microsoft Fabric), including Medallion Architecture, to ensure your application designs support the Analytics team.
* **SaaS Integration:** 
 Experience integrating with Salesforce Cloud (Edu, Marketing) or Microsoft Dynamics/Great Plains.



 Our Technology Stack
 



 You will be the architect for this diverse ecosystem:
 


* **Cloud Core:** 
 Azure (PaaS, Serverless, Logic Apps), Azure API Management.
* **Applications:** 
 Pimcore, KSS (Legacy PHP/Angular systems), Drupal, MuleSoft.
* **Data \& CRM:** 
 Salesforce Cloud (Edu), Microsoft Fabric.
* **Productivity:** 
 Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform.



 Why Join Kaplan?
 


* **Strategic Impact:** 
 You are not just maintaining a system; you are architecting a migration to a modern, cloud\-native estate.
* **Authority:** 
 You are the design authority for the engineering function, defining the patterns that developers will follow.
* **Culture:** 
 A collaborative technical environment where Architecture, Development, and QA work as a unified team to drive quality.

**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview**
 The Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting Bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. The team develops the Bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program and identifies and addresses vulnerabilities, Develops, deploys and manages a risk\-based controls portfolio, Manages and operates a global security operations center that monitors, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking an experienced Identity and Access Management (IAM) Solution Architect to join an exciting team within Global Information Security (GIS). Cyber Security Technology (CST) is a globally distributed team responsible for cyber security innovation and architecture, engineering, solutions and capabilities development, cyber resiliency, access management engineering, data strategy, deployment maintenance, technical project management and information technology security control support.
   

  

 The Identity \& Access Management (IAM) Solution Architect will facilitate with designing, strengthening, and securing the Bank’s Identity \& Access Management systems and overall security posture. This role focuses on collaboration across all Lines of Business, CIO teams, to continuously improve the organization's security adherence. The Solution Architect will design, identify, and document inefficiencies, and prioritize improvement opportunities across the IAM and authentication related projects.
   

  

 Additionally, the role also will actively apply knowledge of laws, rules, regulations, and information security concepts (e.g., NIST, COBIT, ISO) to establish and maintain information security policies and standards. Job expectations include working with information security engineering and identity \& access product teams, identifying gaps and directing the overall identity and access strategy.

+ Manage all aspects of delivery for solution design, including capturing of security requirements, identifying risks \& opportunities, and alignment to information security policy.
+ Create portfolio level, high‑level and low‑level design (PLD/HLD/LLD) documentation for IAM architectures, integrations, and solution components.
+ Perform IAM\-focused threat modeling to assess security risks, identify attack vectors, and define mitigation strategies across identity platforms and authentication workflows.

* Research
+ Maintain thought leadership role in identity and access technology, remaining up to date on offerings of various service providers. Conducting research on emerging IAM technologies, authentication protocols, threat landscapes, and best practices to inform platform strategy and improve architectural robustness.

* Consult
+ Serve as a technical security design resource through the Systems Development Lifecyle and provide expert level guidance on design decisions, standards, and operational practices.
+ Support with creating new and leveraging existing secure patterns to optimize an identity and access design that aligns to business requirements.
+ Be an active member of Identity center of excellence to define and govern best practices in identity and access platforms engineering, operations, application development, and governance.
+ Drive discussions in architecture review board; develop platform architecture artifacts and influence on architectural decisions.

* Communicate
+ Communicate problems, risks, challenges, and evangelize IAM best practices to drive discussions across key stakeholders –engineering, operations, developers, and senior leadership.
+ Cross collaborates and work with line(s) of business teams and other security and IT support functions.

 Summary:
   

  

 This is not a consulting role or a project delivery role. A Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineer is a production engineer who works embedded inside a client's enterprise, shoulder to shoulder with their teams, to transform legacy infrastructure \& Application estates into AI\-ready, cloud/Hybrid platforms and Modernized Infrastructure. You own outcomes: time\-to\-value, reliability, adoption, and scalability. Not delivery milestones. Outcomes.
   

  

 The Role expects the expertise to build cloud including Data and AI foundations that is secure \& scalable and responsive — designing AI Infrastructure architectures including Compute, Data, Networking and security aspects leveraging Hybrid cloud models.
   

  

 Accenture's Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineers operate at the intersection of engineering depth and business reinvention. This is where the most complex enterprise infrastructure challenges get solved — not in a lab, but inside real client environments, with real constraints, at real scale.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Embed directly with client infrastructure and engineering teams to design, execute, and operationalize end\-to\-end transformation — spanning cloud foundation, hyperconverged infrastructure, platform engineering, application modernization, database transformation, SAP, network and security, and AI platform deployment — inside real enterprise environments
* Accountable for production outcomes — platform reliability, time\-to\-value, adoption, and scalability — measured against business metrics, not project milestones.
* Move from ambiguous infrastructure problems to working production environment through rapid iteration: days to validated architecture, weeks to production\-ready deployment.
* Execute application migration hands\-on — rehost (lift \& shift), re\-platform (lift \& optimize), and redeploy — applying the right strategy per workload to land on an AI\-ready, modernized target platform.
* Architect and implement network and security foundations: Zero Trust, SASE/SSE, micro\-segmentation, container security, and application AI governance across enterprise environments.
* Design and govern transformation architectures across the full enterprise stack: compute (HCI/cloud), platform engineering and Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs), Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, network, security, storage, containers, databases, applications, and AI platform layers.

**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Technical Architect with 10\+ years of experience who can own end\-to\-end system architecture for an AI\-driven product. This role requires a hands\-on architect who can design, guide, and govern systems, while still being capable of contributing to code when required. You will work closely with the CEO and Delivery Head to translate product vision into scalable, secure, and high\-performing technical solutions.

* **Architectural Ownership:** 
 Define and own the overall technical architecture of the fund’s infrastructure, ensuring alignment with systematic trading goals in collaboration with the CEO and Delivery Head.
* **System Design \& Impact:** 
 Translate complex requirements into scalable designs for "Bulk" simulation and "Real\-time" execution layers, while conducting detailed technical analysis and impact assessments for all new features and system changes.
* **Technical Leadership:** 
 Provide architectural guidance to engineering teams, acting as the key decision\-maker for the Linux\-based ecosystem.
* **Governance \& Standards:** 
 Establish and enforce coding standards and design principles, ensuring final sign\-offs on all major architectural changes.
* **Performance \& Reliability:** 
 Own system scalability and reliability, proactively identifying bottlenecks in high\-throughput data pipelines.

 Design and govern microservices and distributed system architectures, ensuring alignment between functional requirements and technical solutions
* **AI \& Data Engineering Architecture**

* Guide the implementation of LLM integrations and intelligent automation within R\&D workflows.

* Oversee CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies using Jenkins and Airflow.
* Define the Hybrid\-Cloud Disaster Recovery strategy (Azure preferred), focusing on reusing Ansible scripts for rapid Cloud\-based replication, with a focus on high availability and cost optimization
* Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Infrastructure automation and environment standardization
* **Modernization \& Future\-Proofing** 
 :
* Drive the adoption of modern technologies, tools, and industry best practices, specifically in AI, cloud, and scalable system design.
* Continuously evaluate and introduce emerging technologies and architectural improvements to keep the platform future\-ready.



  





**Required Technical Skills** 



* **Architecture \& Design:** 
 Strong experience in software architecture and design patterns with a solid foundation in OOPs.
* **Enterprise Development** 
 :
* **Java:** 
 Extensive hands\-on experience in pure Java (multi\-threading, real\-time) and frameworks (Spring, Hibernate, IOC, MVC, JDBC, JMS)
* **Python:** 
 Mastery of the Python stack for R\&D, reporting (PDF/HTML, visualisation libraries), backend services and data systems
* API\-driven architectures and microservices design
* **Big Data Technologies:**
* Expert knowledge of the Apache stack, specifically Spark, HDFS, Yarn, HBase, Hive, Airflow and ML libraries
* Data pipelines, large\-scale data processing, and analytics workflows
* ML/AI system integration concepts and data\-driven architectures
* **DevOps \& Automation** 
 :
* CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Maven, Git, JIRA)
* Experience with Cloud platforms (Azure preferred) specifically for Disaster Recovery.
* Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes
* **Data \& Database Systems** 
 :
* Relational databases (MS SQL, PostgreSQL)
* Query optimization and system performance tuning
* **Operating Systems:** 
 Deep expertise in Linux\-based infrastructure and cluster management.



  





**Required Soft Skills** 



* Strong ability to work collaboratively across teams and leadership
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to mentor, guide, and influence teams
* High level of ownership and accountability
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical mindset
* Ability to prioritize, manage time, and work under pressure
* Willingness to learn, adapt, and drive continuous improvement
* Professional, approachable, and reliable



  





**What We Expect from an Architect (Startup Mindset)** 



* Think long\-term architecture, but act fast in execution
* Balance scalability vs speed of delivery
* Avoid over\-engineering — focus on practical, scalable solutions
* Take complete ownership of technical decisions and outcomes



  





**About the Company** 




 We are a cutting\-edge AI company dedicated to revolutionizing industries through the power of artificial intelligence. We specialize in developing advanced AI solutions that empower businesses to make smarter decisions, optimize processes, and unlock new opportunities. Our company is constantly evolving and growing. We provide a wide range of services. Our mission is to provide the best solution that helps everyone.

c2a320db.description:
**Project Role :** 
 Cloud Platform Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Oversee application architecture and deployment in cloud platform environments \-\- including public cloud, private cloud and hybrid cloud. This can include cloud adoption plans, cloud application design, and cloud management and monitoring.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Cloud Design and Build
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 Cloud Strategy and Assessment, Cloud Automation DevOps, Docker Kubernetes Architecture, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Database Architecture
   

  

**Minimum 7\.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 This is not a consulting role or a project delivery role. A Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineer is a production engineer who works embedded inside a client's enterprise, shoulder to shoulder with their teams, to transform legacy infrastructure \& Application estates into AI\-ready, cloud/Hybrid platforms and Modernized Infrastructure. You own outcomes: time\-to\-value, reliability, adoption, and scalability. Not delivery milestones. Outcomes.
   

  

 The Role expects the expertise to build cloud including Data and AI foundations that is secure \& scalable and responsive — designing AI Infrastructure architectures including Compute, Data, Networking and security aspects leveraging Hybrid cloud models.
   

  

 Accenture's Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineers operate at the intersection of engineering depth and business reinvention. This is where the most complex enterprise infrastructure challenges get solved — not in a lab, but inside real client environments, with real constraints, at real scale.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Embed directly with client infrastructure and engineering teams to design, execute, and operationalize end\-to\-end transformation — spanning cloud foundation, hyperconverged infrastructure, platform engineering, application modernization, database transformation, SAP, network and security, and AI platform deployment — inside real enterprise environments
* Accountable for production outcomes — platform reliability, time\-to\-value, adoption, and scalability — measured against business metrics, not project milestones.
* Move from ambiguous infrastructure problems to working production environment through rapid iteration: days to validated architecture, weeks to production\-ready deployment.
* Execute application migration hands\-on — rehost (lift \& shift), re\-platform (lift \& optimize), and redeploy — applying the right strategy per workload to land on an AI\-ready, modernized target platform.
* Architect and implement network and security foundations: Zero Trust, SASE/SSE, micro\-segmentation, container security, and application AI governance across enterprise environments.
* Design and govern transformation architectures across the full enterprise stack: compute (HCI/cloud), platform engineering and Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs), Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, network, security, storage, containers, databases, applications, and AI platform layers.
* Build the Data and AI foundation layer: design data architectures for structured and unstructured data deploy the AI platform layer that enables modernized workloads to leverage AI at scale.
* Architect and modernize database estates — relational and NoSQL database migration, schema conversion, performance tuning, and cloud\-native database deployment — as the data layer underpinning the modernized platform.
* Leverage Python end\-to\-end — infrastructure automation, deployment scripting, data pipeline engineering, and AI agent development across the full transformation lifecycle.
* Translate technical architecture into business impact for client CTO, CFO, and CISO shape modernization roadmaps, ROI backlogs, and AI adoption strategy.
* Build reusable patterns, playbooks, and accelerators through architecture workshops, proofs of concept, and code\-with sessions — leaving the client team fully capable of operating, scaling, and extending the platform independently, and codifying learnings that grow the FDE practice


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Engineering Mindset should come in the beginning.
* Minimum 2 years of working experience of AI platform ecosystems — cloud\-native AI services (AWS, Azure, GCP), open\-source model deployment, and the infrastructure layer required to run AI workloads reliably at enterprise scale.
* 3 to 5 years of engineering experience with cloud\-native systems. \& have the ability to deploy and guiding team to deploy AI use cases
* Minimum 1 years of experience designing, deploying and operating AI platforms and infrastructure — model serving environments, AI\-ready compute, data pipelines, and platform integration — in production enterprise environments
* 10\+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, with demonstrable production delivery across cloud platforms, network, Security, Kubernetes, containerization, platform engineering, and enterprise application environments.
* Track record of owning and delivering infrastructure transformation outcomes inside live enterprise environments — not advisory engagements, internal initiatives, vendor labs, or contained team deployments.
* Ability to connect infrastructure decisions to business/financial outcomes — translating platform reliability, migration efficiency, and modernization gains into business impact a CFO would fund and act on.
* Experience presenting to and building trust with senior client stakeholders at CTO, CFO, or CISO level.
* Non\-linear profiles are expected and welcomed — assessment is based on demonstrated delivery experience and outcome ownership, not CV pattern matching.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Flexible to work in 24\*7 environment

53d60bdd.description:
At Viamagus, every engineer works with AI every day \- not as a side experiment, but as the core of how we build. We're looking for a
 **Technical Architect** 
 who has shipped real systems, led real teams, and already treats AI tools as first\-class instruments of engineering. You'll own architecture across all client engagements, mentor a team of 15–20 engineers, and shape how an AI\-native consultancy delivers at scale.
 



  




* Direct access to client CTOs \- architecture decisions that actually ship, not slide decks
* Work inside an org where Claude Code, Cursor, and LLM\-native workflows are the default, not the exception
* Lead technical direction on diverse engagements: cloud modernisation, AI product builds, enterprise integrations
* Shape Viamagus's engineering standards, internal tooling, and AI practices from the ground up



  





**What you'll do** 



* Design scalable, secure architectures for client engagements and lead technical due diligence on proposals
* Drive production readiness: incident management, observability, release processes
* Mentor backend, mobile, and cloud engineers \- through architecture reviews, code reviews, and retrospectives
* Be the technical face to client CTOs: translate business objectives into architecture decisions and escalate risks with proposed mitigations
* Enforce security\-first design including threat modelling, data classification, and AI\-specific risks (prompt injection, PII leakage)
* Ensure compliance readiness for ISO 27001, SOC 2, and HIPAA where applicable



  





**What you bring** 




**Engineering foundation** 



* 8\+ years of software development, 3\+ years in an architect or lead role; degree in CS/Engineering (Master's preferred)
* Built and owned systems from scratch to production \- full lifecycle, not slices
* Multiple integration experiences: third\-party APIs, enterprise systems (SAP, Salesforce, ERP), messaging buses, legacy modernisation
* Built reusable platforms, SDKs, and internal tooling adopted across teams
* Technology\-agnostic: strong in at least one modern backend stack, one frontend framework, and one cloud platform
* AWS or Azure architecture: VPC design, IAM, container orchestration, cost optimisation
* DevOps fluency: Docker, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, Terraform or CDK
* Performance tuning, distributed tracing, APM tools (Datadog, New Relic, or equivalent)
* AppSec fundamentals: OWASP Top 10, VAPT remediation, secrets management; ISO/SOC 2/HIPAA exposure a plus



  





**AI\-era fluency (working knowledge of most of these required)** 



* Daily use of AI coding tools \- Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent \- and the ability to articulate where they help and where they fall short
* LLM integration patterns: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open\-source models; streaming, function calling, structured outputs
* RAG fundamentals: vector DBs (pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant), embeddings, chunking, retrieval tradeoffs
* Agentic systems: tool use, multi\-step agents, LangGraph or CrewAI
* Prompt engineering: versioning, structured outputs, guardrails, handling hallucinations
* AI evaluation and cost awareness: measuring quality, latency, and cost of LLM\-powered features
* MCP (Model Context Protocol): awareness of what it is and where it fits



  





**Nice to have** 



* Open\-source contributions or published AI tooling
* Real\-time sync experience: CRDTs, Realm, Ditto, or offline\-first architectures
* Technical writing \- blogs, conference talks, or public GitHub work
* Google, AWS, or Azure certifications (a bonus, not a substitute for depth)

* Modernize the infrastructure\-as\-code practice. Propose tooling and patterns for joint review with the Senior Security Infrastructure Engineer, and incrementally bring infrastructure under code with security guardrails built in from the start.
* Partner with the senior developer and broader development team to extend modern CI/CD patterns from application code into infrastructure deployment, and to design systems that scale securely as the business grows.
* Work closely with Omni’s security team and managed SOC on hardening, vulnerability remediation, identity controls, endpoint protection through SentinelOne, and compliance evidence.
* Cross\-train into the security workstreams the Senior Security Infrastructure Engineer manages day\-to\-day, including endpoint detection and response, SASE and ZTNA networking, SIEM, and the managed SOC’s tooling, so the two roles can back each other up across disciplines.
* Manage observability across Datadog and Azure Monitor, including alerting, on\-call signal hygiene, and runbook development.
* Maintain the homegrown line\-of\-business application infrastructure (Azure App Services, Azure SQL, and Microsoft WAF).

* Build and maintain runbooks, architecture diagrams, and change records so the environment can be supported by anyone on the team.
* Partner with Omni’s co\-managed MSP as a shared delivery team across day\-to\-day operations and escalations, rather than treating the MSP as an outside vendor.
* Provide escalation support to internal end users for infrastructure\-impacting tickets routed through the helpdesk and the co\-managed MSP.
* Participate in an after\-hours rotation covering monthly maintenance windows and incident response, and co\-lead post\-incident reviews. Formalizing the rotation is part of the role, in partnership with the Senior Security Infrastructure Engineer.


**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* 8\+ years of cloud engineering experience, with significant Azure depth.
* 3\+ years operating Windows Server environments at production scale.
* Hands\-on experience with hybrid identity, including Active Directory, Group Policy, and Entra ID, in a Windows\-centric environment.
* Strong cloud and hybrid networking experience, including firewall change management, network segmentation, cross\-tenant routing, IPsec and SSL VPN, NSGs, and subnet design.
* Experience operating to defined RPO and RTO targets, including DR runbook maintenance and failover testing.
* Strong infrastructure\-as\-code experience. Terraform preferred, with openness to Azure\-native equivalents such as Bicep or ARM templates.
* Demonstrated ability to modernize engineering practices in close collaboration with security counterparts, partnering on the final shape of the practice rather than dictating it.
* Comfort operating in a role where a security peer reviews and signs off on significant infrastructure decisions, and where outcomes are defined jointly rather than independently.
* Comfort cross\-training across infrastructure and security disciplines, holding a primary area of focus while providing secondary coverage of the other.
* Track record of partnering closely with security and development teams to ship and operate software safely and at scale.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 Copilot or other enterprise AI rollouts.
* Exposure to NIST CSF, CIS Controls, or ISO/IEC 27001, and how these frameworks apply to both cloud and on\-premises or Group Policy deployment.
* Familiarity with SOC 2 control operation and evidence collection.
* Working knowledge of California privacy regulation (CCPA / CPRA). HIPAA exposure also a plus.
* Microsoft partnership program exposure (CSP, Solutions Partner designations).
* Secondary cloud and SaaS familiarity beyond Azure, including Google Workspace, Google Cloud Storage, and Wasabi object storage.
* Exposure to thin\-client deployments and cloud browser management.
* Cloudflare familiarity (edge, DNS, security).
* Next\-generation firewall platform experience (Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet FortiGate, or comparable).
* Enterprise backup and DR platform experience (Veeam, Axcient, Azure Backup, or comparable).
* Experience migrating workloads from traditional VMs to serverless or cloud\-native application platforms.
* SQL Server DBA exposure for day\-to\-day database operations (not a primary focus of the role).
* IIS management experience.
* AWS, Kubernetes, or serverless experience.
* Experience operating in a small infrastructure team where breadth matters more than depth in any one area.

f10f996d.title: Cloud Architect
f10f996d.description:
**Company Description** 
 HummingBird is a Responsible AI\-powered total talent workforce platform that transforms how organizations attract, engage, and retain talent through personalized, data\-driven experiences for candidates and employers. The platform optimizes the full talent lifecycle, from sourcing and engagement to hiring and long\-term retention, using advanced AI to improve every interaction. Product capabilities include AI\-generated job descriptions, intelligent candidate analysis, automated pre\-screening interviews, and comprehensive analytics with both pre\-built and custom reports. HummingBird offers predictive insights, referral tracking, social media integration, and seamless configuration of ATS/VMS stages and scoring models. With access to over 20 million global talents and quick integrations to major VMS/ATS systems, the platform creates a unified, efficient recruitment ecosystem.
 



  





  





**Role Description** 
 The Cloud Architect role is a full\-time hybrid position based in Chennai, with flexibility for partial work from home. This role is responsible for designing and implementing scalable, secure, and resilient cloud architectures that support HummingBird’s AI\-driven talent platform and unified recruitment ecosystem. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include defining cloud solution designs, collaborating with software development teams on application and microservices architecture, and guiding infrastructure deployment across cloud environments. The Cloud Architect will oversee integration between internal systems and external ATS/VMS platforms, optimize performance and cost, and ensure robust security, compliance, and reliability. The role also involves documenting architectural standards, mentoring engineering teams on best practices, and partnering with product and data teams to support new features and analytics capabilities.
 



  





  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong Solution Architecture skills, including designing scalable, secure, and highly available cloud solutions.
* Experience with Infrastructure design and implementation across public cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including networking, storage, and compute.
* Background in Software Development with knowledge of microservices, APIs, and modern application frameworks.
* Proven Integration expertise, including connecting to third\-party systems (e.g., ATS/VMS), APIs, and data pipelines.
* Solid Architecture fundamentals, including design patterns, performance optimization, reliability, and security best practices.
* Hands\-on experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with data platforms, analytics, or AI/ML workloads in the cloud is an advantage.
* Relevant degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and communicate complex architectural concepts clearly.
* Experience in hybrid work environments and willingness to work from the Chennai office as required.

**Phenom Introduction:** 




 Our purpose is to help a billion people find the right work! Phenom is an AI\-Powered talent experience platform that is redefining the HR tech space. We have grown into a global organization with offices in 6 countries and over 1,500 employees. As an HR tech unicorn organization, innovation and creativity is within our DNA. Come help us make every talent moment Phenomenal!
 



**Job Description:** 




 The Solutions Architect is responsible for providing technical subject matter expertise and best practices on custom solutions at the product and platform layers. This team also owns the technical governance related to all external integrations of the Phenom platform.
 



 The Solutions Architect will work closely with prospects, customers, and internal teams to ensure that the customer’s technical requirements are addressed. The role calls for an individual who is part Technologist, part Solutions Architect, and part functional consultant. As a Solutions Architect, you will own all facets of solutioning \- including planning, elicitation, scoping, requirements gathering, communication, identifying potential risks, and ultimately facilitating the success of the deal.
 



**Responsibilities:** 



* Creating, defining \& driving scope, solutioning, and estimation, thereby driving the statement of work activities.
* Facilitating smooth handoffs between sales to services teams on solution delivery and clear articulation of in\-scope and out\-of\-scope requirements.
* Training and mentoring Phenom \& Partner implementation resources on the latest product/engineering rollouts from an implementation/integration standpoint.
* Internally liaising with appropriate product and engineering teams for proof of concept/solution prototypes to ensure proposed solutions meet customer needs and align with the Product/Engineering roadmap \& feasibility.
* Gaining a general understanding of Phenom’s data security, governance, and retention policies across the platform as it pertains specifically to GDPR/Privacy regulations.
* Researching and developing world\-class technical artifacts and documentation best practices such as Integration Playbooks, Integrated Solutions Documents, Functional requirements \& specifications, proof of concepts, wireframes, etc.
* Researching and analyzing competitors’ product offerings and solution capabilities to assess Phenom’s own technical maturity from an implementation point of view and preparing to offer workable solutions as alternatives.
* Participating in Vendor workshops for assessing integration and implementation capabilities to drive partnerships serving mutual interests.



**What You’ve Done:** 



* 8\+ years of hands\-on technical consulting experience, including designing/estimating and prototyping solutions for enterprise environments (SaaS is preferred).
* Hands\-on technical experience in integrations/data migrations/product provisioning, etc.
* Understanding of Java/Web/Middleware technologies. You are not expected to write code, but you need to understand the technical requirements and decipher complex technical problems.
* Understanding of common web technologies, SaaS platform \& architecture, Content Management systems, and working knowledge of HTML, XML, API, JavaScript, CSS, APIs (REST and SOAP), Authentication methods like Basic/OAuth2\.0, etc.
* Strong understanding of software development methodologies, infrastructure architecture, and data management principles.
* Knowledge of Project Management Methodology and Software Development Life Cycles, including Agile and Waterfall.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills to effectively communicate complex technical and business issues (and solutions) to diverse audiences.
* Ability to plan, organize, prioritize, and deliver multiple projects simultaneously.
* Experience with PaaS (Platform as a Service) is a plus.
* Experience in Talent Acquisition/Human Resources technology is a huge asset.



**Benefits:** 




 We want you to be your best self and to pursue your passions!
 


* Health and wellness benefits/programs to support holistic employee health
* Flexible hours and working schedules, as well as parental leave for new parents
* Growing organization with career pathing and development opportunities
* Tons of perks and extras in every location for all Phenoms!

91f3a3c0.description:
**About Us**
 Join us at Orange Business!
   

  

 We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
   

  

 Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a visionary Lead Architect with over 15 years of experience to join our Integration delivery team. In this role, you will be a strategic leader responsible for designing and delivering complex, large\-scale integration, cloud\-native environments. You will drive the architectural vision for our clients, ensuring high\-performance, secure, and cost\-optimized digital transformations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Architecture Strategy \& Leadership** 
 : Define and drive the end\-to\-end architectural roadmap for digital integration, application modernization, and cloud\-native adoption.
   

  

**Cloud \& Application Modernization** 
 : Lead the migration of monolithic legacy applications to microservices\-based, containerised (Docker/Kubernetes) architectures on major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
   

  

**AI / ML Solution Engineering** 
 : Design and implement AI\-based solutions, including Generative AI patterns (RAG, agent workflows) vector databases, and prompt engineering and enhance business processes.
   

  

 Design the end\-to\-end ML lifecycle (MLOps), covering data ingestion, model training, deployment, and automated retraining workflows.
   

  

 Build AI\-enabled applications using Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and prompt engineering
   

  

**FinOps \& Cost Governance** 
 : Establish and oversee FinOps frameworks to optimize cloud spend, ensuring that architectural decisions align with financial efficiency and business value.
   

  

**Application \& SaaS Integration** 
 : Design of robust API\-led and event\-driven integration frameworks using tools like MuleSoft, Apigee, Tibco or Kafka.
   

  

 SaaS integration strategies for major platforms (Salesforce, Workday, SAP, ServiceNow) using iPaaS and Unified APIs.
   

  

 Enforce best practices for multi\-tenant SaaS architecture, including OAuth 2\.0 and secure identity management.
   

  

**Stakeholder Management** 
 : Serve as a trusted advisor to C\-suite executives, translating complex technical requirements into strategic business outcomes.
   

  

**Mentorship \& Governance** 
 : Establish architectural standards and mentor a high\-performing team of architects and engineers.
   

  

**About You**
**Experience** 
 : Minimum 15\+ years in IT, with at least 8 years in a Lead/Principal Architect role focused on Digital Integration and Cloud.
   

  

**Cloud Expertise** 
 : Deep hands\-on experience with Cloud Architecture (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS) and multi\-cloud strategies.
   

  

**Modernization Depth** 
 : Proven track record in Application Modernization, including refactoring legacy systems into microservices and serverless architectures.
   

  

**AI/ML Skills** 
 : Practical experience in delivering production\-grade AI\-enabled solutions, with knowledge of LLMs, vector databases, and AI\-native data integration.
   

  

**FinOps Proficiency** 
 : Strong understanding of FinOps principles, including cost modeling, forecasting, and resource optimization.
   

  

**Bachelor’s/Master’s Degree** 
 in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field.
   

  

 AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional / Google Professional Cloud Architect / Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert. FinOps Certified Practitioner (FCP) or FinOps Certified Architect OGAF 9\.2/10 Certification Databricks Certified Solutions Architect, Google Professional Data Engineer, or AWS Certified Machine Learning Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or SAFe Agilist (Leading SAFe).
   

  

 You bring a can\-do attitude, tackle challenges head\-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Global Opportunities: Work in multi\-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re\-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well\-being programs and benefits, diversity \& inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.


**Only Your Skills Matter**
 Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neuroatypia, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled\-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

* Experience with **Action Profiles, Condition Profiles, and Formulas**.

* Experience with **CTS\+ and QGM integration**.
* Strong troubleshooting and issue\-resolution skills.
* Good understanding of **ChaRM authorization and role management**.

Preferred Skills

* SAP Solution Manager upgrades and patch management.
* ChaRM reporting and KPI dashboards.
* Experience in enterprise SAP landscapes.
* Strong documentation and communication skills.
* Experience conducting user training and knowledge\-transfer sessions.

Candidate Profile

Candidates should have strong hands\-on expertise in **SAP Solution Manager ChaRM configuration and administration**, along with a good understanding of SAP transport management and governance processes. **Please apply with your updated resume highlighting your SAP Solution Manager and ChaRM experience.**

5e527b37.title: Senior CloudOps Engineer
5e527b37.description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------


Engineering the AI\-powered enterprise. With AI and cloud\-native solutions, BETSOL accelerates cloud transformation for enterprises across 17\+ countries. BETSOL holds several engineering patents, and is recognized with industry awards. BETSOL maintains a net promoter score that is 2x the industry average.


BETSOL’s open source backup and recovery product line, Zmanda (Zmanda.com), delivers up to 50% savings in total cost of ownership (TCO) and delivers best\-in\-class performance.


BETSOL Global IT Services (BETSOL.com) builds and supports end\-to\-end enterprise solutions, reducing time\-to\-market for customers.


BETSOL offices are set against the vibrant backdrops of Broomfield, Colorado and Bangalore \& Belagavi, India.


We take pride in being an employee\-centric organization, offering comprehensive benefits and opportunities.


Learn more at betsol.com

**Job Description**
-------------------

**About the Role**


You will join a technical pod building and operating cloud portal workloads across Azure and GCP. The center of gravity for this role is DevOps and DevSecOps: infrastructure as code, secure CI/CD pipelines, automation, and reliability engineering. You also pick up application\-level work on the portal itself when the team needs it, so full\-stack comfort is expected, not optional. You will work alongside a hands\-on Technical Team Leader and are expected to use AI\-first development practices daily.

**Responsibilities**

**Infrastructure as Code**

* Design, develop, and maintain reusable **Terraform** and **Ansible** modules for Azure and GCP.
* Enforce configuration standards and policy\-as\-code practices across environments.

**Cloud Engineering (Azure and GCP)**

* Build and operate scalable, secure Azure and GCP environments: **AKS/GKE, App Gateway, VNets, NSGs, Key Vault, Managed Identities**.
* Implement governance, cost optimization, and compliance controls across subscriptions and projects.

**CI/CD \& Automation**

* Build and optimize **Jenkins** and **GitHub Actions** pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment across environments.
* Implement blue/green, canary, and rollback deployment strategies with observability and alerting.

**DevSecOps \& Security**

* Integrate vulnerability scanning, code analysis, and compliance checks into CI/CD workflows.
* Manage secrets, certificates, and key material with secure vault solutions.
* Partner with security teams to align infrastructure with **FedRAMP, FIPS, ISO, PCI** standards.

**Application Work (Portal Use Cases)**

* Contribute to basic portal application code (modern JS/TS frontend, REST API endpoints, simple backend handlers) when the work calls for it.
* Wire applications into the platform: observability, secrets, auth, and deployment patterns the team has standardized on.

**Monitoring \& Reliability**

* Implement proactive monitoring with **Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Monitoring, Prometheus, Grafana, Log Analytics**.
* Define and tune SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets aligned to business outcomes.

**Collaboration \& Agile Practices**

* Partner with product and engineering teammates in agile ceremonies: planning, standups, retrospectives, release management, and post\-incident reviews

**Looking For**

* 5\+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability, or Platform Engineering, with full\-stack application exposure.

**Mandatory Skills**

**A. Technical Skills**

* Proven expertise on any of the following: **Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP** cloud architecture and automation.
* Hands\-on with **Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes**, and reusable module design.
* Strong with CI/CD tooling: **Jenkins or GitHub Actions**
* Familiarity with security frameworks.
* Experience with container security, image scanning, and supply chain security.
* Proficiency in scripting: **Bash, Python, or PowerShell**.
* Application\-level comfort: building or maintaining portal\-style web apps (modern JS/TS frontend plus a REST backend).
* Working fluency with **AI\-first development**: daily use of AI coding assistants, prompt and context discipline, comfort reviewing AI\-generated output for correctness and security.
* Excellent troubleshooting across infrastructure, network, and application layers

**B. Soft Skills**

* Strong written and verbal English; able to collaborate in US\-EST hours.
* Clear, accountable communicator.
* Strong problem\-solving instincts.
* **Ownership:** takes responsibility for end\-to\-end delivery.
* **Collaboration:** builds trust across teams and communicates transparently.
* **Adaptability:** adjusts quickly to new priorities and technologies.
* **Continuous learning:** proactively explores automation, AI, and new DevOps practices.
* **Security mindset:** integrates security at every stage of development and deployment.
* **Outcome focus:** measures success through reliability, speed, and cost efficiency.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Certifications: Azure (AZ\-104/AZ\-400\), GCP (Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer), CKA/CKAD, HashiCorp Terraform Associate.
* Prior experience in regulated environments (FedRAMP, BFSI, healthcare).
* Ansible
* ArgoCD
* Familiarity with security frameworks, such as: FedRAMP, FIPS, CIS Benchmarks, ISO, PCI.
* Full\-stack application fluency for portal use cases (modern JS/TS frontend, REST APIs, common backend frameworks).
**Qualifications**
------------------


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.

**Additional Information**

9fc36be0.title: Cloud Engineer / Solutions Architect – DevOps & IT
9fc36be0.description:
**Company Description** 
 Water Weaver Solutions (W2S) is a technology and consulting company founded by professionals with experience across both management and technical roles in large enterprises and small businesses.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on Cloud Engineer / Solutions Architect with 3\-5 years of experience to own our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and overall IT environment. The ideal candidate will design and operate workloads across both AWS and Azure, build and maintain deployment pipelines for multiple products, and act as the go\-to person in the team for anything infrastructure, networking, or IT\-related. This is a broad, ownership\-heavy role combining solutions architecture, DevOps engineering, and internal IT support.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 ·       Design, provision, and operate cloud infrastructure across both AWS and Azure including compute, storage, networking, databases, identity, and managed services.
 



 ·       Act as solutions architect for new initiatives like translate product and business requirements into well\-architected cloud designs covering scalability, security, availability, and cost.
 



 ·       Build, maintain, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines for multiple products using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps Pipelines.
 



 ·       Containerize applications using Docker and manage orchestration with Kubernetes (EKS / AKS) or equivalent managed services.
 



 ·       Define and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep, or similar tools.
 



 ·       Set up and operate observability logging, monitoring, alerting, and tracing, using tools such as CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or Datadog.
 



 ·       Own cloud and application security IAM, secrets management, network segmentation, vulnerability scanning, patching, and adherence to best practices.
 



 ·       Serve as the primary point of contact for the CISO / external security team, coordinate VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment \& Penetration Testing) cycles, ISO 27001 and similar certification audits, security questionnaires, and remediation of findings.
 



 ·       Manage office and product networking, VPNs, firewalls, DNS, SSL/TLS certificates, domain management, and connectivity between cloud and on\-prem environments.
 



 ·       Plan and execute backups, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures across cloud workloads.
 



 ·       Monitor and optimize cloud spend across AWS and Azure right\-sizing, reserved capacity, and cost reporting.
 



 ·       Collaborate closely with the Lead Developer, QA, and Product teams on release planning, environment management, and production rollouts.
 



 ·       Document architecture, runbooks, incident response procedures, and IT policies in Confluence or equivalent.
 



 ·       Respond to production incidents, conduct root cause analysis, and drive preventive improvements.
 



**Required Technical Skills** 




 ·       3–5 years of hands\-on experience as a Cloud / DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer, with proven exposure to both AWS and Azure in production environments.
 



 ·       Strong hands\-on with core AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudFront, Lambda, ECS/EKS) and Azure services (VMs, Storage, App Service, AKS, Azure SQL, VNet, Entra ID/Azure AD, Key Vault).
 



 ·       Solid experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines for multi\-service, multi\-environment deployments.
 



 ·       Hands\-on with Docker and at least one orchestration platform (Kubernetes, ECS, or AKS).
 



 ·       Proficient with Infrastructure as Code , Terraform, CloudFormation, or Azure ARM/Bicep.
 



 ·       Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation and tooling.
 



 ·       Good understanding of networking fundamentals , TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, VPN, firewalls, load balancers, and cloud networking constructs (VPC/VNet, subnets, security groups, NSGs).
 



 ·       Working knowledge of Linux system administration and basic Windows server administration.
 



 ·       Experience with monitoring and logging stacks , CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK, or Datadog.
 



 ·       Familiarity with cloud security best practices, IAM design, and tools such as AWS Config, GuardDuty, Azure Defender, or equivalent.
 



 ·       Experience coordinating VAPT engagements, supporting ISO 27001 / SOC 2 audits, and tracking security findings through to remediation.
 



 ·       Comfortable administering common SaaS tools used by the team , Google Workspace / Microsoft 365, Jira, Confluence, GitHub/GitLab, and identity providers (Okta, Entra ID).
 



**Preferred Qualifications** 




 ·       Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field.
 



 ·       Cloud certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, AWS DevOps Engineer, Azure Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent.
 



 ·       Experience with message queues and event\-driven architectures (SQS/SNS, Service Bus, Kafka, RabbitMQ).
 



 ·       Exposure to GCP or hybrid/multi\-cloud environments.
 



 ·       Experience supporting regulated or enterprise customers with audit, compliance, and security review requirements.
 



 ·       Interest or experience using GenAI / LLM tools to accelerate DevOps and IT workflows.
 



**What We're Looking For** 




 ·       Strong ownership mindset , treats infrastructure, pipelines, and IT as a product, not a ticket queue.
 



 ·       Broad generalist comfort , happy switching between cloud architecture, pipeline debugging, and helping a teammate fix their laptop on the same day.
 



 ·       Sharp troubleshooting skills across networking, infrastructure, and application layers.
 



 ·       Excellent documentation habits and proactive communication.
 



 ·       Comfortable being the team's first port of call for IT and infrastructure questions.
 



 ·       Bias for automation , prefers writing scripts and IaC over repeating manual work.

421ce525.title: Tech Delivery Lead – CDS Platform
421ce525.description:
**Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!**
**Who Are We?**
 For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
   

  

 For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L’Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty.
   

  

 Today, L’Oréal includes more than 2,000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.
   

  

 Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L’Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure.
   

  

**A Day in the Life of A** 
**Tech Delivery Lead – CDS Platform**
 As Tech Delivery Lead for CDS, you are the operational backbone of the application engineering team. While Tech Leads define how things are built, you ensure they get built — on time, to standard, and without chaos. You will bring structure and accountability to a fast\-growing internal team spanning API, data, and QA streams, and act as the connective tissue between engineering and the business. Beyond coordinating people, you will drive the team's evolution toward smarter ways of working — creating the conditions where AI\-assisted tooling, sound processes, and human expertise combine to deliver a stable, continuously improving platform. Your mission is to transform a technically capable but organizationally fragmented team into a high\-performing, predictable delivery machine — at a moment when CDS is expanding rapidly and stability is non negotiable.
   

  

**In this role, You will..**
* Delivery Coordination \& Team Leadership
* Own end\-to\-end delivery coordination for CDS across API, data, and QA streams — so no engineer works in isolation.
* Drive resource planning across all streams, including capacity allocation between API, data, and QA teams, to ensure the right balance of skills and effort is assigned to each sprint and project phase.
* Run and own all delivery rituals (standups, sprint planning, retrospectives, release reviews) and ensure they produce real outcomes, not ceremony.
* Maintain a live, shared view of what is in\-flight, what is at risk, and what is blocked — and act on it daily.
* Coordinate internal Tech Leads, Senior Developers, and QA while ensuring vendor and partner contributors are fully integrated into the delivery flow.
* Process Discipline \& Platform Stability
* Establish and enforce engineering processes — PR review gates, release checklists, incident response — so that standards are followed consistently, not aspirationally.
* Drive a measurable reduction in production incidents through structured change management and pre\-release quality gates.
* Identify recurring failure patterns early and drive root\-cause resolution rather than firefighting — leveraging available tooling and data to stay ahead of issues before they reach production.
* Foster new ways of working that combine engineering discipline with modern tooling, so the team continuously improves without adding unnecessary process weight.
* Build a culture where pressure is absorbed at the coordination layer, not passed down to individual contributors. C1 \- Internal use
* Stakeholder Communication \& Risk Management
* Serve as the primary delivery point of contact for the Product Owner and business stakeholders.
* Translate engineering status into business\-readable language: timelines, risks, trade\-offs, and commitments.
* Proactively surface delivery risks — scope, capacity, dependencies — before they escalate.
* Ensure the business always has an accurate, honest picture of where CDS stands — not a filtered one. 4\. Team Cohesion \& Organizational Scaling
* Build a culture of accountability and psychological safety across a mixed team of internal hires and vendor staff.
* Partner with Tech Leads to eliminate knowledge silos, ensure cross\-stream alignment, and prevent contributors from being left on their own.
* Champion a mindset of continuous improvement — encouraging the team to question how work gets done and adopt better approaches, including AI\-assisted workflows where they genuinely add value.
* Support onboarding of new senior hires and ongoing integration of partner teams into delivery workflows.
* Work closely with the IT Manager to anticipate capacity needs and flag organizational risks before they impact delivery.


**What are we looking for?**
**Technical Requirements**
* Programing Language: Java is preferred, with Python experience for data
* AI Tooling: Expert proficiency at Github Copliot or Claude Code or equivalent tools for accelerating the delivery work not limited to development, testing etc.
* Engineering Depth: Solid software engineering background — sufficient to earn Tech Lead trust, read technical risks, and hold credible conversations on API, data, and integration topics.
* Cloud \& Platform Familiarity: Working knowledge of cloud environments (GCP or Azure) and modern integration and data platform patterns.
* Delivery Tooling: Experience with ITSM and incident management (ServiceNow or equivalent) and delivery tracking platforms (Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar).
* Modern Tooling Fluency: Comfortable adopting and evaluating emerging tools — including AI assistants — and capable of guiding the team on when and how to use them effectively.
* QA \& Release Management: Understanding QA lifecycle management and what good test coverage and release confidence look like.
* Domain: Exposure to CRM or MarTech platforms is a strong plus. Soft Skills \& Qualifications C1 \- Internal use
* Experience: 15\+ years in software engineering, with 5\+ years leading delivery across multiple technical streams or teams.
* Leadership under pressure: Demonstrated ability to stabilize a stressed team, absorb organizational noise, and restore clarity of purpose.
* Intellectual curiosity: Genuinely interested in how work evolves — proactively exploring smarter ways of delivering, including through AI, automation, and process innovation.
* Communication: Equally fluent in engineering and business language — able to translate between the two without losing fidelity in either direction.
* Structure: A natural inclination toward process, follow\-through, and documentation — without creating bureaucracy for its own sake.
* Vendor management: Comfortable holding external partners to delivery standards while maintaining a productive relationship.
* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.


 We would love to find out more about you as a candidate and we do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices. The beauty we find in our differences gives us the freedom to go beyond. That’s the beauty of L’Oréal.

Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. Overview of Job Function:
As a key member of Professional Services, the role of the Program Manager is to serve as a customer advocate and is responsible for managing a diverse portfolio of strategic or enterprise programs requiring the implementation and enablement of Verint technology solutions across all product lines. These programs are managed within an established budget, defined scope and forecasted timeline, to consistently achieve program margin and other financial targets and maintain a high level of customer satisfaction throughout the program life cycle. Additionally, the Program Manager is responsible for building and maintaining ongoing internal and customer relationships, while developing and earning the trust of all program stakeholders. The Program Manager has an advanced understanding of the Verint product suite, of the delivery process, and can manage complex engagements with a broad range of internal and customer stakeholders, potentially including third\-party providers and other vendors.


Principal Duties and Essential Responsibilities:
* Manages complex program\-level engagements and implementations.
* Responsible for program objectives, defined scope and achieving the conditions of success that serve as major program milestones and require interim or final customer sign\-off for approval.
