1f9fa677.title: Senior Solutions Engineer (India)
1f9fa677.description:
Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.
   

  

 We are a globally distributed, remote\-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Solutions Engineer** 
 with strong technical credibility and the ability to operate across direct enterprise, partner, and developer community motions in one of Docker's highest\-priority APAC markets. India is Docker's third\-largest APAC market and home to the world's second\-largest developer community, combining a massive open\-source ecosystem, a large IT services sector, and a high\-growth enterprise segment.
   

  

 This role requires an SE who can engage Fortune\-equivalent enterprises directly, enable a diverse channel partner ecosystem, and build authentic presence in one of the world's most active developer communities. The scope extends beyond India, with periodic travel to Southeast Asia to support regional coverage.
   

  

 This role reports to the SE Leader, APAC.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Partner Enablement and Channel Development
   

  

* Enable and co\-sell with Docker's channel partner ecosystem to deliver technical coverage across India's diverse partner landscape, including large SIs, IT services companies, regional VARs, and hyperscaler partner teams.
* Run joint partner workshops, technical enablement sessions, and solution briefings to build partner SE capability.
* Support partner\-led opportunities with architectural depth, PoC support, and competitive differentiation.
* Develop and maintain partner\-ready technical assets: demo environments, reference architectures, and enablement decks.
* Build strong working relationships with key SI, IT services, and reseller contacts across India's channel ecosystem, where the same organisations often represent both partner and customer opportunities.
* Support pipeline development across both direct and partner\-sourced opportunities.


 Evangelist and Community Presence
   

  

* Build Docker's technical presence across India's developer and DevSecOps community, spanning major tech hubs including Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Delhi NCR, and Mumbai.
* Speak at industry and partner\-organised conferences, including India's growing DevSecOps, cloud\-native, and AI developer circuit.
* Produce technical content — blog posts, how\-to guides, and solution briefs — that addresses gaps in Docker documentation and resonates with the India developer community.
* Represent Docker at meetups, developer days, and hackathons to drive awareness and top\-of\-funnel interest.


 Strategic Customer Engagement
   

  

* Lead deep technical discovery across Platform Engineering, DevOps, Security, and AI teams at strategic accounts to understand:
+ AI governance requirements and agentic development workflows
+ Software supply chain risk and secure build pipeline needs
+ Regulatory and compliance drivers relevant to the Indian market (DPDP Act, CERT\-In, RBI circulars for BFSI, SEBI for capital markets, MeitY requirements for public sector)
+ Container security posture and DevSecOps maturity

* Design, position, and execute structured PoCs/PoVs with clear success criteria and executive\-ready value summaries.
* Influence buying decisions through demos, workshops, architecture reviews, and technical executive briefings.
* Translate Docker's AI security and governance capabilities into business value narratives for CISOs, Heads of Platform Engineering, and AI leaders.
* Build and maintain relationships with technical champions across Security, DevOps, Platform, and AI teams at key accounts.
* Support renewal and expansion motions by maintaining engagement beyond the initial sale on key accounts.


 AI Solutions Advocacy
   

  

* Position and demonstrate Docker's AI portfolio as the governance and security layer for modern AI\-native development:
+ Docker MCP Gateway: policy enforcement for MCP tool calls in agentic AI development workflows
+ Docker AI Governance (GA May 2026\): model lifecycle management, AI workload governance, and compliance controls
+ Docker Hardened Images (DHI): secure, continuously patched base images for AI model serving and application containers
+ Docker Sandbox (SBX): free microVM\-based agent isolation for developer\-facing AI coding workflows

* Guide customers in implementing AI governance controls across their SDLC, with particular focus on securing agentic development environments.
* Act as a subject matter expert on secure software supply chain, container security, and AI security trends in customer\-facing and community engagements.
* Provide architectural guidance for policy\-as\-code enforcement, identity and access governance for AI workloads, and SBOM visibility.
* Develop reusable technical assets — workshops, demos, and reference architectures — to scale impact across the channel and direct accounts.
* Advocate for India customer and partner needs with Product and Engineering, providing structured feedback from field experience.


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* Proven experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Solution Architect, or Developer Advocate in a technical sales or community\-facing role.
* Familiarity with AI security, AI governance frameworks, or secure software supply chain practices. Direct experience with agentic AI development workflows is a plus.
* Solid understanding of containers, DevOps, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and modern application architectures.
* Comfortable operating across both enterprise customer engagements and developer community contexts.
* Strong communication and influencing skills across technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience with partner or channel selling motions, co\-selling with resellers, SIs, or distributors, or running partner enablement programs.
* Familiarity with India's enterprise technology landscape, including IT services companies, large SIs, and the startup/scale\-up segment.
* Willingness to travel domestically across India's major tech hubs, with occasional travel to Southeast Asia (primarily Singapore) for regional coverage.


**Preferred**
* Experience with Docker, container ecosystems, or adjacent technologies.
* Public speaking, developer advocacy, conference presenting, or technical content creation experience.
* Familiarity with agentic AI development, MCP tooling, or AI governance frameworks.
* Experience running competitive PoCs/PoVs with clearly defined success and exit criteria.
* Understanding of India\-specific compliance requirements, including DPDP Act, CERT\-In, RBI, and MeitY.
* Familiarity with India's IT services and SI ecosystem.


**What To Expect**
 First 30 Days
   

  

* Onboarding with equipment setup, Docker tools training (Salesforce, Opine, Sigma), and peer pairing with the broader APAC SE team.
* Meet key channel partner contacts, SI leads, and distributor relationships across India.
* Review open pipeline, account history, and any pending handovers from prior SE coverage.
* Begin building familiarity with Docker's AI portfolio: MCP Gateway, AI Gov, DHI, and SBX.


 First 60 Days
   

  

* Deliver first partner enablement session with a key channel partner or SI.
* Engage actively with strategic accounts and participate in live customer opportunities.
* Develop a view of the India community calendar and identify a first speaking or content opportunity.
* Gain in\-depth knowledge of Docker products and how they map to Indian customer priorities.


 First 90 Days
   

  

* Operating independently across partner, customer, and community motions.
* First community content piece or event appearance confirmed or delivered.
* Clear account handover completed and relationships established at key strategic accounts.
* Contributing to the India SE coverage plan and providing product feedback from the field.


***Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.***
**Perks**
* Freedom \& flexibility; fit your work around your life
* Designated quarterly Whaleness Days plus end of year Whaleness break
* Home office setup; we want you comfortable while you work
* 16 weeks of paid Parental leave (after 6 months of employment)
* Technology stipend equivalent to $100 USD net/month
* PTO plan that encourages you to take time to do the things you enjoy
* Training stipend for conferences, courses and classes
* Equity; we are a growing start\-up and want all employees to have a share in the success of the company
* Docker Swag
* Medical benefits, retirement and holidays vary by country
* Remote\-first culture, with offices in Seattle and Paris


 Docker embraces diversity and equal opportunity. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our company will be.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, CX teams, IT teams, data teams, vendors and regional users to translate business requirements into scalable Medallia solutions and ensure high\-quality platform operations across global or regional deployments. **Key Responsibilities:*** Lead the Medallia platform team responsible for configuration, administration, support, enhancement delivery and operational governance of Medallia programs.

* Minimum 3\-5 years of practical experience with Medallia platform implementation, integration, configuration, administration, support or program management.

* Experience working in global transformation programs, multi\-country rollouts, managed service environments or distributed delivery teams is preferred.

d43f2448.title: Cloud Engineer, Specialist
d43f2448.description:
Provides advanced level technical support for complex projects. Troubleshoots, diagnoses, and resolves hardware or software issues that span multiple technology domains, as elevated from the team. Develops technical standards and documentation.
   

  

**About Vanguard**
 Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
   

  

******Vanguard’s India Office******
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 This role provides advanced level technical support for complex projects. Troubleshoots, diagnoses, and resolves hardware or software issues that span multiple technology domains, as elevated from the team. Develops technical standards and documentation, enforces security best practices, supports disaster recovery and collaborates with teams to align cloud solutions with business needs.
   

  

**Responsibilites**
* Designs, implements, and deploys cloud platforms to support and meet business needs. Identifies, recommends, and implements opportunities for improvement and performance issue solutions.
* Provides advanced level technical support and ensures reliable operation of cloud production. Troubleshoots software systems on multiple cloud computing platforms and system integration into existing cloud computing platforms. Maintains comprehensive technical knowledge of software and infrastructure platforms.
* Develops technical standards. Tests and evaluates IT vendor products. Reviews configuration parameters to optimize system performance and maximize operation uptime
* Elevates code into the development, test, and cloud production environments on schedule. Provides follow up production support. Submits change control requests and documents.
* Learns and understands client area business functions and requirements. Determines the appropriate technical tool to address the client's business needs.
* Trains and mentors more junior staff on processes and releases. Troubleshoots and resolves complex issues elevated from staff. Provides guidance and consultation as required. Updates, writes, and maintains documentation for the department.
* Administers system activities. Writes the technical portion of assigned deliverables. Performs systems analysis, including system requirements analysis and definition, and logical design.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Maintains the security of cloud infrastructure, ensuring compliance with both internal governance standards and relevant regulatory requirements.
* Oversees and monitors hybrid cloud environments, ensuring optimal performance, uptime, and efficient resource utilization.
* Develops and implements automation scripts and tools to streamline deployment, configuration, and scaling of cloud\-based resources.

**Role description** **About the Role**



We are looking for a Senior Automation Architect to lead our test automation strategy across UI, API, and data testing. You will design scalable automation frameworks, drive tooling decisions, integrate quality into CI/CD pipelines, lead data lake and ETL validation efforts, and mentor engineering teams. This is a hands\-on leadership role requiring strong technical depth in both application and data testing, with the ability to deliver quality at speed.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Architect and maintain automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver (Java), Playwright, and REST Assured, applying design patterns like Page Object Model and BDD.
* Design and implement API test suites covering functional, contract, schema, and negative testing using REST Assured and Postman/Newman.
* Build and optimize CI/CD test pipelines in GitHub Actions (workflows, reusable actions, matrix strategies), Jenkins, and AWS pipelines (CodePipeline, CodeBuild) with parallel execution, quality gates, and containerized test environments (Docker/K8s).
* Leverage AWS infrastructure (EC2, ECS, S3, Lambda, CodePipeline, CloudWatch) for provisioning scalable test environments, storing test artifacts, and monitoring pipeline health.
* Possess strong knowledge of performance testing tools and methodologies including JMeter (distributed mode, custom plugins, correlation), Gatling, or k6 with the ability to support load, stress, soak, spike, and scalability testing efforts through throughput/latency analysis and bottleneck identification.
* Design data validation frameworks for SQL/NoSQL databases, including SQL script optimization (query tuning, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies) and ETL/data pipeline validation for data migration and warehousing verification.
* Lead AWS Data Lake testing across S3, Glue, Athena, and Redshift validating data ingestion, transformation, storage, and query accuracy across the data pipeline.
* Define and implement ODS (Operational Data Store) architecture validation strategies, ensuring data consistency, completeness, and integrity across source\-to\-target flows.
* Own and maintain the enterprise test automation strategy and roadmap, including framework selection rationale, coverage goals, tooling decisions, and long\-term evolution plans ensuring alignment with product and engineering leadership.
* Define automation standards, conduct code reviews, and mentor QA engineers and SDETs across teams.
* Evaluate emerging tools and AI\-driven testing approaches; leverage GitHub Copilot for accelerated test code generation, code reviews, and productivity improvements across automation teams.


**Technical Skills Matrix**


**UI Automation :** Selenium WebDriver (Java), Playwright (TypeScript/Java), TestNG, JUnit 5, Cucumber BDD


**API Testing :** REST Assured, Postman/Newman, Contract Testing (Pact)

**CI/CD \& DevOps :** GitHub Actions (workflows, reusable actions, matrix builds), Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes

**Database \& SQL :** SQL (complex queries, stored procedures, query optimization, execution plans, indexing strategies), MongoDB, ETL/data pipeline validation, data warehousing concepts, ODS architecture


**AWS Data \& Analytics :** S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift validation, Data Lake testing, CodePipeline

  


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 16\+ years of hands\-on QA and test automation experience with a strong focus on data testing and automation, and at least 5\-6 years in an architect or lead role.
* Strong expertise in SQL complex queries, stored procedures, query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure performance for database\-heavy applications.
* Advanced hands\-on experience in Java programming with deep expertise in Selenium WebDriver and strong proficiency in Playwright for modern browser automation.
* Strong experience in automation frameworks: TestNG, BDD (Cucumber), with proven experience in designing and maintaining scalable automation frameworks using design patterns (POM, Factory, Strategy).
* Mandatory hands\-on experience in AWS Data Lake testing (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift validation) and strong experience in ETL/data pipeline validation and data warehousing concepts.
* Strong understanding of ODS architecture and data validation strategies, including source\-to\-target reconciliation and data integrity checks.
* Advanced API testing experience with REST Assured including authentication flows (OAuth2, JWT), response chaining, and schema validation.
* Hands\-on CI/CD pipeline engineering with GitHub Actions (workflows, reusable actions, self\-hosted runners) and Jenkins, using Docker/Kubernetes\-based test environments.
* Strong working knowledge of AWS infrastructure (EC2, ECS, S3, Lambda, CodePipeline, CloudWatch) for test environment provisioning and pipeline orchestration.
* Working knowledge of performance testing tools and methodologies (JMeter, Gatling, k6\) with the ability to support load and scalability testing efforts.
* Hands\-on experience with GitHub Copilot for AI\-assisted test code generation, code reviews, and driving developer productivity across automation teams.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical decisions at the leadership level.


**Nice to Have**


* Experience with performance testing tools (JMeter distributed testing, Gatling, k6\) including load modeling, throughput/latency analysis, and bottleneck identification.
* Experience with mobile automation using Appium (Android/iOS) and cloud device farm integrations (BrowserStack, Sauce Labs).
* Experience building test observability dashboards (Allure, Grafana, Kibana) for tracking pass rates, flakiness, execution trends, and defect density.

abaf2f05.title: Program Manager II,IN Relay Ops, APEX IN Relay Operations
abaf2f05.description:
**Description**
 Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer\-centric company? If so, meet Amazon.
   

  

 Over the past 20\+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products (like Echo) and, enterprise services (like Amazon Web Services). APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon's transportation network. It ensures hassle free, timely pick\-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
   

  

 Overall, Relay Ops plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
   

  

 Responsibilities of Manager I under Relay Ops/NOC
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Manager to coordinate and lead efforts across operations, multiple technology and program teams. We're looking for a hands\-on and motivated self\-starter who's passionate about using data to help us measure every area of the business, drive efficiencies, optimizations and influence decision\-making.
   

  

 A Manager I is expected to have deep functional knowledge, ability to design new program frameworks/processes and running defect reduction programs. He should be proficient, in identifying the input and output metric to gauge the success of a program. In this role, he will work with business and operations team to analyze historic results, challenge status quo and make business recommendations to senior management based on those analyses – all in an environment of rapid growth and increasing complexity. The Manager will drive improvements to the reporting tools, methods, and processes utilized by the team to increase the availability and granularity of actionable data to internal and external partners.
   

  

 The successful candidate must have very strong analytical skills and expert in excel. Knowledge of SQL and tools like R/Python would be an added advantage. He/she will be experienced at working with large data sets and the technical tools needed to work with them. He/she will have superb communication and customer\-relationship skills, good analytic insight, and be a passionate advocate of operations team to other stakeholders. He/she will drive towards simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have excellent project\-management skills, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy\-to\-understand way.
   

  

 What are we really looking for?
   

  

* You should be very analytical and be able to justify your decisions and approaches with data
* You should be able to deal with a high degree of ambiguity
* You should be able to take a complex problem and break it down to smaller digestible chunks
* You should be able to define a logical and step by step approach to achieving assigned goals
* You should be comfortable with processes and process design/analysis
* You should have the ability to influence without authority and do so by using data and facts
* You should be able to deal with varied stakeholders and earn their trust
* You are mature and able to function independently with limited guidance
* You should be willing to work in rotational shifts
* Languages proficiency (mandatory) – English.


**The Manager I Is Required To**
* Cost Reduction Strategy:
* Develop and implement strategies to reduce costs in the transportation business


 (ii) Analyze and optimize adhoc share, number of trips, and truck utilization
   

  

 (iii) Participate in and contribute to WBR meetings with the core group
   

  

* Network Optimization:
* Work on improving network design
* Optimize NOC Governance Mechanism
* Improve RLB adoption and truck utilization
* Forecasting and Scheduling:
* Enhance and expand Forecast Based Scheduling (FBS) feature
* Analyze and act on Frequent Adhoc \& Frequent Cancellation (FAFC) trends
* Optimize schedule capacity and reduce adhoc share
* Cost per Trip Reduction:
* Address issues leading to increased cost per trip collaborate with all the miles to reduce unloading delays
* Improve RLB conversion rates and manage manual adhoc rates
* Truck Utilization Improvement:
* Continue efforts to increase average totes per trip
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve fill rates
* Process Standardization and Improvement:
* Standardize stacking height for palletized loading
* Develop and implement SOPs for improved asset handling and transfer
* Cross\-functional Collaboration:
* Work closely with FC, SC, EWH, and other teams to implement improvements
* Coordinate with tech teams for necessary system enhancements
* Manage stakeholder relationships and secure buy\-in for new initiatives
* Data Analysis and Reporting:
* Conduct cost\-benefit analyses for proposed initiatives
* Create and maintain performance dashboards
* Provide regular updates on KPIs and project progress
* Continuous Improvement:
* Identify new opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvement
* Plan and execute pilot projects to test new ideas
* Scale successful initiatives across the network


 This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, analytical skills, project management expertise, and strong cross\-functional leadership to drive significant improvements in the linehaul network's efficiency and cost\-effectiveness.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The incumbent will own the following \-
   

  

* They will be responsible for working with supply chain execution, transportation, QC FC, carriers and other Amazon teams to identify pain points and scope out large high impact projects
* They will be responsible for driving cost benefit analysis and go/no\-go decisions on various initiatives
* Once a go decision is made, the program manager will work to evolve a plan and timeline for execution.
* The program manager will develop a roadmap and metrics to measure progress of the initiative they own. They will also own writing reports that detail the progress to leadership on a frequent basis
* They will liaise across functions to drive their project and help clear issues and bottlenecks.
* They will work with technology teams to scope out and drive any tech changes that are needed


 A day in the life
   

  

 Daily activities include leading team towards betterment of the QC Transportation Supply Chain operations
   

  

**About The Team**
 NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick\-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem\-solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. 8b05cb0a.description:
**Job Description**
 The Application Support Engineer – CSD Division will be responsible for providing technical and application support for Agilent's Chemistries and Supplies Division (CSD) portfolio, including chromatography columns, sample preparation products, consumables, reagents, and workflow solutions. The role focuses on enabling customer success through application consulting, method optimization support, troubleshooting, customer training, and close collaboration with sales, service, and product teams.
   

  

 The successful candidate will possess strong analytical chemistry knowledge, hands\-on experience with chromatography workflows, excellent problem\-solving capabilities, and a customer\-centric mindset. This position plays a critical role in helping customers maximize the performance and value of Agilent CSD products while driving customer satisfaction and business growth.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Application \& Technical Support**
* Serve as the primary technical resource for customer inquiries related to Agilent CSD products including HPLC, LC/MS, GC, GC/MS columns, sample preparation products, standards, reagents, and laboratory consumables.
* Provide application guidance and troubleshooting support for chromatography workflows and analytical challenges.
* Assist customers in achieving optimal method performance through product selection and application recommendations.
* Support issue resolution by working closely with customers, field service engineers, and technical support teams.


**Method Development \& Optimization**
* Support customers in developing, transferring, and optimizing analytical methods using Agilent chromatography columns and consumables.
* Provide recommendations on sample preparation, chromatographic separation, method robustness, and productivity improvements.
* Demonstrate best practices for improving analytical performance and laboratory efficiency.


**Customer Training \& Education**
* Conduct customer training programs, workshops, seminars, and webinars on chromatography applications and consumable usage.
* Develop and deliver application\-focused educational content, including technical guides, application notes, presentations, and training materials.
* Promote best practices for method development, troubleshooting, and instrument\-consumable integration.


**Customer Engagement \& Success**
* Partner with sales teams to understand customer requirements and provide application consultation.
* Build strong relationships with customers across pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, environmental, food, chemical, forensic, academic, and contract testing laboratories.
* Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction through proactive follow\-up and continuous technical support.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer workflows and laboratory productivity using Agilent solutions.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Service, Product Management, and Global Application teams to address customer needs.
* Provide customer feedback, market intelligence, and application insights to support product development and portfolio enhancement initiatives.
* Support new product introductions and technical marketing activities.


**Market \& Competitive Intelligence**
* Stay current with industry trends, regulatory developments, emerging analytical techniques, and competitive technologies.
* Monitor application trends in chromatography and related analytical workflows.
* Support business growth initiatives through identification of customer challenges and opportunities.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.


**Experience**
* Minimum 5 years of relevant laboratory, applications, technical support, or customer\-facing experience.
* Hands\-on experience with HPLC, UHPLC, LC/MS, GC, and/or GC/MS techniques.
* Experience in method development, troubleshooting, and analytical workflow optimization.
* Knowledge of chromatography consumables, sample preparation products, and related laboratory workflows is highly desirable.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong understanding of chromatographic theory and analytical chemistry principles.
* Ability to troubleshoot analytical methods and chromatography\-related issues.
* Familiarity with pharmaceutical, environmental, food, chemical, or applied markets.
* Proficiency in scientific data interpretation and problem\-solving.


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong presentation and customer engagement capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively in cross\-functional and multicultural environments.
* Customer\-focused approach with a passion for helping customers succeed.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting chromatography columns and sample\-preparation products.
* Prior experience in applications support, technical sales support, or customer success roles.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver customer training and technical seminars.

 This job has a full time weekly schedule.

 The consultant will work closely with client stakeholders, onshore and offshore teams, and cross\-functional Oracle HCM consultants to deliver solutions that align with business requirements and Oracle leading practices.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Participate in client discovery, business process discussions, fit\-gap analysis, and business requirement gathering sessions

* Perform hands\-on configuration of Oracle Cloud Payroll

* Work with technical and cross\-functional teams to prepare Functional Solution Designs (FSDs) for integrations, reports, Fast Formulas, data conversions, and application enhancements. Drive functional specifications, support unit testing, validate delivered solutions, and troubleshoot implementation issues

* Define System Integration Testing (SIT) scenarios, coordinate end\-to\-end testing across Payroll, Core HR, Time and Labor, Absence Management, Benefits, Compensation, and Finance/General Ledger, validate integrated business processes, and drive resolution of defects identified during SIT
* Participate in Conference Room Pilots (CRPs) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), supporting business validation and resolution of functional issues
* Support Parallel Payroll testing by executing payroll reconciliation and payroll variance analysis, validating payroll calculations, balances, taxes, earnings, deductions, costing, and payroll results to ensure production readiness
* Conduct remote client\-facing knowledge transfer sessions, configuration walkthroughs, and solution validation meetings
* Support payroll cutover, production deployment, and approximately 30 days of post\-go\-live stabilization by investigating and resolving functional issues identified during deployment and production support

89418843.title: Ginesys One - Cloud Architect - Azure Kubernetes Service
89418843.description:
**Job Title :** 
 Senior Cloud Platform Engineer
   

  

**Level :** 
 L3 \- Senior
   

  

**Department :** 
 Platform Engineering
   

  

**Reporting To :** 
 Cloud Platform Architect
   

  

**Collaborates With :** 
 Principal Architect, Product Heads, DevOps, Security
   

  

**Experience :** 
 5\-8 years (3\+ years in cloud\-native / Azure architecture)
   

  

**Employment Type :** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Location :** 
 Kolkata
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Senior Cloud Platform Engineer is the primary owner of the modern application platform for the Ginesys One retail SaaS suite. The core mandate is to design, build, and continuously evolve a container\-native platform on Azure making it scalable, stable, and manageable at SaaS scale. This role leads AKS adoption across Ginesys One product services, drives CI/CD maturity, and works closely with the Cloud Platform Architect to ensure the platform aligns with the Well\-Architected Framework. It serves as the primary technical escalation point for platform engineering decisions.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* AKS \& Modern Application Platform :
* Own the design, deployment, and evolution of Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) as the primary hosting platform for Ginesys One product services.
* Assess containerisation readiness of individual product services; define and drive the migration path from IaaS to AKS.
* Design cluster topology for SaaS scale \- multi\-tenancy, node pools, namespaces, resource quotas, and auto\-scaling policies (HPA / VPA / KEDA).
* Architect for platform stability \- define pod disruption budgets, liveness/readiness probes, graceful drain, and upgrade strategies.
* Design for manageability \- standardise Helm chart structures, config management, and environment promotion across dev/staging/prod.
* Collaborate with product engineering teams to align container and service design with platform capabilities.
* Work with the Security team to baseline AKS security \- RBAC, network policies, pod security standards, and image scanning policies.
* CI/CD \& DevOps Engineering :
* Design and own the CI/CD pipeline architecture for all Ginesys One product services running on the platform.
* Establish pipeline standards \- build, test, security scan, image publish, and deployment stages using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Implement GitOps practices for AKS workload delivery; evaluate and adopt tooling such as Flux or ArgoCD.
* Define environment promotion gates \- automated quality, compliance, and rollback triggers between dev, staging, and production.
* Drive IaC adoption using Terraform or Bicep for all platform infrastructure; enforce version control and peer\-review discipline.
* Establish release management standards \- versioning, changelogs, blue\-green and canary deployment patterns.
* Scalability, Stability \& Platform Architecture :
* Collaborate with the Cloud Platform Architect and Principal Architect on platform roadmap and architecture decisions.
* Design for horizontal and vertical scalability \- workload\-aware auto\-scaling, cluster auto\-provisioner, and burst capacity strategies.
* Conduct architecture reviews and produce Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for significant platform changes.
* Evaluate new Azure and CNCF ecosystem capabilities; recommend adoption where they improve scalability, stability, or manageability.
* Contribute to Well\-Architected Framework reviews \- with focus on Reliability, Operational Excellence, and Performance Efficiency.
* Networking Optimisation \- Placement \& Grouping :
* Design and optimise VNet topology \- hub\-spoke architecture, peering, and segmentation for AKS and supporting services.
* Define subnet placement strategy aligned to workload classification (prod, non\-prod, data, app, management).
* Evaluate and implement private endpoints, service endpoints, and DNS private zones for PaaS services.
* Optimise egress paths, NAT gateway usage, and bandwidth cost.
* Review NSG rule sets for operational efficiency and correctness; coordinate with the Security team for hardening.
* Disaster Recovery \& High Availability :
* Define RTO/RPO targets per product tier in alignment with business requirements.
* Design and document DR architecture \- geo\-redundancy, backup strategy, failover procedures.
* Implement and periodically test HA configurations for critical workloads (DB clusters, AKS, app tiers).
* Establish and validate runbooks for partial, complete, and degraded\-performance outage scenarios.
* Cost Estimation, Budgeting \& Optimisation :
* Produce Azure cost models for new architectures and migration scenarios using Azure Pricing Calculator and Retail Prices API.
* Conduct monthly cost reviews; identify and act on rightsizing, reserved instance, and savings plan opportunities.
* Define cost allocation tagging taxonomy and governance; ensure 100% tag compliance.
* Present cost vs. architecture trade\-offs to stakeholders for informed decision\-making.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
* Area : AKS / Containers : AKS design and operations; Docker; Helm; Kubernetes networking, scaling, upgrades (MUST HAVE).
* Area : CI/CD \& DevOps : Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions; GitOps (Flux / ArgoCD); release management; Jenkins.
* Area : IaC : Terraform or Bicep \- production\-grade, version\-controlled infrastructure (MUST HAVE).
* Area : Cloud Platform : Azure \- advanced IaaS/PaaS, architecture patterns, landing zones.
* Area : Networking : Hub\-spoke VNet design, NSG, DNS, private endpoints, routing concepts.
* Area : DR / HA : Azure Site Recovery, geo\-redundancy, backup design, RTO/RPO modelling.
* Area : Multi\-cloud : AWS / GCP architecture awareness \- strong added advantage.
* Area : OS / Infra : Windows Server \& Linux \- working knowledge; not a primary focus.
* Area : WAF / Security : Well\-Architected Framework; Defender for Cloud, RBAC, WAF \- knowledge is a plus.
* Area : Observability : Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Prometheus, Grafana, APM \- knowledge is a plus.


**Certifications**
* AZ\-104 \+ AZ\-305 : Required (Solutions Architect Expert strongly preferred).
* CKA / CKAD (Kubernetes) : Preferred.
* AZ\-400 (DevOps Engineer) : Preferred.
* AZ\-700 (Network Engineer) : Preferred.
* AZ\-500 (Security Engineer) : Good to have.
* AWS Solutions Architect Associate / GCP Professional Cloud Architect \- significant advantage.


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Systems thinking \- sees platform\-wide implications of individual design choices.
* Collaborative by default \- designs are shaped with teams, not handed to them.
* Bias for documentation \- decisions, trade\-offs, and designs are written down.
* Cost\-aware engineering \- considers financial impact as a first\-class design constraint.
* Mentorship \- actively raises the technical bar of the L1/L2 operations team.
* Vendor\-neutral judgement \- selects the right tool, not the familiar one.

1b70c0b2.title: Senior Program Manager, Last Mile Analytics and Quality
1b70c0b2.description:
**Description**
 Amazon, a Fortune 500 company based in Seattle, Washington, is the global leader in e\-commerce. Since Jeff Bezos started Amazon in 1995, we have significantly expanded our product offerings, international sites, and worldwide network of fulfillment and customer service centers. Today, Amazon offers everything from books and electronics to tennis rackets and diamond jewelry. We operate sites in Canada, China, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, Spain and United Kingdom and maintain dozens of fulfillment centers around the world which encompass more than 26 million square feet.
   

  

 Amazon’s Last Mile Analytics \& Quality team is looking for an enthusiastic, customer obsessed Program Manager to manage projects, implement and improve metrics, work in collaboration with Amazon’s technology, product, business and operations teams to create solutions for our internal and external customers.
   

  

 To be successful in this role, you need a passion for making data driven decisions which will have direct impact on the customer experience. Some keys to your success are the ability to be an effective communicator to various audiences. The ability to remain flexible and adept to learning new tools and systems is instrumental your role on the team. Our environment is deadline driven, fast paced and requires you to be detail\-oriented and comfortable interacting or working with multiple teams (business and technical).
   

  

 The ideal candidate has a background of running large, cross\-functional projects. The candidate is as comfortable working on high\-level strategy and design, as they are rolling\-up their sleeves and working on implementation. They have demonstrated the ability to build customized logistics solutions, drive process improvement, standardize procedures and eliminate the root cause of defects within current systems. This job will require strong communication skills while having the ability to work independently in a high pressure, and often ambiguous, work environment. Passion and drive for customer service is a must. The candidate must be able to accurately prioritize projects, make sound judgments, work to improve the customer experience, and get the right things done.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Program manage the solution for last mile related problems from identification, scoping and sizing to creating long term solutions in partnership with tech, product, business and operations.
* Define success criteria for programs and audits processes and create/ drive right metrics to track and influence program health.
* Collaborate with multiple teams as a subject matter expert in Transportation and logistics domain and develop solutions that utilize the highest standards of analytical rigor, data integrity and solves problem for the long term.
* Identify, develop, manage, and execute analyses to uncover areas of opportunity and present written business recommendations.
* Analyze and solve business problems alongside product, tech, policy stakeholders.


 A day in the life
   

  

**Role**
 As a Sr. Program Manager in this role, daily activities would encompass activities involving designing program strategy as well as ensuring rapid execution globally. This typically includes:
   

  

* Strategy Development: Develop and implement a comprehensive program strategy aligned with the organization's goals and objectives. This involves defining the scope, objectives, and metrics for measuring program outcomes.
* Data Collection and Analysis: Oversee the collection, consolidation, and analysis of data from multiple sources. Develop and implement methodologies for data cleansing, segmentation, and analysis to derive actionable insights for business stakeholder teams.
* Insight Generation: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to interpret and prioritize insights, and develop strategies to enable stakeholder team address pain points and improve customer experiences on long term basis.
* Global Rollout and Optimization: Lead the global rollout and continuous optimization of the program across different regions, markets, and business units. Ensure consistency in strategy, quality, and methodologies while accounting for business and regional nuances.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, such as product, tech and operations, to communicate insights to leadership and drive decision\-making.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

**Senior Consultant – GOLD SaaS Managed Services**
==================================================

**About Us**
------------


SymphonyAI is a leading enterprise AI solutions provider helping retailers and manufacturers optimize business operations through advanced analytics, planning, and automation solutions. Our products support global organizations in improving supply chain efficiency, inventory performance, forecasting accuracy, and customer satisfaction.
We are committed to delivering measurable outcomes for our clients through innovative technology, deep domain expertise, and strong customer partnerships.**Job Description**
-------------------

We are looking for a Senior Consultant to deliver Symphony GOLD SaaS managed services across a portfolio of North American grocery accounts as the managed\-services organization's US\-based engineer — providing local coverage during US business hours, on\-site presence for critical escalations, and the primary technical interface between US customers and the global managed\-services organization.
The consultant concurrently serves 8–9 US and Canadian retailers with distinct GOLD configurations. The role's structural value is the combination of account breadth, local US presence, and cross\-region coordination with global teams across time zones.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Portfolio Managed Services**


Deliver SaaS managed services across 8–9 concurrent North American GOLD accounts as first line of technical expertise.
Provide production support during US business hours: batch monitoring, incident triage and management, complex application troubleshooting.
Maintain per\-account configuration knowledge across the portfolio, including customer\-specific implementations.

### **Local Presence \& Coordination**


Act as primary technical interface between US customers and the global managed\-services organization, coordinating across time zones.
Provide local, on\-site support for critical customer escalations and build customer relationships through regular communication and technical guidance.
Coordinate with project teams, R\&D, Cloud Operations, and customer technical teams for timely resolution.### **Technical Delivery**


Support customer upgrades, deployments, production changes, and stabilization activities.
Perform production investigations and root\-cause analysis (Oracle SQL/PL\-SQL, Linux/shell, log analysis).**Qualifications**
------------------


5\+ years of SaaS managed\-services experience on Symphony GOLD or an equivalent renowned, market\-established and referenceable SCM solution, on North American retail accounts, with strong functional and technical platform knowledge.
Demonstrated concurrent coverage of 8\+ accounts with distinct configurations.
Permanent US base with US\-business\-hours availability and readiness for on\-site customer visits — a core structural requirement of the role.
Strong Oracle SQL and PL/SQL for production investigations; good Linux and shell scripting.
Deep understanding of SCM\-platform operational processes (Symphony GOLD or equivalent), Night Batch execution, interfaces, and customer\-specific implementations.
Cross\-region coordination experience between customers and global delivery teams across time zones.
Customer relationship building; incident management discipline.
Fluent English.

US grocery wholesale/distribution domain knowledge.
Hawaii/Western\-US time\-zone account experience.
Canadian grocery (multicultural formats) account exposure.**What We Offer**

Competitive salary and benefits package.
Opportunity to work on high\-impact retail transformation and managed\-services programs.
Exposure to leading European and global retailers on the Symphony GOLD platform.
A collaborative and fast\-paced work environment.
Learning and growth opportunities across supply chain, retail, and enterprise AI solutions.

Introduction
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Lead Platform Engineer
   

  

**Overview:**
 Our solutions hosted on our Iris Smart Manufacturing platform combine equipment and process domain expertise in Mining \& Metals, Oil \& Gas, Chemicals \& Petrochemicals with the state\-of\-the\-art in data sciences, machine learning, and process optimization. The IRIS platform can work in hybrid mode and is built using microservices architecture. The applications are containerised and run on Azure Kubernetes service and use Azure blob storage, Data Lake, IoT Hub, Event Hub, Event Grid, and Queues.
   

  

 The development team embraces DevOps culture and delivers products using Continuous Delivery principles. You will be key in managing multiple installations of the platform across Cloud and on\-premise environments, fixing security vulnerabilities on a monthly basis, conducting audits, and contributing to automation of installations. You will have a great opportunity to work with a world\-class team and latest technologies and be able to learn and contribute.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Responsibilities:**
* Contribute to the IRIS Platform operations roadmap and execute planned research and development
* Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure on Azure and AWS using best practices and governance standards
* Lead production operations, including incident management, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis
* Automate so that IRIS Platform is deployable easily across multiple Cloud providers such as Azure and AWS, and on\-premise such as K3s and RKE2
* Work with customers and Services team to support multiple installations of the IRIS platform
* Conduct monthly audits including vulnerabilities, DAST tests, and review of backups, cost and access reviews
* Develop CICD pipelines for projects built microservices that would be deployable across multiple environments
* Implement security best practices in cloud and on\-premise environments to address vulnerabilities and compliance requirements
* Develop and maintain Helm charts for packaging and deploying Kubernetes applications
* Manage operations of the databases and messaging systems Postgres, Elastic, Redis, and Kafka including configuration, scalability, and backups
* Implement auto\-scaling of various platform services within the Kubernetes environment
* Automate infrastructure provisioning with Terraform, Ansible, or similar IaC tools
* Operate Kubernetes clusters, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting to maintain SLAs and availability targets
* Apply security best practices and enforce compliance standards across cloud and deployment pipelines
* Be the operations contact point for multiple product teams


**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**
* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience with AWS and/or Azure
* 3\+ years of experience working with Linux systems
* 4\+ years of commercial experience with Kubernetes
* 2\+ years of experience working with Docker
* 4\+ years of experience setting up CICD pipelines (AzureDevOps or similar)
* 2\+ years of experience with automation tools such as Terraform and Ansible
* 2\+ years of experience with Cloud such as Azure, AWS or GCP
* Good knowledge of best security practices, vulnerability management, and testing tools such as Acunetix, Snyk, CheckMarx or Trivy
* Troubleshooting problems in Production and comfortable doing root cause analysis
* Able to work in an Agile environment


**Preferred Skills \& Qualifications:**
* Good working or operational knowledge of databases (Postgres, Elastic search, Redis or similar)
* Exposure to configuring web servers such as Nginx
* Working knowledge of monitoring tools such as Grafana and Prometheus
* Working knowledge of a messaging framework such as Event Hub, Kafka, RabbitMQ or similar


**Compensation \& Benefits:**
* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Flexible hybrid working model
* Opportunities for professional growth and development
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment
* Access to the latest technologies and tools
* Opportunity to make a tangible impact on cutting\-edge Retail/CPG AI solutions


**Diversity \& Inclusion Statement:**
 We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
   

  

**About Us**
 SymphonyAI is building the leading enterprise AI SaaS company for digital transformation across the most critical and resilient growth industries, including retail, consumer packaged goods, financial crime prevention, manufacturing, media, and IT service management. Since its founding in 2017, SymphonyAI today serves 1500\+ Enterprise customers globally and has grown to 3,000 talented leaders, data scientists, and other professionals across over 30 countries.

We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

 **Job Description**  

We are seeking an experienced **Senior GCP \& Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) DevOps Engineer** to design, implement, and manage secure, scalable, highly available, and resilient cloud infrastructure across **Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**.


The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in **multi\-cloud architecture, DevOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD automation, Kubernetes, cloud networking, observability, and cloud security**. You will work closely with development, QA, security, architecture, and operations teams to streamline software delivery, automate infrastructure management, and improve platform reliability across GCP and OCI environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure across **GCP and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**.
* Design and support multi\-cloud architectures, connectivity, and workloads spanning GCP and OCI.

* Automate infrastructure provisioning, application deployments, configuration management, monitoring, patching, and operational tasks.

* Implement IAM, identity federation, service accounts, OCI dynamic groups, policies, and least\-privilege access controls.
* Configure monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability using **Google Cloud Operations Suite, OCI Monitoring, OCI Logging, Prometheus, and Grafana**.
* Optimize cloud resources across GCP and OCI for performance, scalability, reliability, availability, and cost efficiency.
* Design and support backup, disaster recovery, high availability, and business continuity strategies across cloud environments.
* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure and production issues and participate in incident management, root cause analysis, and remediation.
* Collaborate with development teams to improve application deployment, release management, and platform engineering processes.
* Implement and enforce **DevSecOps**, vulnerability management, secrets management, policy enforcement, and compliance standards.
* Support container and artifact security, vulnerability scanning, and secure software supply\-chain practices.
* Maintain technical documentation, cloud architecture diagrams, deployment procedures, and operational runbooks.
* Mentor junior engineers and promote DevOps, automation, security, and cloud engineering best practices across teams.

**Required Skills:**

* Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
* Compute Engine
* Cloud Run
* Cloud Functions
* Cloud Build
* Cloud Storage
* Cloud SQL
* BigQuery
* Pub/Sub
* VPC, IAM, Load Balancing, and Cloud DNS
* Secret Manager
* Artifact Registry
* Google Cloud Operations Suite

**Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**

* Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE)

* OCI Functions
* OCI Container Instances
* OCI Object Storage
* OCI Database services
* Autonomous Database
* OCI DevOps

0c40eab3.description:
**About Aarvian** 

  
 




  





 Aarvian is an enterprise AI transformation consulting firm that helps organizations turn AI into measurable business outcomes through purpose\-driven strategy, domain expertise, and trusted innovation — moving clients from AI experimentation to enterprise adoption across AI \& ML advisory, data and infrastructure operations, generative AI and agentic solutions, and intelligent automation.
 
  
 




  





**Role Overview** 

  
 




  





 We are looking for a Pre\-Sales Consultant / Manager who combines genuine technical depth in AI and Analytics with the commercial and storytelling skills needed to win enterprise deals. The ideal candidate began their career building AI/ML and analytics solutions hands\-on, and has since moved into a pre\-sales role where they own end\-to\-end proposal development — from opportunity qualification and solution design through costing, RFP/RFI response, and client\-facing presentation — across multiple industry verticals.
 
  
 




  





**Expected Career Trajectory** 

  
 




  




* Started as a hands\-on practitioner — data scientist, ML/AI engineer, or analytics consultant — building and deploying models, dashboards, or AI\-driven solutions.
* Progressively moved closer to the client, taking on solutioning, estimation, and proposal\-writing responsibilities alongside delivery.
* Has now spent meaningful time (typically 2–4\+ years) fully dedicated to pre\-sales, owning proposals end\-to\-end rather than just contributing technical inputs.
* Has worked across more than one industry vertical, adapting AI/Analytics narratives and solution architectures to different client contexts.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 

  
 




  




* Own end\-to\-end proposal development for AI and Analytics opportunities — from opportunity qualification and discovery through solution design, effort estimation, pricing input, and final proposal/RFP submission.
* Translate client business problems into clear AI/Analytics solution narratives, architectures, and value propositions, working closely with delivery, technical, and domain SMEs.
* Lead and contribute to RFP/RFI/RFQ responses, technical write\-ups, case studies, and capability decks tailored to client and vertical.
* Design and articulate solution approaches spanning AI/ML advisory, data \& analytics platforms, generative and agentic AI, and intelligent automation.
* Build and present business cases, ROI models, and commercial constructs (pricing, effort sizing, delivery models) in partnership with sales and delivery leadership.
* Represent Aarvian in client workshops, solution walkthroughs, and executive presentations, including running or contributing to proof\-of\-concept (PoC) scoping.
* Maintain and evolve reusable pre\-sales assets — solution accelerators, reference architectures, proposal templates, and vertical\-specific pitch material.
* Partner with account/sales teams to shape deal strategy, competitive positioning, and win themes.
* Stay current on AI/Analytics market trends, emerging technologies, and competitor offerings to keep proposals differentiated and credible.



  





**Required Experience \& Qualifications** 

  
 



* 5–10 years of overall experience, including meaningful hands\-on delivery experience in AI/ML, data science, or analytics before transitioning into pre\-sales.
* Demonstrated track record of owning full proposal lifecycles (not just technical inputs) for enterprise AI/Analytics engagements.
* Experience working across multiple industry verticals (e.g., manufacturing, BFSI, retail, telecom, public sector, industrial/metals), adapting solutioning to each context.
* Strong grasp of AI/ML, data engineering, and analytics platforms and architectures — sufficient to design and defend a solution technically, not just present it.
* Proven ability to produce clear, client\-ready proposal documents, solution decks, and commercial write\-ups under deal timelines.
* Comfortable engaging directly with client stakeholders, from technical teams through business and executive sponsors.



  





**Preferred Experience** 

  
 




  




* Prior experience working with Middle East (ME) clients — understanding of regional buying processes, stakeholder dynamics, and localization/compliance considerations.
* Experience with government or public sector clients — familiarity with public\-sector RFP/tender processes, compliance and security requirements, and longer, multi\-stakeholder sales cycles.
* Exposure to large\-scale digital transformation or Industry 4\.0 / industrial AI programs is a plus.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 

  
 




  





**Technical** 

  
 



* Working knowledge of AI/ML techniques, generative \& agentic AI, data platforms (cloud data warehouses/lakes), and common analytics/BI tooling.
* Ability to read and contribute to solution architecture diagrams and effort/estimation models.



**Business \& Communication** 

  
 



* Excellent written communication — able to structure and write persuasive, well\-organized proposals and executive summaries.
* Strong verbal and presentation skills, comfortable leading client\-facing conversations and workshops.
* Commercial acumen — understanding of pricing models, effort estimation, and deal economics.
* Strong stakeholder management, cross\-functional collaboration, and ability to work under deal\-driven deadlines.



  





**Education** 

  
 



* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field; MBA or equivalent management qualification is a plus.

* Lead end\-to\-end cybersecurity presales engagements, including requirement gathering, discovery workshops, solution design, technical presentations, product demonstrations, proof of concepts, and proposal support.

****AI Engineering Layer for mission\-critical AI****

 . We help enterprises turn open and closed models into
 
****governed, auditable, production\-grade systems****

 without vendor or infrastructure lock\-in.
 





 Founded by pioneers in deep learning, with research hubs in Mumbai and Paris, Lexsi operates at the intersection of
 
****AI safety, interpretability, alignment, and systems engineering****

 . Our work is published at top\-tier venues (ICML, IJCNN, WWW, ACL), and our patented technologies, such as
 
****DL\-Backtrace****

 , enable explainability and auditability at a scale that enterprise AI demands.
 





 Our customers deploy AI in environments where failures are expensive, regulation is real, and evidence matters: banking, financial services, insurance, and other high\-risk domains.
 




 The Role
 


 We are looking for a
 
****Senior AI Solutions Architect****

 to lead strategic, high\-value customer engagements and support large enterprise transactions. This is a senior, customer\-facing pre\-sales role for someone who combines
 
****deep AI understanding, system\-level thinking, and executive communication skills****

 .
 





 You will work closely with sales leadership, researchers, and engineers to shape deals from first conversation to closure. You will regularly engage with CXOs, Heads of AI, Risk, and Engineering, helping them understand how to build
 
****sovereign, governed, and defensible AI systems****

 using Lexsi’s platform and research\-led primitives.
 





 This role is not about running delivery projects. It is about
 
****owning technical credibility in complex sales cycles****

 .
 




 What You’ll Do
 


 You will lead technical discovery, solution design, and executive\-level presentations for large, multi\-stakeholder customers across Europe, the Middle East, and South Asia. You will frame customer problems around AI sovereignty, risk, governance, cost, and control, and translate them into clear architectures and evidence\-backed solutions.
 





 You will own the technical narrative in proposals, RFPs, and regulatory questionnaires, working closely with internal research and engineering teams to ensure accuracy, rigor, and feasibility. You will support advanced demos and proofs\-of\-concept, and help customers understand how Lexsi enables governed LLM gateways, explainability at scale, alignment and fine\-tuning pipelines, and runtime observability.
 





 Internally, you will act as the voice of the customer, feeding structured insights back into product, platform, and go\-to\-market strategy.
 




 Who You Are
 


 You have significant experience working with AI systems and have spent time in
 
****pre\-sales, solution architecture, or technical consulting roles****

 tied to complex enterprise deals. You have built or shipped AI products and understand modern ML systems beyond surface\-level tooling.
 





 You are comfortable discussing topics such as explainability, alignment, evaluation, and deployment trade\-offs with both researchers and senior enterprise stakeholders. You can walk into a high\-stakes meeting and clearly explain why governance, auditability, and model optionality matter, without losing the room in technical detail.
 





 You write clearly, present confidently, and operate well in ambiguity. You enjoy shaping solutions rather than following scripts.
 




 Why This Role at Lexsi
 


 You will work at the frontier of
 
****trustworthy and mission\-critical AI****

 , influencing how advanced research is adopted in real enterprises. You will play a visible role in large strategic deals and help define how Lexsi is positioned with regulators, banks, and global institutions.
 





 This is a role for someone who wants to sit where
 
****research, product, and revenue intersect****

 , and who enjoys being trusted with conversations that actually matter.

 At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.
   

  





 We're looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager to drive the strategy, planning, and execution of large\-scale, cross\-functional programs across Talent Enterprise Engineering and other org partners. In this role, you'll lead cross\-functional projects, and partner closely with engineering, product, data science, and design to deliver high\-impact initiatives that shape how LinkedIn members and enterprise customers experience career mobility.
   

  





 At the Staff level, you are expected to independently own ambiguous, complex programs, influence technical and product direction, and raise the bar for program management practices across the org.
   

  





 Responsibilities:
   

  




* Lead and drive end\-to\-end delivery of multiple concurrent, high\-complexity AI\-driven engineering programs across Talent Enterprise Engineering and LinkedIn — from scoping and roadmap planning through launch and post\-launch measurement.

* Partner with engineering on AI system design trade\-offs — model selection, latency/cost/accuracy balance, data pipelines, and evaluation frameworks — and translate those decisions into program risk and timeline impact.

* Partner with engineering leads, architects, and product leaders to identify technical dependencies, risks, and critical path, and drive resolution across teams.
* Define and own program operating rhythms: planning cadences, milestone tracking, cross\-team sync structures, and executive reporting.
* Drive bi\-annual roadmap and resource planning, and lead teams through execution of roadmaps, releases, and backlogs.

* Anticipate and proactively mitigate risks; surface gaps, unblock issues, and escalate blockers with clear, actionable recommendations.
* Foster a collaborative environment built on transparency, shared understanding, autonomy, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Coach and mentor others in modern technical program planning and execution best practices.
* Bring business\-strategy understanding and strong product intuition to program decisions.


**Qualifications**

* 6\+ years of full time technical program management experience within an engineering or technical team
* B.S degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 4\+ years of hands\-on software engineering development experience



 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  




* 8\+ years of full time technical program management experience
* Demonstrated success managing multiple major and concurrent projects/programs
* Demonstrated success driving the development program of world\-class online products
* Significant experience working with software engineering leadership, technical teams, individual contributors and external clients
* Knowledge of complex technical ecosystems and adequate technical depth
* Ability to build collaborations and create a community of leadership
* Be a thought leader; someone who can help advance strategy and challenge others in the organization to make important improvements
* Demonstrated conflict resolution skills combined with strong negotiation ability delivered with a high level of influence and professionalism
* Agile coaching and practitioner experience (Scrum, Kanban) with multiple teams.
* Experience in managing all phases of end\-to\-end product development
* Knowledge of Internet client/server social networking applications and systems
* Hands\-on software development experience

**Job Description: Pre\-Sales Manager – Core Banking** 




**Position** 




**Pre\-Sales Manager – Core Banking Domain** 




**Experience \- 7–12 Years** 




**Location – Siruseri \- Chennai (Work From Office)** 




  





**About Intellect** 




 Intellect Design Arena is a global leader in Financial Technology, enabling banking and insurance institutions to accelerate digital transformation, modernize core infrastructures, and deliver exceptional customer experiences. With a comprehensive suite of cloud\-native, API\-first, and AI\-led solutions, Intellect powers financial institutions across Consumer Banking, Wholesale Banking, Transaction Banking, Capital Markets, Wealth, and Insurance globally.
 



 Explore more at: www.intellectdesign.com
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




  





 As
 **Pre\-Sales Manager – Core Banking** 
 , you will own the solutioning agenda across complex, high\-value core banking modernization deals. You will bring together deep functional domain expertise in core banking (Deposits, Lending, General Ledger, Payments Integration, Interest Engine, and Real\-Time Account Processing), cloud\-native microservices architecture, and consultative selling to win transformational business.
 



 You will engage with C\-level executives (CIOs, CTOs, Heads of Retail/Corporate Banking, Chief Risk Officers) to diagnose architectural and operational bottlenecks in legacy systems, and translate them into modern, API\-first, AI\-enabled Core Banking transformation opportunities.
 



  





**Role Definition** 




  





 The Pre\-Sales Manager actively drives early\-to\-late stage sales cycles by shaping, qualifying, and solutioning Core Banking opportunities. You will act as the crucial bridge between Sales, Core Banking Product Management, Architecture, and Delivery teams to create compelling value propositions, lead technical \& functional workshops, and demonstrate modern core platform capabilities to drive deal conversions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Prospect \& Core Banking Discovery** 



* Engage with banking executives, C\-level IT leaders, and business unit heads to analyze current legacy core architectures, pain points, batch processing bottlenecks, and operational challenges.
* Actively validate critical deal qualifiers—including Need/Legacy Transformation Urgency, Decision Makers, Timeline, Budget runway, and Deployment Preference (SaaS, On\-Premise, Cloud).



  





**Consultative Value \& Domain Selling** 



* Articulate measurable business outcomes (e.g., lower TCO, real\-time 24/7 processing, faster time\-to\-market for deposit/lending products, zero\-downtime maintenance).
* Guide banks through core transformation journeys, including progressive modernization, co\-existence strategies, and full core replacements.



  





**Core Banking Demonstrations \& Solution Workshops** 



* Lead high\-impact product demonstrations, proof\-of\-concepts (POCs), and discovery workshops showcasing core engine capabilities (Product Builder, Account Servicing, General Ledger, Interest Calculation, End\-of\-Day/Batch processing, and Open Banking APIs).
* Conduct "Demo Diagnostics" to ensure live scenarios match the client's specific regulatory and localization requirements.



  





**RFP / RFI \& Bid Management** 



* Own and lead technical/functional responses for Core Banking RFPs, RFIs, and unsolicited bids.
* Ensure responses accurately reflect core platform capabilities, cloud\-native readiness, security standards, and integration frameworks.



  





**Solutioning \& Architecture Alignment** 



* Design tailored end\-to\-end core banking solutions, including high\-level integration topology, data migration strategies from legacy systems, parameterization models, and deployment architectures.
* Collaborate on effort estimations, implementation timelines, assumptions, phase\-wise rollouts, and commercial structures.



  





**Cross\-Functional Coordination (Product, Tech \& Delivery)** 



* Work closely with Product Roadmap teams, Enterprise Architects, and Implementation Leads to validate custom requirements, API extensions, local clearing/regulatory mandates, and delivery feasibility.



  





**Sales Enablement \& Competitive Intelligence** 



* Equip global sales teams with Core Banking playbooks, competitive battle cards (e.g., against legacy core incumbents), pitch decks, ROI calculators, and demo scripts.



  





**Product \& Market Feedback Loop** 



* Feed structured market intelligence, client requests, and regional compliance trends (e.g., ISO 20022, real\-time clearing, open API mandates) directly into the Core Banking Product Strategy team.



  





**Transition to Delivery** 



* Ensure seamless handovers from Sales to the Core Banking Delivery team by clearly documenting target architecture, functional scope, custom commitments, data migration assumptions, and risks.



  





**Experience \& Qualifications** 




  




* **Education:** 
**MBA (Master of Business Administration) is Mandatory** 
 (preferably in Finance, Systems, Business Analytics, or General Management from a reputed institute).
* **Experience:** 
 7–12 years of overall experience with a strong track record in
 **Core Banking Pre\-Sales, Solution Architecture, or Core Banking Functional Consulting** 
 within Fintechs, Banking IT Consultancies, or System Integrators.
* **Domain Expertise:** 
 Deep domain knowledge in Core Banking modules—including Retail \& Commercial Deposits, Loans \& Lending, General Ledger (GL) \& Accounting, Interest \& Charges Engine, Teller/Branch Operations, and Real\-Time Payment Clearing.
* **Architecture \& Modernization Understanding:** 
 Strong understanding of Core Banking transformation strategies (e.g., Legacy Co\-existence, API\-first architecture, Microservices, Cloud\-native deployments, and Data Migration methodologies).
* **Pursuit Leadership:** 
 Proven experience leading complex Core Banking sales pursuits, executive workshops, POCs, and high\-stakes client demonstrations to CXOs.
* **Commercial \& Bid Acumen:** 
 Hands\-on experience building core solution proposals, scope/RACI matrices, effort estimation models, and rollout plans.
* **Communication \& CXO Presence:** 
 Exceptional presentation and consultative skills with the ability to build immediate credibility with both technical (CTO/EA) and business (Head of Core/Retail/Operations) stakeholders.



  





**Why This Role?** 




 You will operate at the very center of banking infrastructure modernization—where legacy constraints meet next\-generation AI and cloud architecture. In this role, your deep core banking domain expertise won't just support deals; it will actively shape product roadmap strategies and guide global financial institutions through their most critical IT transformations.

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

 Architects educate customers about product features and automations, perform technical discovery \& assessments to provide guidance on APIs and extensibility of Slack as a platform. They advise on practical applications of AI, and develop recommendations on architecture changes and integrations that drive adoption.
   

  

 Success Architects reduce enterprise risk and accelerate time\-to\-value by ensuring Slack is designed correctly in complex environments. In an ever changing technical landscape, we are seeking someone who understands technical capabilities but can blend that with customer facing pedigree to help customers move from challenge to deployable solution at pace with Slack.
   

  

 We are expanding our team to find someone who can both practically apply AI technologies to internal business problems, and theoretically guide our customers about the use of AI technologies that integrate with Slack.
   

  

 Do you want to work alongside some of the most hardworking and dynamic people in the industry? If so, Slack just might be the place for you.
